@graph.name: Schema.org Vocabulary
@graph.description: The full schema.org vocabulary expressed as a MASP schema crate. Generated from the official schema.org JSON-LD dump.

@graph.rdfs:label: episodes
@graph.name: episodes
@graph.rdfs:comment: An episode of a TV/radio series or season.

@graph.rdfs:label: deathDate
@graph.name: deathDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date of death.

@graph.rdfs:label: replacee
@graph.name: replacee
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of object. The object that is being replaced.

@graph.rdfs:label: availableStrength
@graph.name: availableStrength
@graph.rdfs:comment: An available dosage strength for the drug.

@graph.rdfs:label: yearBuilt
@graph.name: yearBuilt
@graph.rdfs:comment: The year an [[Accommodation]] was constructed. This corresponds to the [YearBuilt field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/YearBuilt+Field).

@graph.rdfs:label: tocEntry
@graph.name: tocEntry
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a [[HyperTocEntry]] in a [[HyperToc]].

@graph.rdfs:label: AutoBodyShop
@graph.name: AutoBodyShop
@graph.rdfs:comment: Auto body shop.

@graph.rdfs:label: CafeOrCoffeeShop
@graph.name: CafeOrCoffeeShop
@graph.rdfs:comment: A cafe or coffee shop.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumVentUse
@graph.name: cvdNumVentUse
@graph.rdfs:comment: numventuse - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS IN USE: Total number of ventilators in use.

@graph.rdfs:label: courseSchedule
@graph.name: courseSchedule
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the length and pace of a course, expressed as a [[Schedule]].

@graph.rdfs:label: InstallAction
@graph.name: InstallAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of installing an application.

@graph.rdfs:label: companyRegistration
@graph.name: companyRegistration
@graph.rdfs:comment: The official registration information of a business including the organization that issued it such as Company House or Chamber of Commerce in form of a Certification.

@graph.rdfs:label: orderPercentage
@graph.name: orderPercentage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Value representing the fraction of the value of the order that is charged as shipping cost. Example: 0.10 would mean shipping rate is 10% of the total order value.

@graph.rdfs:label: LandmarksOrHistoricalBuildings
@graph.name: LandmarksOrHistoricalBuildings
@graph.rdfs:comment: An historical landmark or building.

@graph.rdfs:label: Mass
@graph.name: Mass
@graph.rdfs:comment: Properties that take Mass as values are of the form '<Number> <Mass unit of measure>'. E.g., '7 kg'.

@graph.rdfs:label: TaxiService
@graph.name: TaxiService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A service for a vehicle for hire with a driver for local travel. Fares are usually calculated based on distance traveled.

@graph.rdfs:label: educationalUse
@graph.name: educationalUse
@graph.rdfs:comment: The purpose of a work in the context of education; for example, 'assignment', 'group work'.

@graph.rdfs:label: qualifications
@graph.name: qualifications
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specific qualifications required for this role or Occupation.

@graph.rdfs:label: PronounceableText
@graph.name: PronounceableText
@graph.rdfs:comment: Data type: PronounceableText.

@graph.rdfs:label: creditedTo
@graph.name: creditedTo
@graph.rdfs:comment: The group the release is credited to if different than the byArtist. For example, Red and Blue is credited to "Stefani Germanotta Band", but by Lady Gaga.

@graph.rdfs:label: molecularFormula
@graph.name: molecularFormula
@graph.rdfs:comment: The empirical formula is the simplest whole number ratio of all the atoms in a molecule.

@graph.rdfs:label: events
@graph.name: events
@graph.rdfs:comment: Upcoming or past events associated with this place or organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: containsPlace
@graph.name: containsPlace
@graph.rdfs:comment: The basic containment relation between a place and another that it contains.

@graph.rdfs:label: AutoRepair
@graph.name: AutoRepair
@graph.rdfs:comment: Car repair business.

@graph.rdfs:label: seatNumber
@graph.name: seatNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The location of the reserved seat (e.g., 27).

@graph.rdfs:label: sdPublisher
@graph.name: sdPublisher
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Indicates the party responsible for generating and publishing the current structured data markup, typically in cases where the structured data is derived automatically from existing published content but published on a different site. For example, student projects and open data initiatives often re-publish existing content with more explicitly structured metadata. The
[[sdPublisher]] property helps make such practices more explicit.

@graph.rdfs:label: PlaceOfWorship
@graph.name: PlaceOfWorship
@graph.rdfs:comment: Place of worship, such as a church, synagogue, or mosque.

@graph.rdfs:label: SizeSystemEnumeration
@graph.name: SizeSystemEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates common size systems for different categories of products, for example "EN-13402" or "UK" for wearables or "Imperial" for screws.

@graph.rdfs:label: AuthenticateAction
@graph.name: AuthenticateAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The action of authenticating into a device or application.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumBedsOcc
@graph.name: cvdNumBedsOcc
@graph.rdfs:comment: numbedsocc - HOSPITAL INPATIENT BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient beds that are occupied.

@graph.rdfs:label: worstRating
@graph.name: worstRating
@graph.rdfs:comment: The lowest value allowed in this rating system.

@graph.rdfs:label: suggestedMaxAge
@graph.name: suggestedMaxAge
@graph.rdfs:comment: Maximum recommended age in years for the audience or user.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationTransposes
@graph.name: legislationTransposes
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates that this legislation (or part of legislation) fulfills the objectives set by another legislation, by passing appropriate implementation measures. Typically, some legislations of European Union's member states or regions transpose European Directives. This indicates a legally binding link between the 2 legislations.

@graph.rdfs:label: ShippingConditions
@graph.name: ShippingConditions
@graph.rdfs:comment: ShippingConditions represent a set of constraints and information about the conditions of shipping a product. Such conditions may apply to only a subset of the products being shipped, depending on aspects of the product like weight, size, price, destination, and others. All the specified conditions must be met for this ShippingConditions to apply.

@graph.rdfs:label: torque
@graph.name: torque
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The torque (turning force) of the vehicle's engine.

Typical unit code(s): NU for newton metre (N m), F17 for pound-force per foot, or F48 for pound-force per inch

* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined (e.g. reference RPM) using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

@graph.rdfs:label: EducationalOccupationalCredential
@graph.name: EducationalOccupationalCredential
@graph.rdfs:comment: An educational or occupational credential. A diploma, academic degree, certification, qualification, badge, etc., that may be awarded to a person or other entity that meets the requirements defined by the credentialer.

@graph.rdfs:label: datePosted
@graph.name: datePosted
@graph.rdfs:comment: Publication date of an online listing.

@graph.rdfs:label: orderStatus
@graph.name: orderStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The current status of the order.

@graph.rdfs:label: text
@graph.name: text
@graph.rdfs:comment: The textual content of this CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: actionAccessibilityRequirement
@graph.name: actionAccessibilityRequirement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A set of requirements that must be fulfilled in order to perform an Action. If more than one value is specified, fulfilling one set of requirements will allow the Action to be performed.

@graph.rdfs:label: hospitalAffiliation
@graph.name: hospitalAffiliation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A hospital with which the physician or office is affiliated.

@graph.rdfs:label: Certification
@graph.name: Certification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Certification is an official and authoritative statement about a subject, for example a product, service, person, or organization. A certification is typically issued by an indendent certification body, for example a professional organization or government. It formally attests certain characteristics about the subject, for example Organizations can be ISO certified, Food products can be certified Organic or Vegan, a Person can be a certified professional, a Place can be certified for food processing. There are certifications for many domains: regulatory, organizational, recycling, food, efficiency, educational, ecological, etc. A certification is a form of credential, as are accreditations and licenses. Mapped from the [gs1:CertificationDetails](https://www.gs1.org/voc/CertificationDetails) class in the GS1 Web Vocabulary.

@graph.rdfs:label: totalHistoricalEnrollment
@graph.name: totalHistoricalEnrollment
@graph.rdfs:comment: The total number of students that have enrolled in the history of the course.

@graph.rdfs:label: dissolutionDate
@graph.name: dissolutionDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date that this organization was dissolved.

@graph.rdfs:label: TrainStation
@graph.name: TrainStation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A train station.

@graph.rdfs:label: webFeed
@graph.name: webFeed
@graph.rdfs:comment: The URL for a feed, e.g. associated with a podcast series, blog, or series of date-stamped updates. This is usually RSS or Atom.

@graph.rdfs:label: accommodationFloorPlan
@graph.name: accommodationFloorPlan
@graph.rdfs:comment: A floorplan of some [[Accommodation]].

@graph.rdfs:label: Quantity
@graph.name: Quantity
@graph.rdfs:comment: Quantities such as distance, time, mass, weight, etc. Particular instances of say Mass are strings like '3 kg' or '4 milligrams'.

@graph.rdfs:label: MenuSection
@graph.name: MenuSection
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub-grouping of food or drink items in a menu. E.g. courses (such as 'Dinner', 'Breakfast', etc.), specific type of dishes (such as 'Meat', 'Vegan', 'Drinks', etc.), or some other classification made by the menu provider.

@graph.rdfs:label: valueMaxLength
@graph.name: valueMaxLength
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies the allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

@graph.rdfs:label: educationalProgramMode
@graph.name: educationalProgramMode
@graph.rdfs:comment: Similar to courseMode, the medium or means of delivery of the program as a whole. The value may either be a text label (e.g. "online", "onsite" or "blended"; "synchronous" or "asynchronous"; "full-time" or "part-time") or a URL reference to a term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. https://ceds.ed.gov/element/001311#Asynchronous ).

@graph.rdfs:label: InfectiousAgentClass
@graph.name: InfectiousAgentClass
@graph.rdfs:comment: Classes of agents or pathogens that transmit infectious diseases. Enumerated type.

@graph.rdfs:label: monoisotopicMolecularWeight
@graph.name: monoisotopicMolecularWeight
@graph.rdfs:comment: The monoisotopic mass is the sum of the masses of the atoms in a molecule using the unbound, ground-state, rest mass of the principal (most abundant) isotope for each element instead of the isotopic average mass. Please include the units in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '770.230488 g/mol' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

@graph.rdfs:label: item
@graph.name: item
@graph.rdfs:comment: An entity represented by an entry in a list or data feed (e.g. an 'artist' in a list of 'artists').

@graph.rdfs:label: telephone
@graph.name: telephone
@graph.rdfs:comment: The telephone number.

@graph.rdfs:label: Country
@graph.name: Country
@graph.rdfs:comment: A country.

@graph.rdfs:label: cause
@graph.name: cause
@graph.rdfs:comment: The cause of a medical condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumC19HOPats
@graph.name: cvdNumC19HOPats
@graph.rdfs:comment: numc19hopats - HOSPITAL ONSET: Patients hospitalized in an NHSN inpatient care location with onset of suspected or confirmed COVID-19 14 or more days after hospitalization.

@graph.rdfs:label: SportsActivityLocation
@graph.name: SportsActivityLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sports location, such as a playing field.

@graph.rdfs:label: BoatReservation
@graph.name: BoatReservation
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A reservation for boat travel.

Note: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

@graph.rdfs:label: hasDefinedTerm
@graph.name: hasDefinedTerm
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Defined Term contained in this term set.

@graph.rdfs:label: PhysicalActivity
@graph.name: PhysicalActivity
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any bodily activity that enhances or maintains physical fitness and overall health and wellness. Includes activity that is part of daily living and routine, structured exercise, and exercise prescribed as part of a medical treatment or recovery plan.

@graph.rdfs:label: CityHall
@graph.name: CityHall
@graph.rdfs:comment: A city hall.

@graph.rdfs:label: medicineSystem
@graph.name: medicineSystem
@graph.rdfs:comment: The system of medicine that includes this MedicalEntity, for example 'evidence-based', 'homeopathic', 'chiropractic', etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: language
@graph.name: language
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of instrument. The language used on this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: jobDuration
@graph.name: jobDuration
@graph.rdfs:comment: The expected duration of an employment offer as advertised by the employer. Relevant for job postings that have a clearly defined period in mind such as seasonal work, substitutes for maternal leave or any other temporary employment.

@graph.rdfs:label: usesHealthPlanIdStandard
@graph.name: usesHealthPlanIdStandard
@graph.rdfs:comment: The standard for interpreting the Plan ID. The preferred is "HIOS". See the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services for more details.

@graph.rdfs:label: option
@graph.name: option
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of object. The options subject to this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: FMRadioChannel
@graph.name: FMRadioChannel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A radio channel that uses FM.

@graph.rdfs:label: Brand
@graph.name: Brand
@graph.rdfs:comment: A brand is a name used by an organization or business person for labeling a product, product group, or similar.

@graph.rdfs:label: passengerPriorityStatus
@graph.name: passengerPriorityStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The priority status assigned to a passenger for security or boarding (e.g. FastTrack or Priority).

@graph.rdfs:label: subTrip
@graph.name: subTrip
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifies a [[Trip]] that is a subTrip of this Trip.  For example Day 1, Day 2, etc. of a multi-day trip.

@graph.rdfs:label: OfferForPurchase
@graph.name: OfferForPurchase
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An [[OfferForPurchase]] in Schema.org represents an [[Offer]] to sell something, i.e. an [[Offer]] whose
  [[businessFunction]] is [sell](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.). See [Good Relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GoodRelations) for
  background on the underlying concepts.

@graph.rdfs:label: offeredBy
@graph.name: offeredBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pointer to the organization or person making the offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: alternativeHeadline
@graph.name: alternativeHeadline
@graph.rdfs:comment: A secondary title of the CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: applicantLocationRequirements
@graph.name: applicantLocationRequirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: The location(s) applicants can apply from. This is usually used for telecommuting jobs where the applicant does not need to be in a physical office. Note: This should not be used for citizenship or work visa requirements.

@graph.rdfs:label: Library
@graph.name: Library
@graph.rdfs:comment: A library.

@graph.rdfs:label: ExercisePlan
@graph.name: ExercisePlan
@graph.rdfs:comment: Fitness-related activity designed for a specific health-related purpose, including defined exercise routines as well as activity prescribed by a clinician.

@graph.rdfs:label: restPeriods
@graph.name: restPeriods
@graph.rdfs:comment: How often one should break from the activity.

@graph.rdfs:label: actionApplication
@graph.name: actionApplication
@graph.rdfs:comment: An application that can complete the request.

@graph.rdfs:label: Grant
@graph.name: Grant
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A grant, typically financial or otherwise quantifiable, of resources. Typically a [[funder]] sponsors some [[MonetaryAmount]] to an [[Organization]] or [[Person]],
    sometimes not necessarily via a dedicated or long-lived [[Project]], resulting in one or more outputs, or [[fundedItem]]s. For financial sponsorship, indicate the [[funder]] of a [[MonetaryGrant]]. For non-financial support, indicate [[sponsor]] of [[Grant]]s of resources (e.g. office space).

Grants support  activities directed towards some agreed collective goals, often but not always organized as [[Project]]s. Long-lived projects are sometimes sponsored by a variety of grants over time, but it is also common for a project to be associated with a single grant.

The amount of a [[Grant]] is represented using [[amount]] as a [[MonetaryAmount]].

@graph.rdfs:label: discountCurrency
@graph.name: discountCurrency
@graph.rdfs:comment: The currency of the discount.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

@graph.rdfs:label: Atlas
@graph.name: Atlas
@graph.rdfs:comment: A collection or bound volume of maps, charts, plates or tables, physical or in media form illustrating any subject.

@graph.rdfs:label: includedRiskFactor
@graph.name: includedRiskFactor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A modifiable or non-modifiable risk factor included in the calculation, e.g. age, coexisting condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: WebApplication
@graph.name: WebApplication
@graph.rdfs:comment: Web applications.

@graph.rdfs:label: addressRegion
@graph.name: addressRegion
@graph.rdfs:comment: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. For example, California or another appropriate first-level [Administrative division](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_administrative_divisions_by_country) such as the Province in Italy or Region in Germany.

@graph.rdfs:label: ItemAvailability
@graph.name: ItemAvailability
@graph.rdfs:comment: A list of possible product availability options.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationCountersignedBy
@graph.name: legislationCountersignedBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: The person or organization that countersigned the legislation. Depending on the legal context, a countersignature can indicate that the signed authority undertakes to assume responsibility for texts emanating from a person who is inviolable and irresponsible, (for example a King, Grand Duc or President), or that the authority is in charge of the implementation of the text.

@graph.rdfs:label: Audience
@graph.name: Audience
@graph.rdfs:comment: Intended audience for an item, i.e. the group for whom the item was created.

@graph.rdfs:label: Mosque
@graph.name: Mosque
@graph.rdfs:comment: A mosque.

@graph.rdfs:label: foundingDate
@graph.name: foundingDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date that this organization was founded.

@graph.rdfs:label: seatSection
@graph.name: seatSection
@graph.rdfs:comment: The section location of the reserved seat (e.g. Orchestra).

@graph.rdfs:label: winner
@graph.name: winner
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of participant. The winner of the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: Language
@graph.name: Language
@graph.rdfs:comment: Natural languages such as Spanish, Tamil, Hindi, English, etc. Formal language code tags expressed in [BCP 47](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag) can be used via the [[alternateName]] property. The Language type previously also covered programming languages such as Scheme and Lisp, which are now best represented using [[ComputerLanguage]].

@graph.rdfs:label: regionsAllowed
@graph.name: regionsAllowed
@graph.rdfs:comment: The regions where the media is allowed. If not specified, then it's assumed to be allowed everywhere. Specify the countries in [ISO 3166 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166).

@graph.rdfs:label: isConsumableFor
@graph.name: isConsumableFor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is a consumable.

@graph.rdfs:label: mainContentOfPage
@graph.name: mainContentOfPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates if this web page element is the main subject of the page.

@graph.rdfs:label: paymentMethod
@graph.name: paymentMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.

@graph.rdfs:label: preOp
@graph.name: preOp
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the workup, testing, and other preparations required before implanting this device.

@graph.rdfs:label: acceptedAnswer
@graph.name: acceptedAnswer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The answer(s) that has been accepted as best, typically on a Question/Answer site. Sites vary in their selection mechanisms, e.g. drawing on community opinion and/or the view of the Question author.

@graph.rdfs:label: servesCuisine
@graph.name: servesCuisine
@graph.rdfs:comment: The cuisine of the restaurant.

@graph.rdfs:label: abridged
@graph.name: abridged
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether the book is an abridged edition.

@graph.rdfs:label: PodcastSeries
@graph.name: PodcastSeries
@graph.rdfs:comment: A podcast is an episodic series of digital audio or video files which a user can download and listen to.

@graph.rdfs:label: yearsInOperation
@graph.name: yearsInOperation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The age of the business.

@graph.rdfs:label: passengerSequenceNumber
@graph.name: passengerSequenceNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The passenger's sequence number as assigned by the airline.

@graph.rdfs:label: sponsor
@graph.name: sponsor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person or organization that supports a thing through a pledge, promise, or financial contribution. E.g. a sponsor of a Medical Study or a corporate sponsor of an event.

@graph.rdfs:label: lesser
@graph.name: lesser
@graph.rdfs:comment: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than the object.

@graph.rdfs:label: PerformanceRole
@graph.name: PerformanceRole
@graph.rdfs:comment: A PerformanceRole is a Role that some entity places with regard to a theatrical performance, e.g. in a Movie, TVSeries etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: HowToStep
@graph.name: HowToStep
@graph.rdfs:comment: A step in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It is an ordered list with HowToDirection and/or HowToTip items.

@graph.rdfs:label: inker
@graph.name: inker
@graph.rdfs:comment: The individual who traces over the pencil drawings in ink after pencils are complete.

@graph.rdfs:label: minPrice
@graph.name: minPrice
@graph.rdfs:comment: The lowest price if the price is a range.

@graph.rdfs:label: requiredCollateral
@graph.name: requiredCollateral
@graph.rdfs:comment: Assets required to secure loan or credit repayments. It may take form of third party pledge, goods, financial instruments (cash, securities, etc.)

@graph.rdfs:label: VoteAction
@graph.name: VoteAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of expressing a preference from a fixed/finite/structured set of choices/options.

@graph.rdfs:label: contributor
@graph.name: contributor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A secondary contributor to the CreativeWork or Event.

@graph.rdfs:label: penciler
@graph.name: penciler
@graph.rdfs:comment: The individual who draws the primary narrative artwork.

@graph.rdfs:label: insertion
@graph.name: insertion
@graph.rdfs:comment: The place of attachment of a muscle, or what the muscle moves.

@graph.rdfs:label: activityFrequency
@graph.name: activityFrequency
@graph.rdfs:comment: How often one should engage in the activity.

@graph.rdfs:label: Legislation
@graph.name: Legislation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A legal document such as an act, decree, bill, etc. (enforceable or not) or a component of a legal act (like an article).

@graph.rdfs:label: FinancialIncentive
@graph.name: FinancialIncentive
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Represents financial incentives for goods/services offered by an organization (or individual).

Typically contains the [[name]] of the incentive, the [[incentivizedItem]], the [[incentiveAmount]], the [[incentiveStatus]], [[incentiveType]], the [[provider]] of the incentive, and [[eligibleWithSupplier]].

Optionally contains criteria on whether the incentive is limited based on [[purchaseType]], [[purchasePriceLimit]], [[incomeLimit]], and the [[qualifiedExpense]].

@graph.rdfs:label: BodyMeasurementTypeEnumeration
@graph.name: BodyMeasurementTypeEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates types (or dimensions) of a person's body measurements, for example for fitting of clothes.

@graph.rdfs:label: publicationType
@graph.name: publicationType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of the medical article, taken from the US NLM MeSH publication type catalog. See also [MeSH documentation](http://www.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/pubtypes.html).

@graph.rdfs:label: reviewBody
@graph.name: reviewBody
@graph.rdfs:comment: The actual body of the review.

@graph.rdfs:label: archiveHeld
@graph.name: archiveHeld
@graph.rdfs:comment: Collection, [fonds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fonds), or item held, kept or maintained by an [[ArchiveOrganization]].

@graph.rdfs:label: isProprietary
@graph.name: isProprietary
@graph.rdfs:comment: True if this item's name is a proprietary/brand name (vs. generic name).

@graph.rdfs:label: incentiveCompensation
@graph.name: incentiveCompensation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Description of bonus and commission compensation aspects of the job.

@graph.rdfs:label: Synagogue
@graph.name: Synagogue
@graph.rdfs:comment: A synagogue.

@graph.rdfs:label: softwareVersion
@graph.name: softwareVersion
@graph.rdfs:comment: Version of the software instance.

@graph.rdfs:label: SequentialArt
@graph.name: SequentialArt
@graph.rdfs:comment: An art forms that use images deployed in a specific order for the purpose of graphic storytelling (i.e., narration of graphic stories) or conveying information. Examples of SequentialArt are Franco-Belgian Bande Dessinée, Comics in the USA and 漫画 (Manga) in Japan.

@graph.rdfs:label: geoIntersects
@graph.name: geoIntersects
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) have at least one point in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

@graph.rdfs:label: articleSection
@graph.name: articleSection
@graph.rdfs:comment: Articles may belong to one or more 'sections' in a magazine or newspaper, such as Sports, Lifestyle, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: billingPeriod
@graph.name: billingPeriod
@graph.rdfs:comment: The time interval used to compute the invoice.

@graph.rdfs:label: hoursAvailable
@graph.name: hoursAvailable
@graph.rdfs:comment: The hours during which this service or contact is available.

@graph.rdfs:label: audio
@graph.name: audio
@graph.rdfs:comment: An embedded audio object.

@graph.rdfs:label: CDCPMDRecord
@graph.name: CDCPMDRecord
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A CDCPMDRecord is a data structure representing a record in a CDC tabular data format
      used for hospital data reporting. See [documentation](/docs/cdc-covid.html) for details, and the linked CDC materials for authoritative
      definitions used as the source here.

@graph.rdfs:label: duns
@graph.name: duns
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for identifying an organization or business person.

@graph.rdfs:label: UserBlocks
@graph.name: UserBlocks
@graph.rdfs:comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

@graph.rdfs:label: trackingUrl
@graph.name: trackingUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: Tracking url for the parcel delivery.

@graph.rdfs:label: potentialAction
@graph.name: potentialAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a potential Action, which describes an idealized action in which this thing would play an 'object' role.

@graph.rdfs:label: UserReview
@graph.name: UserReview
@graph.rdfs:comment: A review created by an end-user (e.g. consumer, purchaser, attendee etc.), in contrast with [[CriticReview]].

@graph.rdfs:label: numberedPosition
@graph.name: numberedPosition
@graph.rdfs:comment: A number associated with a role in an organization, for example, the number on an athlete's jersey.

@graph.rdfs:label: followup
@graph.name: followup
@graph.rdfs:comment: Typical or recommended followup care after the procedure is performed.

@graph.rdfs:label: associatedArticle
@graph.name: associatedArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment: A NewsArticle associated with the Media Object.

@graph.rdfs:label: TVSeason
@graph.name: TVSeason
@graph.rdfs:comment: Season dedicated to TV broadcast and associated online delivery.

@graph.rdfs:label: CheckoutPage
@graph.name: CheckoutPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Web page type: Checkout page.

@graph.rdfs:label: Photograph
@graph.name: Photograph
@graph.rdfs:comment: A photograph.

@graph.rdfs:label: albumRelease
@graph.name: albumRelease
@graph.rdfs:comment: A release of this album.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationIdentifier
@graph.name: legislationIdentifier
@graph.rdfs:comment: An identifier for the legislation. This can be either a string-based identifier, like the CELEX at EU level or the NOR in France, or a web-based, URL/URI identifier, like an ELI (European Legislation Identifier) or an URN-Lex.

@graph.rdfs:label: publicAccess
@graph.name: publicAccess
@graph.rdfs:comment: A flag to signal that the [[Place]] is open to public visitors.  If this property is omitted there is no assumed default boolean value.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfItems
@graph.name: numberOfItems
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of items in an ItemList. Note that some descriptions might not fully describe all items in a list (e.g., multi-page pagination); in such cases, the numberOfItems would be for the entire list.

@graph.rdfs:label: HighSchool
@graph.name: HighSchool
@graph.rdfs:comment: A high school.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfPlayers
@graph.name: numberOfPlayers
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicate how many people can play this game (minimum, maximum, or range).

@graph.rdfs:label: WantAction
@graph.name: WantAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of expressing a desire about the object. An agent wants an object.

@graph.rdfs:label: PathologyTest
@graph.name: PathologyTest
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical test performed by a laboratory that typically involves examination of a tissue sample by a pathologist.

@graph.rdfs:label: encodesCreativeWork
@graph.name: encodesCreativeWork
@graph.rdfs:comment: The CreativeWork encoded by this media object.

@graph.rdfs:label: cookingMethod
@graph.name: cookingMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: The method of cooking, such as Frying, Steaming, ...

@graph.rdfs:label: targetName
@graph.name: targetName
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of a node in an established educational framework.

@graph.rdfs:label: learningResourceType
@graph.name: learningResourceType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The predominant type or kind characterizing the learning resource. For example, 'presentation', 'handout'.

@graph.rdfs:label: branch
@graph.name: branch
@graph.rdfs:comment: The branches that delineate from the nerve bundle. Not to be confused with [[branchOf]].

@graph.rdfs:label: startOffset
@graph.name: startOffset
@graph.rdfs:comment: The start time of the clip expressed as the number of seconds from the beginning of the work.

@graph.rdfs:label: image
@graph.name: image
@graph.rdfs:comment: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

@graph.rdfs:label: expectsAcceptanceOf
@graph.name: expectsAcceptanceOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: An Offer which must be accepted before the user can perform the Action. For example, the user may need to buy a movie before being able to watch it.

@graph.rdfs:label: ArriveAction
@graph.name: ArriveAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of arriving at a place. An agent arrives at a destination from a fromLocation, optionally with participants.

@graph.rdfs:label: SportsTeam
@graph.name: SportsTeam
@graph.rdfs:comment: Organization: Sports team.

@graph.rdfs:label: ComicSeries
@graph.name: ComicSeries
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A sequential publication of comic stories under a
    	unifying title, for example "The Amazing Spider-Man" or "Groo the
    	Wanderer".

@graph.rdfs:label: PostalCodeRangeSpecification
@graph.name: PostalCodeRangeSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a range of postal codes, usually defined as the set of valid codes between [[postalCodeBegin]] and [[postalCodeEnd]], inclusively.

@graph.rdfs:label: knowsAbout
@graph.name: knowsAbout
@graph.rdfs:comment: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a topic that is known about - suggesting possible expertise but not implying it. We do not distinguish skill levels here, or relate this to educational content, events, objectives or [[JobPosting]] descriptions.

@graph.rdfs:label: BloodTest
@graph.name: BloodTest
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical test performed on a sample of a patient's blood.

@graph.rdfs:label: Zoo
@graph.name: Zoo
@graph.rdfs:comment: A zoo.

@graph.rdfs:label: InsertAction
@graph.name: InsertAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of adding at a specific location in an ordered collection.

@graph.rdfs:label: SoftwareSourceCode
@graph.name: SoftwareSourceCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: Computer programming source code. Example: Full (compile ready) solutions, code snippet samples, scripts, templates.

@graph.rdfs:label: availableLanguage
@graph.name: availableLanguage
@graph.rdfs:comment: A language someone may use with or at the item, service or place. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[inLanguage]].

@graph.rdfs:label: AutoWash
@graph.name: AutoWash
@graph.rdfs:comment: A car wash business.

@graph.rdfs:label: returnShippingFeesAmount
@graph.name: returnShippingFeesAmount
@graph.rdfs:comment: Amount of shipping costs for product returns (for any reason). Applicable when property [[returnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationCorrects
@graph.name: legislationCorrects
@graph.rdfs:comment: Another legislation in which this one introduces textual changes, like correction of spelling mistakes, with no legal impact (for modifications that have legal impact, use legislationAmends).

@graph.rdfs:label: availableChannel
@graph.name: availableChannel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A means of accessing the service (e.g. a phone bank, a web site, a location, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: hasRepresentation
@graph.name: hasRepresentation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A common representation such as a protein sequence or chemical structure for this entity. For images use schema.org/image.

@graph.rdfs:label: ImageObjectSnapshot
@graph.name: ImageObjectSnapshot
@graph.rdfs:comment: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of an [[ImageObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata (e.g. XMP, EXIF) the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.

@graph.rdfs:label: Hackathon
@graph.name: Hackathon
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [hackathon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hackathon) event.

@graph.rdfs:label: departurePlatform
@graph.name: departurePlatform
@graph.rdfs:comment: The platform from which the train departs.

@graph.rdfs:label: CommunicateAction
@graph.name: CommunicateAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of conveying information to another person via a communication medium (instrument) such as speech, email, or telephone conversation.

@graph.rdfs:label: Answer
@graph.name: Answer
@graph.rdfs:comment: An answer offered to a question; perhaps correct, perhaps opinionated or wrong.

@graph.rdfs:label: smiles
@graph.name: smiles
@graph.rdfs:comment: A specification in form of a line notation for describing the structure of chemical species using short ASCII strings.  Double bond stereochemistry \ indicators may need to be escaped in the string in formats where the backslash is an escape character.

@graph.rdfs:label: ownedFrom
@graph.name: ownedFrom
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date and time of obtaining the product.

@graph.rdfs:label: query
@graph.name: query
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of instrument. The query used on this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: temporal
@graph.name: temporal
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The "temporal" property can be used in cases where more specific properties
(e.g. [[temporalCoverage]], [[dateCreated]], [[dateModified]], [[datePublished]]) are not known to be appropriate.

@graph.rdfs:label: valueAddedTaxIncluded
@graph.name: valueAddedTaxIncluded
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies whether the applicable value-added tax (VAT) is included in the price specification or not.

@graph.rdfs:label: DigitalPlatformEnumeration
@graph.name: DigitalPlatformEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates some common technology platforms, for use with properties such as [[actionPlatform]]. It is not supposed to be comprehensive - when a suitable code is not enumerated here, textual or URL values can be used instead. These codes are at a fairly high level and do not deal with versioning and other nuance. Additional codes can be suggested [in github](https://github.com/schemaorg/schemaorg/issues/3057).

@graph.rdfs:label: includesAttraction
@graph.name: includesAttraction
@graph.rdfs:comment: Attraction located at destination.

@graph.rdfs:label: stepValue
@graph.name: stepValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The stepValue attribute indicates the granularity that is expected (and required) of the value in a PropertyValueSpecification.

@graph.rdfs:label: orderItemStatus
@graph.name: orderItemStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The current status of the order item.

@graph.rdfs:label: seatRow
@graph.name: seatRow
@graph.rdfs:comment: The row location of the reserved seat (e.g., B).

@graph.rdfs:label: JewelryStore
@graph.name: JewelryStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A jewelry store.

@graph.rdfs:label: target
@graph.name: target
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a target EntryPoint, or url, for an Action.

@graph.rdfs:label: medicalAudience
@graph.name: medicalAudience
@graph.rdfs:comment: Medical audience for page.

@graph.rdfs:label: OnDemandEvent
@graph.name: OnDemandEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: A publication event, e.g. catch-up TV or radio podcast, during which a program is available on-demand.

@graph.rdfs:label: HinduTemple
@graph.name: HinduTemple
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Hindu temple.

@graph.rdfs:label: arrivalBoatTerminal
@graph.name: arrivalBoatTerminal
@graph.rdfs:comment: The terminal or port from which the boat arrives.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalGuideline
@graph.name: MedicalGuideline
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any recommendation made by a standard society (e.g. ACC/AHA) or consensus statement that denotes how to diagnose and treat a particular condition. Note: this type should be used to tag the actual guideline recommendation; if the guideline recommendation occurs in a larger scholarly article, use MedicalScholarlyArticle to tag the overall article, not this type. Note also: the organization making the recommendation should be captured in the recognizingAuthority base property of MedicalEntity.

@graph.rdfs:label: menuAddOn
@graph.name: menuAddOn
@graph.rdfs:comment: Additional menu item(s) such as a side dish of salad or side order of fries that can be added to this menu item. Additionally it can be a menu section containing allowed add-on menu items for this menu item.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasBroadcastChannel
@graph.name: hasBroadcastChannel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A broadcast channel of a broadcast service.

@graph.rdfs:label: Corporation
@graph.name: Corporation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Organization: A business corporation.

@graph.rdfs:label: dateCreated
@graph.name: dateCreated
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date on which the CreativeWork was created or the item was added to a DataFeed.

@graph.rdfs:label: contentSize
@graph.name: contentSize
@graph.rdfs:comment: File size in (mega/kilo)bytes.

@graph.rdfs:label: icaoCode
@graph.name: icaoCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: ICAO identifier for an airport.

@graph.rdfs:label: uploadDate
@graph.name: uploadDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date (including time if available) when this media object was uploaded to this site.

@graph.rdfs:label: Product
@graph.name: Product
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any offered product or service. For example: a pair of shoes; a concert ticket; the rental of a car; a haircut; or an episode of a TV show streamed online.

@graph.rdfs:label: speed
@graph.name: speed
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The speed range of the vehicle. If the vehicle is powered by an engine, the upper limit of the speed range (indicated by [[maxValue]]) should be the maximum speed achievable under regular conditions.

Typical unit code(s): KMH for km/h, HM for mile per hour (0.447 04 m/s), KNT for knot

*Note 1: Use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate the range. Typically, the minimal value is zero.
* Note 2: There are many different ways of measuring the speed range. You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.

@graph.rdfs:label: BowlingAlley
@graph.name: BowlingAlley
@graph.rdfs:comment: A bowling alley.

@graph.rdfs:label: warrantyPromise
@graph.name: warrantyPromise
@graph.rdfs:comment: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: contactPoints
@graph.name: contactPoints
@graph.rdfs:comment: A contact point for a person or organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: TheaterEvent
@graph.name: TheaterEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Theater performance.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalSign
@graph.name: MedicalSign
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any physical manifestation of a person's medical condition discoverable by objective diagnostic tests or physical examination.

@graph.rdfs:label: permittedUsage
@graph.name: permittedUsage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indications regarding the permitted usage of the accommodation.

@graph.rdfs:label: Hospital
@graph.name: Hospital
@graph.rdfs:comment: A hospital.

@graph.rdfs:label: phoneticText
@graph.name: phoneticText
@graph.rdfs:comment: Representation of a text [[textValue]] using the specified [[speechToTextMarkup]]. For example the city name of Houston in IPA: /ˈhjuːstən/.

@graph.rdfs:label: InternetCafe
@graph.name: InternetCafe
@graph.rdfs:comment: An internet cafe.

@graph.rdfs:label: memoryRequirements
@graph.name: memoryRequirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: Minimum memory requirements.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationEnsuresImplementationOf
@graph.name: legislationEnsuresImplementationOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates that this Legislation ensures the implementation of another Legislation, for example by modifying national legislations so that they do not contradict to an EU regulation or decision. This implies a legal meaning. Transpositions of EU Directive should be captured with legislationTransposes.

@graph.rdfs:label: Residence
@graph.name: Residence
@graph.rdfs:comment: The place where a person lives.

@graph.rdfs:label: adverseOutcome
@graph.name: adverseOutcome
@graph.rdfs:comment: A possible complication and/or side effect of this therapy. If it is known that an adverse outcome is serious (resulting in death, disability, or permanent damage; requiring hospitalization; or otherwise life-threatening or requiring immediate medical attention), tag it as a seriousAdverseOutcome instead.

@graph.rdfs:label: discussionUrl
@graph.name: discussionUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: A link to the page containing the comments of the CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: cutoffTime
@graph.name: cutoffTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: Order cutoff time allows merchants to describe the time after which they will no longer process orders received on that day. For orders processed after cutoff time, one day gets added to the delivery time estimate. This property is expected to be most typically used via the [[ShippingRateSettings]] publication pattern. The time is indicated using the ISO-8601 Time format, e.g. "23:30:00-05:00" would represent 6:30 pm Eastern Standard Time (EST) which is 5 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

@graph.rdfs:label: closes
@graph.name: closes
@graph.rdfs:comment: The closing hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

@graph.rdfs:label: borrower
@graph.name: borrower
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of participant. The person that borrows the object being lent.

@graph.rdfs:label: Trip
@graph.name: Trip
@graph.rdfs:comment: A trip or journey. An itinerary of visits to one or more places.

@graph.rdfs:label: PerformingArtsEvent
@graph.name: PerformingArtsEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Live performance Event of the performing arts (music, theatre, dance, acrobatics, spoken word), including performance art and performative sports (e.g. choreographed forms of martial arts, figure skating, competitive ballroom dancing).

Note: Use additionalType to differentiate between productions / shows (PerformanceWork, EventSeries), tours (EventSeries), and individual performances.

@graph.rdfs:label: recipeInstructions
@graph.name: recipeInstructions
@graph.rdfs:comment: A step in making the recipe, in the form of a single item (document, video, etc.) or an ordered list with HowToStep and/or HowToSection items.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumTotBeds
@graph.name: cvdNumTotBeds
@graph.rdfs:comment: numtotbeds - ALL HOSPITAL BEDS: Total number of all inpatient and outpatient beds, including all staffed, ICU, licensed, and overflow (surge) beds used for inpatients or outpatients.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasMolecularFunction
@graph.name: hasMolecularFunction
@graph.rdfs:comment: Molecular function performed by this BioChemEntity; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

@graph.rdfs:label: Mountain
@graph.name: Mountain
@graph.rdfs:comment: A mountain, like Mount Whitney or Mount Everest.

@graph.rdfs:label: originatesFrom
@graph.name: originatesFrom
@graph.rdfs:comment: The vasculature the lymphatic structure originates, or afferents, from.

@graph.rdfs:label: DrinkAction
@graph.name: DrinkAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of swallowing liquids.

@graph.rdfs:label: availableService
@graph.name: availableService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical service available from this provider.

@graph.rdfs:label: originalMediaLink
@graph.name: originalMediaLink
@graph.rdfs:comment: Link to the page containing an original version of the content, or directly to an online copy of the original [[MediaObject]] content, e.g. video file.

@graph.rdfs:label: typicalAgeRange
@graph.name: typicalAgeRange
@graph.rdfs:comment: The typical expected age range, e.g. '7-9', '11-'.

@graph.rdfs:label: requirements
@graph.name: requirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: Component dependency requirements for application. This includes runtime environments and shared libraries that are not included in the application distribution package, but required to run the application (examples: DirectX, Java or .NET runtime).

@graph.rdfs:label: BusinessEvent
@graph.name: BusinessEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Business event.

@graph.rdfs:label: contentRating
@graph.name: contentRating
@graph.rdfs:comment: Official rating of a piece of content—for example, 'MPAA PG-13'.

@graph.rdfs:label: boardingPolicy
@graph.name: boardingPolicy
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of boarding policy used by the airline (e.g. zone-based or group-based).

@graph.rdfs:label: accountId
@graph.name: accountId
@graph.rdfs:comment: The identifier for the account the payment will be applied to.

@graph.rdfs:label: RiverBodyOfWater
@graph.name: RiverBodyOfWater
@graph.rdfs:comment: A river (for example, the broad majestic Shannon).

@graph.rdfs:label: hasMenuSection
@graph.name: hasMenuSection
@graph.rdfs:comment: A subgrouping of the menu (by dishes, course, serving time period, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: arrivalGate
@graph.name: arrivalGate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifier of the flight's arrival gate.

@graph.rdfs:label: LegislationObject
@graph.name: LegislationObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: A specific object or file containing a Legislation. Note that the same Legislation can be published in multiple files. For example, a digitally signed PDF, a plain PDF and an HTML version.

@graph.rdfs:label: LegislativeBuilding
@graph.name: LegislativeBuilding
@graph.rdfs:comment: A legislative building—for example, the state capitol.

@graph.rdfs:label: funder
@graph.name: funder
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person or organization that supports (sponsors) something through some kind of financial contribution.

@graph.rdfs:label: callSign
@graph.name: callSign
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [callsign](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Call_sign), as used in broadcasting and radio communications to identify people, radio and TV stations, or vehicles.

@graph.rdfs:label: UserPageVisits
@graph.name: UserPageVisits
@graph.rdfs:comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

@graph.rdfs:label: claimInterpreter
@graph.name: claimInterpreter
@graph.rdfs:comment: For a [[Claim]] interpreted from [[MediaObject]] content, the [[interpretedAsClaim]] property can be used to indicate a claim contained, implied or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]].

@graph.rdfs:label: ReservationPackage
@graph.name: ReservationPackage
@graph.rdfs:comment: A group of multiple reservations with common values for all sub-reservations.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasShippingService
@graph.name: hasShippingService
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specification of a shipping service offered by the organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: structuralClass
@graph.name: structuralClass
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name given to how bone physically connects to each other.

@graph.rdfs:label: programType
@graph.name: programType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of educational or occupational program. For example, classroom, internship, alternance, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: observationPeriod
@graph.name: observationPeriod
@graph.rdfs:comment: The length of time an Observation took place over. The format follows `P[0-9]*[Y|M|D|h|m|s]`. For example, P1Y is Period 1 Year, P3M is Period 3 Months, P3h is Period 3 hours.

@graph.rdfs:label: BedAndBreakfast
@graph.name: BedAndBreakfast
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Bed and breakfast.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

@graph.rdfs:label: branchOf
@graph.name: branchOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: The larger organization that this local business is a branch of, if any. Not to be confused with (anatomical) [[branch]].

@graph.rdfs:label: LeaveAction
@graph.name: LeaveAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An agent leaves an event / group with participants/friends at a location.

Related actions:

* [[JoinAction]]: The antonym of LeaveAction.
* [[UnRegisterAction]]: Unlike UnRegisterAction, LeaveAction implies leaving a group/team of people rather than a service.

@graph.rdfs:label: workExample
@graph.name: workExample
@graph.rdfs:comment: Example/instance/realization/derivation of the concept of this creative work. E.g. the paperback edition, first edition, or e-book.

@graph.rdfs:label: postalCodePrefix
@graph.name: postalCodePrefix
@graph.rdfs:comment: A defined range of postal codes indicated by a common textual prefix. Used for non-numeric systems such as UK.

@graph.rdfs:label: costCurrency
@graph.name: costCurrency
@graph.rdfs:comment: The currency (in 3-letter) of the drug cost. See: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217.

@graph.rdfs:label: author
@graph.name: author
@graph.rdfs:comment: The author of this content or rating. Please note that author is special in that HTML 5 provides a special mechanism for indicating authorship via the rel tag. That is equivalent to this and may be used interchangeably.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfForwardGears
@graph.name: numberOfForwardGears
@graph.rdfs:comment: The total number of forward gears available for the transmission system of the vehicle.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

@graph.rdfs:label: Statement
@graph.name: Statement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A statement about something, for example a fun or interesting fact. If known, the main entity this statement is about can be indicated using mainEntity. For more formal claims (e.g. in Fact Checking), consider using [[Claim]] instead. Use the [[text]] property to capture the text of the statement.

@graph.rdfs:label: license
@graph.name: license
@graph.rdfs:comment: A license document that applies to this content, typically indicated by URL.

@graph.rdfs:label: loanType
@graph.name: loanType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of a loan or credit.

@graph.rdfs:label: possibleComplication
@graph.name: possibleComplication
@graph.rdfs:comment: A possible unexpected and unfavorable evolution of a medical condition. Complications may include worsening of the signs or symptoms of the disease, extension of the condition to other organ systems, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: additionalName
@graph.name: additionalName
@graph.rdfs:comment: An additional name for a Person, can be used for a middle name.

@graph.rdfs:label: educationalRole
@graph.name: educationalRole
@graph.rdfs:comment: An educationalRole of an EducationalAudience.

@graph.rdfs:label: conditionsOfAccess
@graph.name: conditionsOfAccess
@graph.rdfs:comment: Conditions that affect the availability of, or method(s) of access to, an item. Typically used for real world items such as an [[ArchiveComponent]] held by an [[ArchiveOrganization]]. This property is not suitable for use as a general Web access control mechanism. It is expressed only in natural language.\n\nFor example "Available by appointment from the Reading Room" or "Accessible only from logged-in accounts ".

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalEnumeration
@graph.name: MedicalEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerations related to health and the practice of medicine: A concept that is used to attribute a quality to another concept, as a qualifier, a collection of items or a listing of all of the elements of a set in medicine practice.

@graph.rdfs:label: FundingScheme
@graph.name: FundingScheme
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A FundingScheme combines organizational, project and policy aspects of grant-based funding
    that sets guidelines, principles and mechanisms to support other kinds of projects and activities.
    Funding is typically organized via [[Grant]] funding. Examples of funding schemes: Swiss Priority Programmes (SPPs); EU Framework 7 (FP7); Horizon 2020; the NIH-R01 Grant Program; Wellcome institutional strategic support fund. For large scale public sector funding, the management and administration of grant awards is often handled by other, dedicated, organizations - [[FundingAgency]]s such as ERC, REA, ...

@graph.rdfs:label: CreativeWorkSeason
@graph.name: CreativeWorkSeason
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media season, e.g. TV, radio, video game etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: isSimilarTo
@graph.name: isSimilarTo
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pointer to another, functionally similar product (or multiple products).

@graph.rdfs:label: Sculpture
@graph.name: Sculpture
@graph.rdfs:comment: A piece of sculpture.

@graph.rdfs:label: exerciseRelatedDiet
@graph.name: exerciseRelatedDiet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: currenciesAccepted
@graph.name: currenciesAccepted
@graph.rdfs:comment: The currency accepted.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

@graph.rdfs:label: LiquorStore
@graph.name: LiquorStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A shop that sells alcoholic drinks such as wine, beer, whisky and other spirits.

@graph.rdfs:label: childMaxAge
@graph.name: childMaxAge
@graph.rdfs:comment: Maximal age of the child.

@graph.rdfs:label: providerMobility
@graph.name: providerMobility
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the mobility of a provided service (e.g. 'static', 'dynamic').

@graph.rdfs:label: timeToComplete
@graph.name: timeToComplete
@graph.rdfs:comment: The expected length of time to complete the program if attending full-time.

@graph.rdfs:label: PresentationDigitalDocument
@graph.name: PresentationDigitalDocument
@graph.rdfs:comment: A file containing slides or used for a presentation.

@graph.rdfs:label: earlyPrepaymentPenalty
@graph.name: earlyPrepaymentPenalty
@graph.rdfs:comment: The amount to be paid as a penalty in the event of early payment of the loan.

@graph.rdfs:label: requiredMaxAge
@graph.name: requiredMaxAge
@graph.rdfs:comment: Audiences defined by a person's maximum age.

@graph.rdfs:label: Invoice
@graph.name: Invoice
@graph.rdfs:comment: A statement of the money due for goods or services; a bill.

@graph.rdfs:label: accountMinimumInflow
@graph.name: accountMinimumInflow
@graph.rdfs:comment: A minimum amount that has to be paid in every month.

@graph.rdfs:label: lender
@graph.name: lender
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of participant. The person that lends the object being borrowed.

@graph.rdfs:label: validForMemberTier
@graph.name: validForMemberTier
@graph.rdfs:comment: The membership program tier(s) an Offer (or a PriceSpecification, OfferShippingDetails, or MerchantReturnPolicy under an Offer) is valid for.

@graph.rdfs:label: PreventionIndication
@graph.name: PreventionIndication
@graph.rdfs:comment: An indication for preventing an underlying condition, symptom, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: DrugCost
@graph.name: DrugCost
@graph.rdfs:comment: The cost per unit of a medical drug. Note that this type is not meant to represent the price in an offer of a drug for sale; see the Offer type for that. This type will typically be used to tag wholesale or average retail cost of a drug, or maximum reimbursable cost. Costs of medical drugs vary widely depending on how and where they are paid for, so while this type captures some of the variables, costs should be used with caution by consumers of this schema's markup.

@graph.rdfs:label: handlingTime
@graph.name: handlingTime
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup.

In the context of [[ShippingDeliveryTime]], Typical properties: minValue, maxValue, unitCode (d for DAY).  This is by common convention assumed to mean business days (if a unitCode is used, coded as "d"), i.e. only counting days when the business normally operates.

In the context of [[ShippingService]], use the [[ServicePeriod]] format, that contains the same information in a structured form, with cut-off time, business days and duration.

@graph.rdfs:label: PublicSwimmingPool
@graph.name: PublicSwimmingPool
@graph.rdfs:comment: A public swimming pool.

@graph.rdfs:label: AppendAction
@graph.name: AppendAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of inserting at the end if an ordered collection.

@graph.rdfs:label: SpeakableSpecification
@graph.name: SpeakableSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A SpeakableSpecification indicates (typically via [[xpath]] or [[cssSelector]]) sections of a document that are highlighted as particularly [[speakable]]. Instances of this type are expected to be used primarily as values of the [[speakable]] property.

@graph.rdfs:label: beneficiaryBank
@graph.name: beneficiaryBank
@graph.rdfs:comment: A bank or bank’s branch, financial institution or international financial institution operating the beneficiary’s bank account or releasing funds for the beneficiary.

@graph.rdfs:label: paymentAccepted
@graph.name: paymentAccepted
@graph.rdfs:comment: Cash, Credit Card, Cryptocurrency, Local Exchange Tradings System, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: SearchResultsPage
@graph.name: SearchResultsPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Web page type: Search results page.

@graph.rdfs:label: ServiceChannel
@graph.name: ServiceChannel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A means for accessing a service, e.g. a government office location, web site, or phone number.

@graph.rdfs:label: shippingDetails
@graph.name: shippingDetails
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates information about the shipping policies and options associated with an [[Offer]].

@graph.rdfs:label: timeRequired
@graph.name: timeRequired
@graph.rdfs:comment: Approximate or typical time it usually takes to work with or through the content of this work for the typical or target audience.

@graph.rdfs:label: Distillery
@graph.name: Distillery
@graph.rdfs:comment: A distillery.

@graph.rdfs:label: PhysicalActivityCategory
@graph.name: PhysicalActivityCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Categories of physical activity, organized by physiologic classification.

@graph.rdfs:label: naics
@graph.name: naics
@graph.rdfs:comment: The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for a particular organization or business person.

@graph.rdfs:label: productGroupID
@graph.name: productGroupID
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a textual identifier for a ProductGroup.

@graph.rdfs:label: reviewAspect
@graph.name: reviewAspect
@graph.rdfs:comment: This Review or Rating is relevant to this part or facet of the itemReviewed.

@graph.rdfs:label: Map
@graph.name: Map
@graph.rdfs:comment: A map.

@graph.rdfs:label: jobBenefits
@graph.name: jobBenefits
@graph.rdfs:comment: Description of benefits associated with the job.

@graph.rdfs:label: branchCode
@graph.name: branchCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short textual code (also called "store code") that uniquely identifies a place of business. The code is typically assigned by the parentOrganization and used in structured URLs.\n\nFor example, in the URL http://www.starbucks.co.uk/store-locator/etc/detail/3047 the code "3047" is a branchCode for a particular branch.

@graph.rdfs:label: Taxon
@graph.name: Taxon
@graph.rdfs:comment: A set of organisms asserted to represent a natural cohesive biological unit.

@graph.rdfs:label: TelevisionChannel
@graph.name: TelevisionChannel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A unique instance of a television BroadcastService on a CableOrSatelliteService lineup.

@graph.rdfs:label: MotorcycleRepair
@graph.name: MotorcycleRepair
@graph.rdfs:comment: A motorcycle repair shop.

@graph.rdfs:label: MeasurementTypeEnumeration
@graph.name: MeasurementTypeEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumeration of common measurement types (or dimensions), for example "chest" for a person, "inseam" for pants, "gauge" for screws, or "wheel" for bicycles.

@graph.rdfs:label: GovernmentBuilding
@graph.name: GovernmentBuilding
@graph.rdfs:comment: A government building.

@graph.rdfs:label: musicArrangement
@graph.name: musicArrangement
@graph.rdfs:comment: An arrangement derived from the composition.

@graph.rdfs:label: returnPolicySeasonalOverride
@graph.name: returnPolicySeasonalOverride
@graph.rdfs:comment: Seasonal override of a return policy.

@graph.rdfs:label: addOn
@graph.name: addOn
@graph.rdfs:comment: An additional offer that can only be obtained in combination with the first base offer (e.g. supplements and extensions that are available for a surcharge).

@graph.rdfs:label: usedToDiagnose
@graph.name: usedToDiagnose
@graph.rdfs:comment: A condition the test is used to diagnose.

@graph.rdfs:label: imagingTechnique
@graph.name: imagingTechnique
@graph.rdfs:comment: Imaging technique used.

@graph.rdfs:label: returnFees
@graph.name: returnFees
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of return fees for purchased products (for any return reason).

@graph.rdfs:label: deathPlace
@graph.name: deathPlace
@graph.rdfs:comment: The place where the person died.

@graph.rdfs:label: siblings
@graph.name: siblings
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sibling of the person.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfAirbags
@graph.name: numberOfAirbags
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number or type of airbags in the vehicle.

@graph.rdfs:label: serviceSmsNumber
@graph.name: serviceSmsNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number to access the service by text message.

@graph.rdfs:label: naturalProgression
@graph.name: naturalProgression
@graph.rdfs:comment: The expected progression of the condition if it is not treated and allowed to progress naturally.

@graph.rdfs:label: articleBody
@graph.name: articleBody
@graph.rdfs:comment: The actual body of the article.

@graph.rdfs:label: populationType
@graph.name: populationType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the populationType common to all members of a [[StatisticalPopulation]] or all cases within the scope of a [[StatisticalVariable]].

@graph.rdfs:label: QuantitativeValue
@graph.name: QuantitativeValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: A point value or interval for product characteristics and other purposes.

@graph.rdfs:label: WebPage
@graph.name: WebPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: A web page. Every web page is implicitly assumed to be declared to be of type WebPage, so the various properties about that webpage, such as breadcrumb may be used. We recommend explicit declaration if these properties are specified, but if they are found outside of an itemscope, they will be assumed to be about the page.

@graph.rdfs:label: Error
@graph.name: Error
@graph.rdfs:comment: Representation of an Error.

@graph.rdfs:label: dateModified
@graph.name: dateModified
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified or when the item's entry was modified within a DataFeed.

@graph.rdfs:label: artMedium
@graph.name: artMedium
@graph.rdfs:comment: The material used. (E.g. Oil, Watercolour, Acrylic, Linoprint, Marble, Cyanotype, Digital, Lithograph, DryPoint, Intaglio, Pastel, Woodcut, Pencil, Mixed Media, etc.)

@graph.rdfs:label: purchaseType
@graph.name: purchaseType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Optional. The type of purchase the consumer must make in order to qualify for this incentive.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalDevice
@graph.name: MedicalDevice
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any object used in a medical capacity, such as to diagnose or treat a patient.

@graph.rdfs:label: acceptedOffer
@graph.name: acceptedOffer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The offer(s) -- e.g., product, quantity and price combinations -- included in the order.

@graph.rdfs:label: interestRate
@graph.name: interestRate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The interest rate, charged or paid, applicable to the financial product. Note: This is different from the calculated annualPercentageRate.

@graph.rdfs:label: gameLocation
@graph.name: gameLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Real or fictional location of the game (or part of game).

@graph.rdfs:label: recipeCategory
@graph.name: recipeCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: The category of the recipe—for example, appetizer, entree, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: arrivalTerminal
@graph.name: arrivalTerminal
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifier of the flight's arrival terminal.

@graph.rdfs:label: DrugClass
@graph.name: DrugClass
@graph.rdfs:comment: A class of medical drugs, e.g., statins. Classes can represent general pharmacological class, common mechanisms of action, common physiological effects, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: eligibleDuration
@graph.name: eligibleDuration
@graph.rdfs:comment: The duration for which the given offer is valid.

@graph.rdfs:label: grantee
@graph.name: grantee
@graph.rdfs:comment: The person, organization, contact point, or audience that has been granted this permission.

@graph.rdfs:label: costCategory
@graph.name: costCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: The category of cost, such as wholesale, retail, reimbursement cap, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: iso6523Code
@graph.name: iso6523Code
@graph.rdfs:comment: An organization identifier as defined in [ISO 6523(-1)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO/IEC_6523). The identifier should be in the `XXXX:YYYYYY:ZZZ` or `XXXX:YYYYYY`format. Where `XXXX` is a 4 digit _ICD_ (International Code Designator), `YYYYYY` is an _OID_ (Organization Identifier) with all formatting characters (dots, dashes, spaces) removed with a maximal length of 35 characters, and `ZZZ` is an optional OPI (Organization Part Identifier) with a maximum length of 35 characters. The various components (ICD, OID, OPI) are joined with a colon character (ASCII `0x3a`). Note that many existing organization identifiers defined as attributes like [leiCode](https://schema.org/leiCode) (`0199`), [duns](https://schema.org/duns) (`0060`) or [GLN](https://schema.org/globalLocationNumber) (`0088`) can be expressed using ISO-6523. If possible, ISO-6523 codes should be preferred to populating [vatID](https://schema.org/vatID) or [taxID](https://schema.org/taxID), as ISO identifiers are less ambiguous.

@graph.rdfs:label: Class
@graph.name: Class
@graph.rdfs:comment: A class, also often called a 'Type'; equivalent to rdfs:Class.

@graph.rdfs:label: HowToTip
@graph.name: HowToTip
@graph.rdfs:comment: An explanation in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It provides supplementary information about a technique, supply, author's preference, etc. It can explain what could be done, or what should not be done, but doesn't specify what should be done (see HowToDirection).

@graph.rdfs:label: domainIncludes
@graph.name: domainIncludes
@graph.rdfs:comment: Relates a property to a class that is (one of) the type(s) the property is expected to be used on.

@graph.rdfs:label: roofLoad
@graph.name: roofLoad
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The permitted total weight of cargo and installations (e.g. a roof rack) on top of the vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]]
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

@graph.rdfs:label: isGift
@graph.name: isGift
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether the offer was accepted as a gift for someone other than the buyer.

@graph.rdfs:label: announcementLocation
@graph.name: announcementLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a specific [[CivicStructure]] or [[LocalBusiness]] associated with the SpecialAnnouncement. For example, a specific testing facility or business with special opening hours. For a larger geographic region like a quarantine of an entire region, use [[spatialCoverage]].

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationLegalValue
@graph.name: legislationLegalValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The legal value of this legislation file. The same legislation can be written in multiple files with different legal values. Typically a digitally signed PDF have a "stronger" legal value than the HTML file of the same act.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastAffiliateOf
@graph.name: broadcastAffiliateOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: The media network(s) whose content is broadcast on this station.

@graph.rdfs:label: applicationStartDate
@graph.name: applicationStartDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date at which the program begins collecting applications for the next enrollment cycle.

@graph.rdfs:label: codeValue
@graph.name: codeValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short textual code that uniquely identifies the value.

@graph.rdfs:label: energyEfficiencyScaleMin
@graph.name: energyEfficiencyScaleMin
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies the least energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

@graph.rdfs:label: sibling
@graph.name: sibling
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sibling of the person.

@graph.rdfs:label: CorrectionComment
@graph.name: CorrectionComment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[comment]] that corrects [[CreativeWork]].

@graph.rdfs:label: hasTierRequirement
@graph.name: hasTierRequirement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A requirement for a user to join a membership tier, for example: a CreditCard if the tier requires sign up for a credit card, A UnitPriceSpecification if the user is required to pay a (periodic) fee, or a MonetaryAmount if the user needs to spend a minimum amount to join the tier. If a tier is free to join then this property does not need to be specified.

@graph.rdfs:label: Brewery
@graph.name: Brewery
@graph.rdfs:comment: Brewery.

@graph.rdfs:label: IncentiveStatus
@graph.name: IncentiveStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates a status for an incentive, such as whether it is active.

@graph.rdfs:label: creator
@graph.name: creator
@graph.rdfs:comment: The creator/author of this CreativeWork. This is the same as the Author property for CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: AutomatedTeller
@graph.name: AutomatedTeller
@graph.rdfs:comment: ATM/cash machine.

@graph.rdfs:label: OutletStore
@graph.name: OutletStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: An outlet store.

@graph.rdfs:label: TennisComplex
@graph.name: TennisComplex
@graph.rdfs:comment: A tennis complex.

@graph.rdfs:label: MediaReview
@graph.name: MediaReview
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A [[MediaReview]] is a more specialized form of Review dedicated to the evaluation of media content online, typically in the context of fact-checking and misinformation.
    For more general reviews of media in the broader sense, use [[UserReview]], [[CriticReview]] or other [[Review]] types. This definition is
    a work in progress. While the [[MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration]] list reflects significant community review amongst fact-checkers and others working
    to combat misinformation, the specific structures for representing media objects, their versions and publication context, are still evolving. Similarly, best practices for the relationship between [[MediaReview]] and [[ClaimReview]] markup have not yet been finalized.

@graph.rdfs:label: strengthValue
@graph.name: strengthValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The value of an active ingredient's strength, e.g. 325.

@graph.rdfs:label: Dentist
@graph.name: Dentist
@graph.rdfs:comment: A dentist.

@graph.rdfs:label: fuelEfficiency
@graph.name: fuelEfficiency
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The distance traveled per unit of fuel used; most commonly miles per gallon (mpg) or kilometers per liter (km/L).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for miles per gallon or kilometers per liter. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. mpg or km/L.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel economy to another value.

@graph.rdfs:label: expectedArrivalFrom
@graph.name: expectedArrivalFrom
@graph.rdfs:comment: The earliest date the package may arrive.

@graph.rdfs:label: CollectionPage
@graph.name: CollectionPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Web page type: Collection page.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalRiskFactor
@graph.name: MedicalRiskFactor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A risk factor is anything that increases a person's likelihood of developing or contracting a disease, medical condition, or complication.

@graph.rdfs:label: softwareRequirements
@graph.name: softwareRequirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: Component dependency requirements for application. This includes runtime environments and shared libraries that are not included in the application distribution package, but required to run the application (examples: DirectX, Java or .NET runtime).

@graph.rdfs:label: honorificSuffix
@graph.name: honorificSuffix
@graph.rdfs:comment: An honorific suffix following a Person's name such as M.D./PhD/MSCSW.

@graph.rdfs:label: episodeNumber
@graph.name: episodeNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: Position of the episode within an ordered group of episodes.

@graph.rdfs:label: address
@graph.name: address
@graph.rdfs:comment: Physical address of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: AllocateAction
@graph.name: AllocateAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of organizing tasks/objects/events by associating resources to it.

@graph.rdfs:label: Store
@graph.name: Store
@graph.rdfs:comment: A retail good store.

@graph.rdfs:label: publishedOn
@graph.name: publishedOn
@graph.rdfs:comment: A broadcast service associated with the publication event.

@graph.rdfs:label: inChI
@graph.name: inChI
@graph.rdfs:comment: Non-proprietary identifier for molecular entity that can be used in printed and electronic data sources thus enabling easier linking of diverse data compilations.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalAudience
@graph.name: MedicalAudience
@graph.rdfs:comment: Target audiences for medical web pages.

@graph.rdfs:label: sportsTeam
@graph.name: sportsTeam
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of participant. The sports team that participated on this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: NightClub
@graph.name: NightClub
@graph.rdfs:comment: A nightclub or discotheque.

@graph.rdfs:label: category
@graph.name: category
@graph.rdfs:comment: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasHealthAspect
@graph.name: hasHealthAspect
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the aspect or aspects specifically addressed in some [[HealthTopicContent]]. For example, that the content is an overview, or that it talks about treatment, self-care, treatments or their side-effects.

@graph.rdfs:label: legalRepresentative
@graph.name: legalRepresentative
@graph.rdfs:comment: One or multiple persons who represent this organization legally such as CEO or sole administrator.

@graph.rdfs:label: vehicleInteriorColor
@graph.name: vehicleInteriorColor
@graph.rdfs:comment: The color or color combination of the interior of the vehicle.

@graph.rdfs:label: educationalFramework
@graph.name: educationalFramework
@graph.rdfs:comment: The framework to which the resource being described is aligned.

@graph.rdfs:label: WearableSizeGroupEnumeration
@graph.name: WearableSizeGroupEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates common size groups (also known as "size types") for wearable products.

@graph.rdfs:label: totalPaymentDue
@graph.name: totalPaymentDue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The total amount due.

@graph.rdfs:label: acrissCode
@graph.name: acrissCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: The ACRISS Car Classification Code is a code used by many car rental companies, for classifying vehicles. ACRISS stands for Association of Car Rental Industry Systems and Standards.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationAmends
@graph.name: legislationAmends
@graph.rdfs:comment: Another legislation that this legislation amends, introducing legal changes.

@graph.rdfs:label: securityClearanceRequirement
@graph.name: securityClearanceRequirement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of any security clearance requirements of the job.

@graph.rdfs:label: associatedMedia
@graph.name: associatedMedia
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for encoding.

@graph.rdfs:label: energyEfficiencyScaleMax
@graph.name: energyEfficiencyScaleMax
