@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies the most energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

@graph.rdfs:label: FollowAction
@graph.name: FollowAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of forming a personal connection with someone/something (object) unidirectionally/asymmetrically to get updates polled from.

Related actions:

* [[BefriendAction]]: Unlike BefriendAction, FollowAction implies that the connection is *not* necessarily reciprocal.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, FollowAction implies that the follower acts as an active agent constantly/actively polling for updates.
* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, FollowAction implies that the agent is interested in continuing receiving updates from the object.
* [[JoinAction]]: Unlike JoinAction, FollowAction implies that the agent is interested in getting updates from the object.
* [[TrackAction]]: Unlike TrackAction, FollowAction refers to the polling of updates of all aspects of animate objects rather than the location of inanimate objects (e.g. you track a package, but you don't follow it).

@graph.rdfs:label: Room
@graph.name: Room
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A room is a distinguishable space within a structure, usually separated from other spaces by interior walls (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Room).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

@graph.rdfs:label: ShippingDeliveryTime
@graph.name: ShippingDeliveryTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: ShippingDeliveryTime provides various pieces of information about delivery times for shipping.

@graph.rdfs:label: PublicToilet
@graph.name: PublicToilet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A public toilet is a room or small building containing one or more toilets (and possibly also urinals) which is available for use by the general public, or by customers or employees of certain businesses.

@graph.rdfs:label: loanTerm
@graph.name: loanTerm
@graph.rdfs:comment: The duration of the loan or credit agreement.

@graph.rdfs:label: recordedAt
@graph.name: recordedAt
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Event where the CreativeWork was recorded. The CreativeWork may capture all or part of the event.

@graph.rdfs:label: knownVehicleDamages
@graph.name: knownVehicleDamages
@graph.rdfs:comment: A textual description of known damages, both repaired and unrepaired.

@graph.rdfs:label: vehicleSpecialUsage
@graph.name: vehicleSpecialUsage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether the vehicle has been used for special purposes, like commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi. The legislation in many countries requires this information to be revealed when offering a car for sale.

@graph.rdfs:label: DatedMoneySpecification
@graph.name: DatedMoneySpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A DatedMoneySpecification represents monetary values with optional start and end dates. For example, this could represent an employee's salary over a specific period of time. __Note:__ This type has been superseded by [[MonetaryAmount]], use of that type is recommended.

@graph.rdfs:label: VideoGame
@graph.name: VideoGame
@graph.rdfs:comment: A video game is an electronic game that involves human interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device.

@graph.rdfs:label: logo
@graph.name: logo
@graph.rdfs:comment: An associated logo.

@graph.rdfs:label: sportsActivityLocation
@graph.name: sportsActivityLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of location. The sports activity location where this action occurred.

@graph.rdfs:label: ScreeningEvent
@graph.name: ScreeningEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: A screening of a movie or other video.

@graph.rdfs:label: playMode
@graph.name: playMode
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether this game is multi-player, co-op or single-player.  The game can be marked as multi-player, co-op and single-player at the same time.

@graph.rdfs:label: paymentMethodId
@graph.name: paymentMethodId
@graph.rdfs:comment: An identifier for the method of payment used (e.g. the last 4 digits of the credit card).

@graph.rdfs:label: ControlAction
@graph.name: ControlAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: An agent controls a device or application.

@graph.rdfs:label: interactionCount
@graph.name: interactionCount
@graph.rdfs:comment: This property is deprecated, alongside the UserInteraction types on which it depended.

@graph.rdfs:label: estimatesRiskOf
@graph.name: estimatesRiskOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: The condition, complication, or symptom whose risk is being estimated.

@graph.rdfs:label: webCheckinTime
@graph.name: webCheckinTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The time when a passenger can check into the flight online.

@graph.rdfs:label: Vessel
@graph.name: Vessel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A component of the human body circulatory system comprised of an intricate network of hollow tubes that transport blood throughout the entire body.

@graph.rdfs:label: Landform
@graph.name: Landform
@graph.rdfs:comment: A landform or physical feature.  Landform elements include mountains, plains, lakes, rivers, seascape and oceanic waterbody interface features such as bays, peninsulas, seas and so forth, including sub-aqueous terrain features such as submersed mountain ranges, volcanoes, and the great ocean basins.

@graph.rdfs:label: ApprovedIndication
@graph.name: ApprovedIndication
@graph.rdfs:comment: An indication for a medical therapy that has been formally specified or approved by a regulatory body that regulates use of the therapy; for example, the US FDA approves indications for most drugs in the US.

@graph.rdfs:label: PaintAction
@graph.name: PaintAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of producing a painting, typically with paint and canvas as instruments.

@graph.rdfs:label: SteeringPositionValue
@graph.name: SteeringPositionValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: A value indicating a steering position.

@graph.rdfs:label: Manuscript
@graph.name: Manuscript
@graph.rdfs:comment: A book, document, or piece of music written by hand rather than typed or printed.

@graph.rdfs:label: characterName
@graph.name: characterName
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of a character played in some acting or performing role, i.e. in a PerformanceRole.

@graph.rdfs:label: ComedyClub
@graph.name: ComedyClub
@graph.rdfs:comment: A comedy club.

@graph.rdfs:label: departureTerminal
@graph.name: departureTerminal
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifier of the flight's departure terminal.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfRooms
@graph.name: numberOfRooms
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The number of rooms (excluding bathrooms and closets) of the accommodation or lodging business.
Typical unit code(s): ROM for room or C62 for no unit. The type of room can be put in the unitText property of the QuantitativeValue.

@graph.rdfs:label: MonetaryAmount
@graph.name: MonetaryAmount
@graph.rdfs:comment: A monetary value or range. This type can be used to describe an amount of money such as $50 USD, or a range as in describing a bank account being suitable for a balance between £1,000 and £1,000,000 GBP, or the value of a salary, etc. It is recommended to use [[PriceSpecification]] Types to describe the price of an Offer, Invoice, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: potentialUse
@graph.name: potentialUse
@graph.rdfs:comment: Intended use of the BioChemEntity by humans.

@graph.rdfs:label: ListenAction
@graph.name: ListenAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of consuming audio content.

@graph.rdfs:label: Preschool
@graph.name: Preschool
@graph.rdfs:comment: A preschool.

@graph.rdfs:label: performerIn
@graph.name: performerIn
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event that this person is a performer or participant in.

@graph.rdfs:label: DefenceEstablishment
@graph.name: DefenceEstablishment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A defence establishment, such as an army or navy base.

@graph.rdfs:label: seatingCapacity
@graph.name: seatingCapacity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of persons that can be seated (e.g. in a vehicle), both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

@graph.rdfs:label: sameAs
@graph.name: sameAs
@graph.rdfs:comment: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.

@graph.rdfs:label: orderDate
@graph.name: orderDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date order was placed.

@graph.rdfs:label: gameTip
@graph.name: gameTip
@graph.rdfs:comment: Links to tips, tactics, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: competencyRequired
@graph.name: competencyRequired
@graph.rdfs:comment: Knowledge, skill, ability or personal attribute that must be demonstrated by a person or other entity in order to do something such as earn an Educational Occupational Credential or understand a LearningResource.

@graph.rdfs:label: EducationalOrganization
@graph.name: EducationalOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: An educational organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: printColumn
@graph.name: printColumn
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of the column in which the NewsArticle appears in the print edition.

@graph.rdfs:label: educationalAlignment
@graph.name: educationalAlignment
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An alignment to an established educational framework.

This property should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource [[teaches]] or [[assesses]] a competency.

@graph.rdfs:label: Newspaper
@graph.name: Newspaper
@graph.rdfs:comment: A publication containing information about varied topics that are pertinent to general information, a geographic area, or a specific subject matter (i.e. business, culture, education). Often published daily.

@graph.rdfs:label: colleagues
@graph.name: colleagues
@graph.rdfs:comment: A colleague of the person.

@graph.rdfs:label: bioChemInteraction
@graph.name: bioChemInteraction
@graph.rdfs:comment: A BioChemEntity that is known to interact with this item.

@graph.rdfs:label: saturatedFatContent
@graph.name: saturatedFatContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of grams of saturated fat.

@graph.rdfs:label: mpn
@graph.name: mpn
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the product, or the product to which the offer refers.

@graph.rdfs:label: newsUpdatesAndGuidelines
@graph.name: newsUpdatesAndGuidelines
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a page with news updates and guidelines. This could often be (but is not required to be) the main page containing [[SpecialAnnouncement]] markup on a site.

@graph.rdfs:label: firstAppearance
@graph.name: firstAppearance
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the first known occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

@graph.rdfs:label: GameAvailabilityEnumeration
@graph.name: GameAvailabilityEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: For a [[VideoGame]], such as used with a [[PlayGameAction]], an enumeration of the kind of game availability offered.

@graph.rdfs:label: sensoryUnit
@graph.name: sensoryUnit
@graph.rdfs:comment: The neurological pathway extension that inputs and sends information to the brain or spinal cord.

@graph.rdfs:label: reservedTicket
@graph.name: reservedTicket
@graph.rdfs:comment: A ticket associated with the reservation.

@graph.rdfs:label: incentiveType
@graph.name: incentiveType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of incentive offered (tax credit/rebate, tax deduction, tax waiver, subsidies, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: nonprofitStatus
@graph.name: nonprofitStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: nonprofitStatus indicates the legal status of a non-profit organization in its primary place of business.

@graph.rdfs:label: Optician
@graph.name: Optician
@graph.rdfs:comment: A store that sells reading glasses and similar devices for improving vision.

@graph.rdfs:label: supersededBy
@graph.name: supersededBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: Relates a term (i.e. a property, class or enumeration) to one that supersedes it.

@graph.rdfs:label: CurrencyConversionService
@graph.name: CurrencyConversionService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A service to convert funds from one currency to another currency.

@graph.rdfs:label: ParcelDelivery
@graph.name: ParcelDelivery
@graph.rdfs:comment: The delivery of a parcel either via the postal service or a commercial service.

@graph.rdfs:label: GolfCourse
@graph.name: GolfCourse
@graph.rdfs:comment: A golf course.

@graph.rdfs:label: cookTime
@graph.name: cookTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The time it takes to actually cook the dish, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

@graph.rdfs:label: bed
@graph.name: bed
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The type of bed or beds included in the accommodation. For the single case of just one bed of a certain type, you use bed directly with a text.
      If you want to indicate the quantity of a certain kind of bed, use an instance of BedDetails. For more detailed information, use the amenityFeature property.

@graph.rdfs:label: Book
@graph.name: Book
@graph.rdfs:comment: A book.

@graph.rdfs:label: CreditCard
@graph.name: CreditCard
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A card payment method of a particular brand or name.  Used to mark up a particular payment method and/or the financial product/service that supplies the card account.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#AmericanExpress
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DinersClub
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Discover
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#JCB
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#MasterCard
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#VISA

@graph.rdfs:label: coursePrerequisites
@graph.name: coursePrerequisites
@graph.rdfs:comment: Requirements for taking the Course. May be completion of another [[Course]] or a textual description like "permission of instructor". Requirements may be a pre-requisite competency, referenced using [[AlignmentObject]].

@graph.rdfs:label: RecyclingCenter
@graph.name: RecyclingCenter
@graph.rdfs:comment: A recycling center.

@graph.rdfs:label: QuoteAction
@graph.name: QuoteAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: An agent quotes/estimates/appraises an object/product/service with a price at a location/store.

@graph.rdfs:label: translationOfWork
@graph.name: translationOfWork
@graph.rdfs:comment: The work that this work has been translated from. E.g. 物种起源 is a translationOf “On the Origin of Species”.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfSeasons
@graph.name: numberOfSeasons
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of seasons in this series.

@graph.rdfs:label: StatusEnumeration
@graph.name: StatusEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Lists or enumerations dealing with status types.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalGuidelineContraindication
@graph.name: MedicalGuidelineContraindication
@graph.rdfs:comment: A guideline contraindication that designates a process as harmful and where quality of the data supporting the contraindication is sound.

@graph.rdfs:label: OrderStatus
@graph.name: OrderStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerated status values for Order.

@graph.rdfs:label: baseSalary
@graph.name: baseSalary
@graph.rdfs:comment: The base salary of the job or of an employee in an EmployeeRole.

@graph.rdfs:label: MarryAction
@graph.name: MarryAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of marrying a person.

@graph.rdfs:label: dosageForm
@graph.name: dosageForm
@graph.rdfs:comment: A dosage form in which this drug/supplement is available, e.g. 'tablet', 'suspension', 'injection'.

@graph.rdfs:label: freeShippingThreshold
@graph.name: freeShippingThreshold
@graph.rdfs:comment: A monetary value above (or at) which the shipping rate becomes free. Intended to be used via an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with [[shippingSettingsLink]] matching this [[ShippingRateSettings]].

@graph.rdfs:label: Course
@graph.name: Course
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of an educational course which may be offered as distinct instances which take place at different times or take place at different locations, or be offered through different media or modes of study. An educational course is a sequence of one or more educational events and/or creative works which aims to build knowledge, competence or ability of learners.

@graph.rdfs:label: partOfSeason
@graph.name: partOfSeason
@graph.rdfs:comment: The season to which this episode belongs.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfPartialBathrooms
@graph.name: numberOfPartialBathrooms
@graph.rdfs:comment: Number of partial bathrooms - The total number of half and ¼ bathrooms in an [[Accommodation]]. This corresponds to the [BathroomsPartial field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsPartial+Field).

@graph.rdfs:label: cholesterolContent
@graph.name: cholesterolContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of milligrams of cholesterol.

@graph.rdfs:label: priceSpecification
@graph.name: priceSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: One or more detailed price specifications, indicating the unit price and delivery or payment charges.

@graph.rdfs:label: endTime
@graph.name: endTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The endTime of something. For a reserved event or service (e.g. FoodEstablishmentReservation), the time that it is expected to end. For actions that span a period of time, when the action was performed. E.g. John wrote a book from January to *December*. For media, including audio and video, it's the time offset of the end of a clip within a larger file.\n\nNote that Event uses startDate/endDate instead of startTime/endTime, even when describing dates with times. This situation may be clarified in future revisions.

@graph.rdfs:label: Intangible
@graph.name: Intangible
@graph.rdfs:comment: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things such as quantities, structured values, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: isPartOf
@graph.name: isPartOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates an item or CreativeWork that this item, or CreativeWork (in some sense), is part of.

@graph.rdfs:label: mentions
@graph.name: mentions
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates that the CreativeWork contains a reference to, but is not necessarily about a concept.

@graph.rdfs:label: EmailMessage
@graph.name: EmailMessage
@graph.rdfs:comment: An email message.

@graph.rdfs:label: associatedClaimReview
@graph.name: associatedClaimReview
@graph.rdfs:comment: An associated [[ClaimReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

@graph.rdfs:label: partOfOrder
@graph.name: partOfOrder
@graph.rdfs:comment: The overall order the items in this delivery were included in.

@graph.rdfs:label: DataFeed
@graph.name: DataFeed
@graph.rdfs:comment: A single feed providing structured information about one or more entities or topics.

@graph.rdfs:label: drugClass
@graph.name: drugClass
@graph.rdfs:comment: The class of drug this belongs to (e.g., statins).

@graph.rdfs:label: validThrough
@graph.name: validThrough
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date after when the item is not valid. For example the end of an offer, salary period, or a period of opening hours.

@graph.rdfs:label: measurementQualifier
@graph.name: measurementQualifier
@graph.rdfs:comment: Provides additional qualification to an observation. For example, a GDP observation measures the Nominal value.

@graph.rdfs:label: boardingGroup
@graph.name: boardingGroup
@graph.rdfs:comment: The airline-specific indicator of boarding order / preference.

@graph.rdfs:label: ReplyAction
@graph.name: ReplyAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of responding to a question/message asked/sent by the object. Related to [[AskAction]].

Related actions:

* [[AskAction]]: Appears generally as an origin of a ReplyAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: measuredProperty
@graph.name: measuredProperty
@graph.rdfs:comment: The measuredProperty of an [[Observation]], typically via its [[StatisticalVariable]]. There are various kinds of applicable [[Property]]: a schema.org property, a property from other RDF-compatible systems, e.g. W3C RDF Data Cube, Data Commons, Wikidata, or schema.org extensions such as [GS1's](https://www.gs1.org/voc/?show=properties).

@graph.rdfs:label: applicationDeadline
@graph.name: applicationDeadline
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date on which the program stops collecting applications for the next enrollment cycle. Flexible application deadlines (for example, a program with rolling admissions) can be described in a textual string, rather than as a DateTime.

@graph.rdfs:label: subStructure
@graph.name: subStructure
@graph.rdfs:comment: Component (sub-)structure(s) that comprise this anatomical structure.

@graph.rdfs:label: targetCollection
@graph.name: targetCollection
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: gtin12
@graph.name: gtin12
@graph.rdfs:comment: The GTIN-12 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. The GTIN-12 is the 12-digit GS1 Identification Key composed of a U.P.C. Company Prefix, Item Reference, and Check Digit used to identify trade items. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

@graph.rdfs:label: gtin8
@graph.name: gtin8
@graph.rdfs:comment: The GTIN-8 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This code is also known as EAN/UCC-8 or 8-digit EAN. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

@graph.rdfs:label: unitCode
@graph.name: unitCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: The unit of measurement given using the UN/CEFACT Common Code (3 characters) or a URL. Other codes than the UN/CEFACT Common Code may be used with a prefix followed by a colon.

@graph.rdfs:label: targetPopulation
@graph.name: targetPopulation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Characteristics of the population for which this is intended, or which typically uses it, e.g. 'adults'.

@graph.rdfs:label: EmployerAggregateRating
@graph.name: EmployerAggregateRating
@graph.rdfs:comment: An aggregate rating of an Organization related to its role as an employer.

@graph.rdfs:label: carrierRequirements
@graph.name: carrierRequirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies specific carrier(s) requirements for the application (e.g. an application may only work on a specific carrier network).

@graph.rdfs:label: BankAccount
@graph.name: BankAccount
@graph.rdfs:comment: A product or service offered by a bank whereby one may deposit, withdraw or transfer money and in some cases be paid interest.

@graph.rdfs:label: programmingModel
@graph.name: programmingModel
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether API is managed or unmanaged.

@graph.rdfs:label: SearchRescueOrganization
@graph.name: SearchRescueOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Search and Rescue organization of some kind.

@graph.rdfs:label: responsibilities
@graph.name: responsibilities
@graph.rdfs:comment: Responsibilities associated with this role or Occupation.

@graph.rdfs:label: frequency
@graph.name: frequency
@graph.rdfs:comment: How often the dose is taken, e.g. 'daily'.

@graph.rdfs:label: arrivalPlatform
@graph.name: arrivalPlatform
@graph.rdfs:comment: The platform where the train arrives.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanCoinsuranceRate
@graph.name: healthPlanCoinsuranceRate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The rate of coinsurance expressed as a number between 0.0 and 1.0.

@graph.rdfs:label: globalLocationNumber
@graph.name: globalLocationNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The [Global Location Number](http://www.gs1.org/gln) (GLN, sometimes also referred to as International Location Number or ILN) of the respective organization, person, or place. The GLN is a 13-digit number used to identify parties and physical locations.

@graph.rdfs:label: valueName
@graph.name: valueName
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the name of the PropertyValueSpecification to be used in URL templates and form encoding in a manner analogous to HTML's input@name.

@graph.rdfs:label: contraindication
@graph.name: contraindication
@graph.rdfs:comment: A contraindication for this therapy.

@graph.rdfs:label: causeOf
@graph.name: causeOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: The condition, complication, symptom, sign, etc. caused.

@graph.rdfs:label: TieAction
@graph.name: TieAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of reaching a draw in a competitive activity.

@graph.rdfs:label: accessCode
@graph.name: accessCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: Password, PIN, or access code needed for delivery (e.g. from a locker).

@graph.rdfs:label: accelerationTime
@graph.name: accelerationTime
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The time needed to accelerate the vehicle from a given start velocity to a given target velocity.

Typical unit code(s): SEC for seconds

* Note: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for seconds/0..100 km/h or seconds/0..60 mph. Simply use "SEC" for seconds and indicate the velocities in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]], or use [[valueReference]] with a [[QuantitativeValue]] of 0..60 mph or 0..100 km/h to specify the reference speeds.

@graph.rdfs:label: rangeIncludes
@graph.name: rangeIncludes
@graph.rdfs:comment: Relates a property to a class that constitutes (one of) the expected type(s) for values of the property.

@graph.rdfs:label: ticketedSeat
@graph.name: ticketedSeat
@graph.rdfs:comment: The seat associated with the ticket.

@graph.rdfs:label: gamePlatform
@graph.name: gamePlatform
@graph.rdfs:comment: The electronic systems used to play video games.

@graph.rdfs:label: signDetected
@graph.name: signDetected
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sign detected by the test.

@graph.rdfs:label: vehicleInteriorType
@graph.name: vehicleInteriorType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type or material of the interior of the vehicle (e.g. synthetic fabric, leather, wood, etc.). While most interior types are characterized by the material used, an interior type can also be based on vehicle usage or target audience.

@graph.rdfs:label: annualPercentageRate
@graph.name: annualPercentageRate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The annual rate that is charged for borrowing (or made by investing), expressed as a single percentage number that represents the actual yearly cost of funds over the term of a loan. This includes any fees or additional costs associated with the transaction.

@graph.rdfs:label: makesOffer
@graph.name: makesOffer
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pointer to products or services offered by the organization or person.

@graph.rdfs:label: embeddedTextCaption
@graph.name: embeddedTextCaption
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents textual captioning from a [[MediaObject]], e.g. text of a 'meme'.

@graph.rdfs:label: owner
@graph.name: owner
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person or organization who owns this Thing.

@graph.rdfs:label: bitrate
@graph.name: bitrate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The bitrate of the media object.

@graph.rdfs:label: givenName
@graph.name: givenName
@graph.rdfs:comment: Given name. In the U.S., the first name of a Person.

@graph.rdfs:label: molecularWeight
@graph.name: molecularWeight
@graph.rdfs:comment: This is the molecular weight of the entity being described, not of the parent. Units should be included in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '12 amu' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

@graph.rdfs:label: maximumAttendeeCapacity
@graph.name: maximumAttendeeCapacity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The total number of individuals that may attend an event or venue.

@graph.rdfs:label: description
@graph.name: description
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: checkoutPageURLTemplate
@graph.name: checkoutPageURLTemplate
@graph.rdfs:comment: A URL template (RFC 6570) for a checkout page for an offer. This approach allows merchants to specify a URL for online checkout of the offered product, by interpolating parameters such as the logged in user ID, product ID, quantity, discount code etc. Parameter naming and standardization are not specified here.

@graph.rdfs:label: CompoundPriceSpecification
@graph.name: CompoundPriceSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A compound price specification is one that bundles multiple prices that all apply in combination for different dimensions of consumption. Use the name property of the attached unit price specification for indicating the dimension of a price component (e.g. "electricity" or "final cleaning").

@graph.rdfs:label: originalMediaContextDescription
@graph.name: originalMediaContextDescription
@graph.rdfs:comment: Describes, in a [[MediaReview]] when dealing with [[DecontextualizedContent]], background information that can contribute to better interpretation of the [[MediaObject]].

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicStore
@graph.name: MusicStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A music store.

@graph.rdfs:label: restockingFee
@graph.name: restockingFee
@graph.rdfs:comment: Use [[MonetaryAmount]] to specify a fixed restocking fee for product returns, or use [[Number]] to specify a percentage of the product price paid by the customer.

@graph.rdfs:label: AudioObjectSnapshot
@graph.name: AudioObjectSnapshot
@graph.rdfs:comment: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of an [[AudioObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.

@graph.rdfs:label: BusinessAudience
@graph.name: BusinessAudience
@graph.rdfs:comment: A set of characteristics belonging to businesses, e.g. who compose an item's target audience.

@graph.rdfs:label: BoatTrip
@graph.name: BoatTrip
@graph.rdfs:comment: A trip on a commercial ferry line.

@graph.rdfs:label: Question
@graph.name: Question
@graph.rdfs:comment: A specific question - e.g. from a user seeking answers online, or collected in a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) document.

@graph.rdfs:label: billingStart
@graph.name: billingStart
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies after how much time this price (or price component) becomes valid and billing starts. Can be used, for example, to model a price increase after the first year of a subscription. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

@graph.rdfs:label: displayLocation
@graph.name: displayLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The location at which an item can be viewed or experienced in-person.

@graph.rdfs:label: Pharmacy
@graph.name: Pharmacy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pharmacy or drugstore.

@graph.rdfs:label: releaseOf
@graph.name: releaseOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: The album this is a release of.

@graph.rdfs:label: TierBenefitEnumeration
@graph.name: TierBenefitEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: An enumeration of possible benefits as part of a loyalty (members) program.

@graph.rdfs:label: UserTweets
@graph.name: UserTweets
@graph.rdfs:comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

@graph.rdfs:label: produces
@graph.name: produces
@graph.rdfs:comment: The tangible thing generated by the service, e.g. a passport, permit, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: itinerary
@graph.name: itinerary
@graph.rdfs:comment: Destination(s) ( [[Place]] ) that make up a trip. For a trip where destination order is important use [[ItemList]] to specify that order (see examples).

@graph.rdfs:label: expires
@graph.name: expires
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date the content expires and is no longer useful or available. For example a [[VideoObject]] or [[NewsArticle]] whose availability or relevance is time-limited, a [[ClaimReview]] fact check whose publisher wants to indicate that it may no longer be relevant (or helpful to highlight) after some date, or a [[Certification]] the validity has expired.

@graph.rdfs:label: validUntil
@graph.name: validUntil
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date when the item is no longer valid.

@graph.rdfs:label: nsn
@graph.name: nsn
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the [NATO stock number](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO_Stock_Number) (nsn) of a [[Product]].

@graph.rdfs:label: sharedContent
@graph.name: sharedContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: A CreativeWork such as an image, video, or audio clip shared as part of this posting.

@graph.rdfs:label: doseUnit
@graph.name: doseUnit
@graph.rdfs:comment: The unit of the dose, e.g. 'mg'.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicVideoObject
@graph.name: MusicVideoObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: A music video file.

@graph.rdfs:label: members
@graph.name: members
@graph.rdfs:comment: A member of this organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: actionPlatform
@graph.name: actionPlatform
@graph.rdfs:comment: The high level platform(s) where the Action can be performed for the given URL. To specify a specific application or operating system instance, use actionApplication.

@graph.rdfs:label: iupacName
@graph.name: iupacName
@graph.rdfs:comment: Systematic method of naming chemical compounds as recommended by the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC).

@graph.rdfs:label: EntryPoint
@graph.name: EntryPoint
@graph.rdfs:comment: An entry point, within some Web-based protocol.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationJurisdiction
@graph.name: legislationJurisdiction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The jurisdiction from which the legislation originates.

@graph.rdfs:label: countryOfOrigin
@graph.name: countryOfOrigin
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The country of origin of something, including products as well as creative  works such as movie and TV content.

In the case of TV and movie, this would be the country of the principle offices of the production company or individual responsible for the movie. For other kinds of [[CreativeWork]] it is difficult to provide fully general guidance, and properties such as [[contentLocation]] and [[locationCreated]] may be more applicable.

In the case of products, the country of origin of the product. The exact interpretation of this may vary by context and product type, and cannot be fully enumerated here.

@graph.rdfs:label: programmingLanguage
@graph.name: programmingLanguage
@graph.rdfs:comment: The computer programming language.

@graph.rdfs:label: scheduledPaymentDate
@graph.name: scheduledPaymentDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date the invoice is scheduled to be paid.

@graph.rdfs:label: ExhibitionEvent
@graph.name: ExhibitionEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Exhibition event, e.g. at a museum, library, archive, tradeshow, ...

@graph.rdfs:label: box
@graph.name: box
@graph.rdfs:comment: A box is the area enclosed by the rectangle formed by two points. The first point is the lower corner, the second point is the upper corner. A box is expressed as two points separated by a space character.

@graph.rdfs:label: employee
@graph.name: employee
@graph.rdfs:comment: Someone working for this organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: citation
@graph.name: citation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A citation or reference to another creative work, such as another publication, web page, scholarly article, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: unsaturatedFatContent
@graph.name: unsaturatedFatContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of grams of unsaturated fat.

@graph.rdfs:label: DataType
@graph.name: DataType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The basic data types such as Integers, Strings, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasPart
@graph.name: hasPart
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates an item or CreativeWork that is part of this item, or CreativeWork (in some sense).

@graph.rdfs:label: FloorPlan
@graph.name: FloorPlan
@graph.rdfs:comment: A FloorPlan is an explicit representation of a collection of similar accommodations, allowing the provision of common information (room counts, sizes, layout diagrams) and offers for rental or sale. In typical use, some [[ApartmentComplex]] has an [[accommodationFloorPlan]] which is a [[FloorPlan]].  A FloorPlan is always in the context of a particular place, either a larger [[ApartmentComplex]] or a single [[Apartment]]. The visual/spatial aspects of a floor plan (i.e. room layout, [see wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floor_plan)) can be indicated using [[image]].

@graph.rdfs:label: IceCreamShop
@graph.name: IceCreamShop
@graph.rdfs:comment: An ice cream shop.

@graph.rdfs:label: containsSeason
@graph.name: containsSeason
@graph.rdfs:comment: A season that is part of the media series.

@graph.rdfs:label: SportsClub
@graph.name: SportsClub
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sports club.

@graph.rdfs:label: inventoryLevel
@graph.name: inventoryLevel
@graph.rdfs:comment: The current approximate inventory level for the item or items.

@graph.rdfs:label: Protein
@graph.name: Protein
@graph.rdfs:comment: Protein is here used in its widest possible definition, as classes of amino acid based molecules. Amyloid-beta Protein in human (UniProt P05067), eukaryota (e.g. an OrthoDB group) or even a single molecule that one can point to are all of type :Protein. A protein can thus be a subclass of another protein, e.g. :Protein as a UniProt record can have multiple isoforms inside it which would also be :Protein. They can be imagined, synthetic, hypothetical or naturally occurring.

@graph.rdfs:label: reviews
@graph.name: reviews
@graph.rdfs:comment: Review of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: previousItem
@graph.name: previousItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: A link to the ListItem that precedes the current one.

@graph.rdfs:label: backstory
@graph.name: backstory
@graph.rdfs:comment: For an [[Article]], typically a [[NewsArticle]], the backstory property provides a textual summary giving a brief explanation of why and how an article was created. In a journalistic setting this could include information about reporting process, methods, interviews, data sources, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: workLocation
@graph.name: workLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A contact location for a person's place of work.

@graph.rdfs:label: postalCode
@graph.name: postalCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: The postal code. For example, 94043.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfBeds
@graph.name: numberOfBeds
@graph.rdfs:comment: The quantity of the given bed type available in the HotelRoom, Suite, House, or Apartment.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasMenu
@graph.name: hasMenu
@graph.rdfs:comment: Either the actual menu as a structured representation, as text, or a URL of the menu.

@graph.rdfs:label: MeasurementMethodEnum
@graph.name: MeasurementMethodEnum
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumeration(s) for use with [[measurementMethod]].

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationConsolidates
@graph.name: legislationConsolidates
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates another legislation taken into account in this consolidated legislation (which is usually the product of an editorial process that revises the legislation). This property should be used multiple times to refer to both the original version or the previous consolidated version, and to the legislations making the change.

@graph.rdfs:label: albumProductionType
@graph.name: albumProductionType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: usesDevice
@graph.name: usesDevice
@graph.rdfs:comment: Device used to perform the test.

@graph.rdfs:label: servicePhone
@graph.name: servicePhone
@graph.rdfs:comment: The phone number to use to access the service.

@graph.rdfs:label: partySize
@graph.name: partySize
@graph.rdfs:comment: Number of people the reservation should accommodate.

@graph.rdfs:label: AMRadioChannel
@graph.name: AMRadioChannel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A radio channel that uses AM.

@graph.rdfs:label: ShippingService
@graph.name: ShippingService
@graph.rdfs:comment: ShippingService represents the criteria used to determine if and how an offer could be shipped to a customer.

@graph.rdfs:label: videoQuality
@graph.name: videoQuality
@graph.rdfs:comment: The quality of the video.

@graph.rdfs:label: WearAction
@graph.name: WearAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of dressing oneself in clothing.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationPassedBy
@graph.name: legislationPassedBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: The person or organization that originally passed or made the law: typically parliament (for primary legislation) or government (for secondary legislation). This indicates the "legal author" of the law, as opposed to its physical author.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastChannelId
@graph.name: broadcastChannelId
@graph.rdfs:comment: The unique address by which the BroadcastService can be identified in a provider lineup. In US, this is typically a number.

@graph.rdfs:label: UnitPriceSpecification
@graph.name: UnitPriceSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: The price asked for a given offer by the respective organization or person.

@graph.rdfs:label: spatial
@graph.name: spatial
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The "spatial" property can be used in cases when more specific properties
(e.g. [[locationCreated]], [[spatialCoverage]], [[contentLocation]]) are not known to be appropriate.

@graph.rdfs:label: RadioBroadcastService
@graph.name: RadioBroadcastService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A delivery service through which radio content is provided via broadcast over the air or online.

@graph.rdfs:label: documentation
@graph.name: documentation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Further documentation describing the Web API in more detail.

@graph.rdfs:label: starRating
@graph.name: starRating
@graph.rdfs:comment: An official rating for a lodging business or food establishment, e.g. from national associations or standards bodies. Use the author property to indicate the rating organization, e.g. as an Organization with name such as (e.g. HOTREC, DEHOGA, WHR, or Hotelstars).

@graph.rdfs:label: OwnershipInfo
@graph.name: OwnershipInfo
@graph.rdfs:comment: A structured value providing information about when a certain organization or person owned a certain product.

@graph.rdfs:label: character
@graph.name: character
@graph.rdfs:comment: Fictional person connected with a creative work.

@graph.rdfs:label: referee
@graph.name: referee
@graph.rdfs:comment: An official who watches a game or match closely to enforce the rules and arbitrate on matters arising from the play such as referees, umpires or judges. The name of the effective function can vary according to the sport.

@graph.rdfs:label: fatContent
@graph.name: fatContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of grams of fat.

@graph.rdfs:label: TipAction
@graph.name: TipAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of giving money voluntarily to a beneficiary in recognition of services rendered.

@graph.rdfs:label: previousStartDate
@graph.name: previousStartDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Used in conjunction with eventStatus for rescheduled or cancelled events. This property contains the previously scheduled start date. For rescheduled events, the startDate property should be used for the newly scheduled start date. In the (rare) case of an event that has been postponed and rescheduled multiple times, this field may be repeated.

@graph.rdfs:label: appliesToDeliveryMethod
@graph.name: appliesToDeliveryMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: The delivery method(s) to which the delivery charge or payment charge specification applies.

@graph.rdfs:label: VirtualLocation
@graph.name: VirtualLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: An online or virtual location for attending events. For example, one may attend an online seminar or educational event. While a virtual location may be used as the location of an event, virtual locations should not be confused with physical locations in the real world.

@graph.rdfs:label: materialExtent
@graph.name: materialExtent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The quantity of the materials being described or an expression of the physical space they occupy.

@graph.rdfs:label: FulfillmentTypeEnumeration
@graph.name: FulfillmentTypeEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: A type of product fulfillment.

@graph.rdfs:label: connectedTo
@graph.name: connectedTo
@graph.rdfs:comment: Other anatomical structures to which this structure is connected.

@graph.rdfs:label: maxPrice
@graph.name: maxPrice
@graph.rdfs:comment: The highest price if the price is a range.

@graph.rdfs:label: fulfillmentType
@graph.name: fulfillmentType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Type of fulfillment applicable to the [[ShippingService]].

@graph.rdfs:label: trainNumber
@graph.name: trainNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier for the train.

@graph.rdfs:label: wordCount
@graph.name: wordCount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of words in the text of the CreativeWork such as an Article, Book, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationDateOfApplicability
@graph.name: legislationDateOfApplicability
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date at which the Legislation becomes applicable. This can sometimes be distinct from the date of entry into force : a text may come in force today, and state it will become applicable in 3 months.

@graph.rdfs:label: Winery
@graph.name: Winery
@graph.rdfs:comment: A winery.

@graph.rdfs:label: FinancialProduct
@graph.name: FinancialProduct
@graph.rdfs:comment: A product provided to consumers and businesses by financial institutions such as banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, consumer finance companies, and investment companies which comprise the financial services industry.

@graph.rdfs:label: durationOfWarranty
@graph.name: durationOfWarranty
@graph.rdfs:comment: The duration of the warranty promise. Common unitCode values are ANN for year, MON for months, or DAY for days.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicRecording
@graph.name: MusicRecording
@graph.rdfs:comment: A music recording (track), usually a single song.

@graph.rdfs:label: meetsEmissionStandard
@graph.name: meetsEmissionStandard
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates that the vehicle meets the respective emission standard.

@graph.rdfs:label: caption
@graph.name: caption
@graph.rdfs:comment: The caption for this object. For downloadable machine formats (closed caption, subtitles etc.) use MediaObject and indicate the [[encodingFormat]].

@graph.rdfs:label: TelevisionStation
@graph.name: TelevisionStation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A television station.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasOccupation
@graph.name: hasOccupation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Person's occupation. For past professions, use Role for expressing dates.

@graph.rdfs:label: salaryUponCompletion
@graph.name: salaryUponCompletion
@graph.rdfs:comment: The expected salary upon completing the training.

@graph.rdfs:label: Play
@graph.name: Play
@graph.rdfs:comment: A play is a form of literature, usually consisting of dialogue between characters, intended for theatrical performance rather than just reading. Note: A performance of a Play would be a [[TheaterEvent]] or [[BroadcastEvent]] - the *Play* being the [[workPerformed]].

@graph.rdfs:label: audienceType
@graph.name: audienceType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The target group associated with a given audience (e.g. veterans, car owners, musicians, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: PlayGameAction
@graph.name: PlayGameAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of playing a video game.

@graph.rdfs:label: courseWorkload
@graph.name: courseWorkload
@graph.rdfs:comment: The amount of work expected of students taking the course, often provided as a figure per week or per month, and may be broken down by type. For example, "2 hours of lectures, 1 hour of lab work and 3 hours of independent study per week".

@graph.rdfs:label: Accommodation
@graph.name: Accommodation
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An accommodation is a place that can accommodate human beings, e.g. a hotel room, a camping pitch, or a meeting room. Many accommodations are for overnight stays, but this is not a mandatory requirement. For more specific types of accommodations not defined in schema.org, one can use [[additionalType]] with external vocabularies.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

@graph.rdfs:label: incentiveStatus
@graph.name: incentiveStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The status of the incentive (active, on hold, retired, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: eligibleCustomerType
@graph.name: eligibleCustomerType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type(s) of customers for which the given offer is valid.

@graph.rdfs:label: inChIKey
@graph.name: inChIKey
@graph.rdfs:comment: InChIKey is a hashed version of the full InChI (using the SHA-256 algorithm).

@graph.rdfs:label: serialNumber
@graph.name: serialNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The serial number or any alphanumeric identifier of a particular product. When attached to an offer, it is a shortcut for the serial number of the product included in the offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: activeIngredient
@graph.name: activeIngredient
@graph.rdfs:comment: An active ingredient, typically chemical compounds and/or biologic substances.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalTestPanel
@graph.name: MedicalTestPanel
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any collection of tests commonly ordered together.

@graph.rdfs:label: VideoObjectSnapshot
@graph.name: VideoObjectSnapshot
@graph.rdfs:comment: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of a [[VideoObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.

@graph.rdfs:label: ReturnMethodEnumeration
@graph.name: ReturnMethodEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates several types of product return methods.

@graph.rdfs:label: BeautySalon
@graph.name: BeautySalon
@graph.rdfs:comment: Beauty salon.

@graph.rdfs:label: expressedIn
@graph.name: expressedIn
@graph.rdfs:comment: Tissue, organ, biological sample, etc in which activity of this gene has been observed experimentally. For example brain, digestive system.

@graph.rdfs:label: speakable
@graph.name: speakable
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Indicates sections of a Web page that are particularly 'speakable' in the sense of being highlighted as being especially appropriate for text-to-speech conversion. Other sections of a page may also be usefully spoken in particular circumstances; the 'speakable' property serves to indicate the parts most likely to be generally useful for speech.

The *speakable* property can be repeated an arbitrary number of times, with three kinds of possible 'content-locator' values:

1.) *id-value* URL references - uses *id-value* of an element in the page being annotated. The simplest use of *speakable* has (potentially relative) URL values, referencing identified sections of the document concerned.

2.) CSS Selectors - addresses content in the annotated page, e.g. via class attribute. Use the [[cssSelector]] property.

3.)  XPaths - addresses content via XPaths (assuming an XML view of the content). Use the [[xpath]] property.


For more sophisticated markup of speakable sections beyond simple ID references, either CSS selectors or XPath expressions to pick out document section(s) as speakable. For this
we define a supporting type, [[SpeakableSpecification]]  which is defined to be a possible value of the *speakable* property.

@graph.rdfs:label: ShareAction
@graph.name: ShareAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of distributing content to people for their amusement or edification.

@graph.rdfs:label: assesses
@graph.name: assesses
@graph.rdfs:comment: The item being described is intended to assess the competency or learning outcome defined by the referenced term.

@graph.rdfs:label: resultReview
@graph.name: resultReview
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of result. The review that resulted in the performing of the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: doesNotShip
@graph.name: doesNotShip
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates when shipping to a particular [[shippingDestination]] is not available.

@graph.rdfs:label: prescriptionStatus
@graph.name: prescriptionStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the status of drug prescription, e.g. local catalogs classifications or whether the drug is available by prescription or over-the-counter, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: Code
@graph.name: Code
@graph.rdfs:comment: Computer programming source code. Example: Full (compile ready) solutions, code snippet samples, scripts, templates.

@graph.rdfs:label: diet
@graph.name: diet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: applicationSuite
@graph.name: applicationSuite
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of the application suite to which the application belongs (e.g. Excel belongs to Office).

@graph.rdfs:label: isVariantOf
@graph.name: isVariantOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the kind of product that this is a variant of. In the case of [[ProductModel]], this is a pointer (from a ProductModel) to a base product from which this product is a variant. It is safe to infer that the variant inherits all product features from the base model, unless defined locally. This is not transitive. In the case of a [[ProductGroup]], the group description also serves as a template, representing a set of Products that vary on explicitly defined, specific dimensions only (so it defines both a set of variants, as well as which values distinguish amongst those variants). When used with [[ProductGroup]], this property can apply to any [[Product]] included in the group.

@graph.rdfs:label: specialCommitments
@graph.name: specialCommitments
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any special commitments associated with this job posting. Valid entries include VeteranCommit, MilitarySpouseCommit, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: median
@graph.name: median
@graph.rdfs:comment: The median value.

@graph.rdfs:label: risks
@graph.name: risks
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specific physiologic risks associated to the diet plan.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfPreviousOwners
@graph.name: numberOfPreviousOwners
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of owners of the vehicle, including the current one.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

@graph.rdfs:label: Service
@graph.name: Service
@graph.rdfs:comment: A service provided by an organization, e.g. delivery service, print services, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: roleName
@graph.name: roleName
@graph.rdfs:comment: A role played, performed or filled by a person or organization. For example, the team of creators for a comic book might fill the roles named 'inker', 'penciller', and 'letterer'; or an athlete in a SportsTeam might play in the position named 'Quarterback'.

@graph.rdfs:label: Courthouse
@graph.name: Courthouse
@graph.rdfs:comment: A courthouse.

@graph.rdfs:label: directApply
@graph.name: directApply
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether an [[url]] that is associated with a [[JobPosting]] enables direct application for the job, via the posting website. A job posting is considered to have directApply of [[True]] if an application process for the specified job can be directly initiated via the url(s) given (noting that e.g. multiple internet domains might nevertheless be involved at an implementation level). A value of [[False]] is appropriate if there is no clear path to applying directly online for the specified job, navigating directly from the JobPosting url(s) supplied.

@graph.rdfs:label: dateVehicleFirstRegistered
@graph.name: dateVehicleFirstRegistered
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date of the first registration of the vehicle with the respective public authorities.

@graph.rdfs:label: arrivalTime
@graph.name: arrivalTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The expected arrival time.

@graph.rdfs:label: parentOrganization
@graph.name: parentOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: The larger organization that this organization is a [[subOrganization]] of, if any.

@graph.rdfs:label: creditText
@graph.name: creditText
@graph.rdfs:comment: Text that can be used to credit person(s) and/or organization(s) associated with a published Creative Work.

@graph.rdfs:label: commentText
@graph.name: commentText
@graph.rdfs:comment: The text of the UserComment.

@graph.rdfs:label: infectiousAgentClass
@graph.name: infectiousAgentClass
@graph.rdfs:comment: The class of infectious agent (bacteria, prion, etc.) that causes the disease.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfCredits
@graph.name: numberOfCredits
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of credits or units awarded by a Course or required to complete an EducationalOccupationalProgram.

@graph.rdfs:label: UseAction
@graph.name: UseAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of applying an object to its intended purpose.

@graph.rdfs:label: actor
@graph.name: actor
@graph.rdfs:comment: An actor (individual or a group), e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc., or in an event. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

@graph.rdfs:label: subjectOf
@graph.name: subjectOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: A CreativeWork or Event about this Thing.

@graph.rdfs:label: hostingOrganization
@graph.name: hostingOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Organization (airline, travelers' club, retailer, etc.) the membership is made with or which offers the  MemberProgram.

@graph.rdfs:label: GiveAction
@graph.name: GiveAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of transferring ownership of an object to a destination. Reciprocal of TakeAction.

Related actions:

* [[TakeAction]]: Reciprocal of GiveAction.
* [[SendAction]]: Unlike SendAction, GiveAction implies that ownership is being transferred (e.g. I may send my laptop to you, but that doesn't mean I'm giving it to you).

@graph.rdfs:label: InsuranceAgency
@graph.name: InsuranceAgency
@graph.rdfs:comment: An Insurance agency.

@graph.rdfs:label: SingleFamilyResidence
@graph.name: SingleFamilyResidence
@graph.rdfs:comment: Residence type: Single-family home.

@graph.rdfs:label: encodingFormat
@graph.name: encodingFormat
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Media type typically expressed using a MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml) and [MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/MIME_types)), e.g. application/zip for a SoftwareApplication binary, audio/mpeg for .mp3 etc.

In cases where a [[CreativeWork]] has several media type representations, [[encoding]] can be used to indicate each [[MediaObject]] alongside particular [[encodingFormat]] information.

Unregistered or niche encoding and file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia/Wikidata entry.

@graph.rdfs:label: ApplyAction
@graph.name: ApplyAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of registering to an organization/service without the guarantee to receive it.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, ApplyAction has no guarantees that the application will be accepted.

@graph.rdfs:label: targetProduct
@graph.name: targetProduct
@graph.rdfs:comment: Target Operating System / Product to which the code applies.  If applies to several versions, just the product name can be used.

@graph.rdfs:label: isInvolvedInBiologicalProcess
@graph.name: isInvolvedInBiologicalProcess
@graph.rdfs:comment: Biological process this BioChemEntity is involved in; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

@graph.rdfs:label: deliveryLeadTime
@graph.name: deliveryLeadTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup.

@graph.rdfs:label: EmployerReview
@graph.name: EmployerReview
@graph.rdfs:comment: An [[EmployerReview]] is a review of an [[Organization]] regarding its role as an employer, written by a current or former employee of that organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: refundType
@graph.name: refundType
@graph.rdfs:comment: A refund type, from an enumerated list.

@graph.rdfs:label: GardenStore
@graph.name: GardenStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A garden store.

@graph.rdfs:label: MovieRentalStore
@graph.name: MovieRentalStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A movie rental store.

@graph.rdfs:label: DeliveryEvent
@graph.name: DeliveryEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: An event involving the delivery of an item.

@graph.rdfs:label: tripOrigin
@graph.name: tripOrigin
@graph.rdfs:comment: The location of origin of the trip, prior to any destination(s).

@graph.rdfs:label: url
@graph.name: url
@graph.rdfs:comment: URL of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: TrackAction
@graph.name: TrackAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An agent tracks an object for updates.

Related actions:

* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, TrackAction refers to the interest on the location of innanimates objects.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, TrackAction refers to  the interest on the location of innanimate objects.

@graph.rdfs:label: maximumIntake
@graph.name: maximumIntake
@graph.rdfs:comment: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

@graph.rdfs:label: taxonomicRange
@graph.name: taxonomicRange
@graph.rdfs:comment: The taxonomic grouping of the organism that expresses, encodes, or in some way related to the BioChemEntity.

@graph.rdfs:label: ContactPage
@graph.name: ContactPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Web page type: Contact page.

@graph.rdfs:label: isLocatedInSubcellularLocation
@graph.name: isLocatedInSubcellularLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Subcellular location where this BioChemEntity is located; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

@graph.rdfs:label: advanceBookingRequirement
@graph.name: advanceBookingRequirement
@graph.rdfs:comment: The amount of time that is required between accepting the offer and the actual usage of the resource or service.

@graph.rdfs:label: occupationalCredentialAwarded
@graph.name: occupationalCredentialAwarded
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other occupational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

@graph.rdfs:label: referencesOrder
@graph.name: referencesOrder
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Order(s) related to this Invoice. One or more Orders may be combined into a single Invoice.

@graph.rdfs:label: seeks
@graph.name: seeks
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pointer to products or services sought by the organization or person (demand).

@graph.rdfs:label: readBy
@graph.name: readBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person who reads (performs) the audiobook.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanCostSharing
@graph.name: healthPlanCostSharing
@graph.rdfs:comment: The costs to the patient for services under this network or formulary.

@graph.rdfs:label: House
@graph.name: House
@graph.rdfs:comment: A house is a building or structure that has the ability to be occupied for habitation by humans or other creatures (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House).

@graph.rdfs:label: GeoCircle
@graph.name: GeoCircle
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A GeoCircle is a GeoShape representing a circular geographic area. As it is a GeoShape
          it provides the simple textual property 'circle', but also allows the combination of postalCode alongside geoRadius.
          The center of the circle can be indicated via the 'geoMidpoint' property, or more approximately using 'address', 'postalCode'.

@graph.rdfs:label: size
@graph.name: size
@graph.rdfs:comment: A standardized size of a product or creative work, specified either through a simple textual string (for example 'XL', '32Wx34L'), a  QuantitativeValue with a unitCode, or a comprehensive and structured [[SizeSpecification]]; in other cases, the [[width]], [[height]], [[depth]] and [[weight]] properties may be more applicable.

@graph.rdfs:label: IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration
@graph.name: IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: IPTC "Digital Source" codes for use with the [[digitalSourceType]] property, providing information about the source for a digital media object. In general these codes are not declared here to be mutually exclusive, although some combinations would be contradictory if applied simultaneously, or might be considered mutually incompatible by upstream maintainers of the definitions. See the IPTC documentation for detailed definitions of all terms.

@graph.rdfs:label: inSupportOf
@graph.name: inSupportOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: Qualification, candidature, degree, application that Thesis supports.

@graph.rdfs:label: mathExpression
@graph.name: mathExpression
@graph.rdfs:comment: A mathematical expression (e.g. 'x^2-3x=0') that may be solved for a specific variable, simplified, or transformed. This can take many formats, e.g. LaTeX, Ascii-Math, or math as you would write with a keyboard.

@graph.rdfs:label: AutomotiveBusiness
@graph.name: AutomotiveBusiness
@graph.rdfs:comment: Car repair, sales, or parts.

@graph.rdfs:label: contentLocation
@graph.name: contentLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The location depicted or described in the content. For example, the location in a photograph or painting.

@graph.rdfs:label: Audiobook
@graph.name: Audiobook
@graph.rdfs:comment: An audiobook.

@graph.rdfs:label: Game
@graph.name: Game
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Game type represents things which are games. These are typically rule-governed recreational activities, e.g. role-playing games in which players assume the role of characters in a fictional setting.

@graph.rdfs:label: trailerWeight
@graph.name: trailerWeight
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The permitted weight of a trailer attached to the vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound
* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

@graph.rdfs:label: additionalProperty
@graph.name: additionalProperty
@graph.rdfs:comment: A property-value pair representing an additional characteristic of the entity, e.g. a product feature or another characteristic for which there is no matching property in schema.org.\n\nNote: Publishers should be aware that applications designed to use specific schema.org properties (e.g. https://schema.org/width, https://schema.org/color, https://schema.org/gtin13, ...) will typically expect such data to be provided using those properties, rather than using the generic property/value mechanism.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanNetworkTier
@graph.name: healthPlanNetworkTier
@graph.rdfs:comment: The tier(s) for this network.

@graph.rdfs:label: deliveryStatus
@graph.name: deliveryStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: New entry added as the package passes through each leg of its journey (from shipment to final delivery).

@graph.rdfs:label: PriceSpecification
@graph.name: PriceSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A structured value representing a price or price range. Typically, only the subclasses of this type are used for markup. It is recommended to use [[MonetaryAmount]] to describe independent amounts of money such as a salary, credit card limits, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: parents
@graph.name: parents
@graph.rdfs:comment: A parents of the person.

@graph.rdfs:label: UserDownloads
@graph.name: UserDownloads
@graph.rdfs:comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

@graph.rdfs:label: holdingArchive
@graph.name: holdingArchive
@graph.rdfs:comment: [[ArchiveOrganization]] that holds, keeps or maintains the [[ArchiveComponent]].

@graph.rdfs:label: travelBans
@graph.name: travelBans
@graph.rdfs:comment: Information about travel bans, e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

@graph.rdfs:label: HealthPlanCostSharingSpecification
@graph.name: HealthPlanCostSharingSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of costs to the patient under a given network or formulary.

@graph.rdfs:label: linkRelationship
@graph.name: linkRelationship
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the relationship type of a Web link.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfFullBathrooms
@graph.name: numberOfFullBathrooms
@graph.rdfs:comment: Number of full bathrooms - The total number of full and ¾ bathrooms in an [[Accommodation]]. This corresponds to the [BathroomsFull field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsFull+Field).

@graph.rdfs:label: includedInHealthInsurancePlan
@graph.name: includedInHealthInsurancePlan
@graph.rdfs:comment: The insurance plans that cover this drug.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanNetworkId
@graph.name: healthPlanNetworkId
@graph.rdfs:comment: Name or unique ID of network. (Networks are often reused across different insurance plans.)

@graph.rdfs:label: result
@graph.name: result
@graph.rdfs:comment: The result produced in the action. E.g. John wrote *a book*.

@graph.rdfs:label: InformAction
@graph.name: InformAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of notifying someone of information pertinent to them, with no expectation of a response.

@graph.rdfs:label: gettingTestedInfo
@graph.name: gettingTestedInfo
@graph.rdfs:comment: Information about getting tested (for a [[MedicalCondition]]), e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

@graph.rdfs:label: GenderType
@graph.name: GenderType
@graph.rdfs:comment: An enumeration of genders.

@graph.rdfs:label: OfficeEquipmentStore
@graph.name: OfficeEquipmentStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: An office equipment store.

@graph.rdfs:label: WebAPI
@graph.name: WebAPI
@graph.rdfs:comment: An application programming interface accessible over Web/Internet technologies.

@graph.rdfs:label: byMonth
@graph.name: byMonth
@graph.rdfs:comment: Defines the month(s) of the year on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-12. January is 1.

@graph.rdfs:label: chemicalRole
@graph.name: chemicalRole
@graph.rdfs:comment: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a chemical context.

@graph.rdfs:label: parent
@graph.name: parent
@graph.rdfs:comment: A parent of this person.

@graph.rdfs:label: DanceGroup
@graph.name: DanceGroup
@graph.rdfs:comment: A dance group—for example, the Alvin Ailey Dance Theater or Riverdance.

@graph.rdfs:label: interactivityType
@graph.name: interactivityType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The predominant mode of learning supported by the learning resource. Acceptable values are 'active', 'expositive', or 'mixed'.

@graph.rdfs:label: LifestyleModification
@graph.name: LifestyleModification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A process of care involving exercise, changes to diet, fitness routines, and other lifestyle changes aimed at improving a health condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationCommences
@graph.name: legislationCommences
@graph.rdfs:comment: Another legislation that this one sets into force.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastServiceTier
@graph.name: broadcastServiceTier
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of service required to have access to the channel (e.g. Standard or Premium).

@graph.rdfs:label: byMonthDay
@graph.name: byMonthDay
@graph.rdfs:comment: Defines the day(s) of the month on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-31.

@graph.rdfs:label: infectiousAgent
@graph.name: infectiousAgent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The actual infectious agent, such as a specific bacterium.

@graph.rdfs:label: width
@graph.name: width
@graph.rdfs:comment: The width of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: HobbyShop
@graph.name: HobbyShop
@graph.rdfs:comment: A store that sells materials useful or necessary for various hobbies.

@graph.rdfs:label: exifData
@graph.name: exifData
@graph.rdfs:comment: exif data for this object.

@graph.rdfs:label: organizer
@graph.name: organizer
@graph.rdfs:comment: An organizer of an Event.

@graph.rdfs:label: validFor
@graph.name: validFor
@graph.rdfs:comment: The duration of validity of a permit or similar thing.

@graph.rdfs:label: printEdition
@graph.name: printEdition
@graph.rdfs:comment: The edition of the print product in which the NewsArticle appears.

@graph.rdfs:label: loanPaymentAmount
@graph.name: loanPaymentAmount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The amount of money to pay in a single payment.

@graph.rdfs:label: suggestedMeasurement
@graph.name: suggestedMeasurement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A suggested range of body measurements for the intended audience or person, for example inseam between 32 and 34 inches or height between 170 and 190 cm. Typically found on a size chart for wearable products.

@graph.rdfs:label: PublicationEvent
@graph.name: PublicationEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: A PublicationEvent corresponds indifferently to the event of publication for a CreativeWork of any type, e.g. a broadcast event, an on-demand event, a book/journal publication via a variety of delivery media.

@graph.rdfs:label: valueReference
@graph.name: valueReference
@graph.rdfs:comment: A secondary value that provides additional information on the original value, e.g. a reference temperature or a type of measurement.

@graph.rdfs:label: paymentStatus
@graph.name: paymentStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The status of payment; whether the invoice has been paid or not.

@graph.rdfs:label: ResumeAction
@graph.name: ResumeAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of resuming a device or application which was formerly paused (e.g. resume music playback or resume a timer).

@graph.rdfs:label: issuedThrough
@graph.name: issuedThrough
@graph.rdfs:comment: The service through which the permit was granted.

@graph.rdfs:label: ChemicalSubstance
@graph.name: ChemicalSubstance
@graph.rdfs:comment: A chemical substance is 'a portion of matter of constant composition, composed of molecular entities of the same type or of different types' (source: [ChEBI:59999](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/searchId.do?chebiId=59999)).

@graph.rdfs:label: orderDelivery
@graph.name: orderDelivery
@graph.rdfs:comment: The delivery of the parcel related to this order or order item.

@graph.rdfs:label: estimatedCost
@graph.name: estimatedCost
@graph.rdfs:comment: The estimated cost of the supply or supplies consumed when performing instructions.

@graph.rdfs:label: ToyStore
@graph.name: ToyStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A toy store.

@graph.rdfs:label: NutritionInformation
@graph.name: NutritionInformation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Nutritional information about the recipe.

@graph.rdfs:label: State
@graph.name: State
@graph.rdfs:comment: A state or province of a country.

@graph.rdfs:label: BedType
@graph.name: BedType
@graph.rdfs:comment: A type of bed. This is used for indicating the bed or beds available in an accommodation.

@graph.rdfs:label: GovernmentOrganization
@graph.name: GovernmentOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: A governmental organization or agency.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationRepeals
@graph.name: legislationRepeals
@graph.rdfs:comment: Another legislation that this legislation repeals (cancels, abrogates).

@graph.rdfs:label: AdultOrientedEnumeration
@graph.name: AdultOrientedEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumeration of considerations that make a product relevant or potentially restricted for adults only.

@graph.rdfs:label: gender
@graph.name: gender
@graph.rdfs:comment: Gender of something, typically a [[Person]], but possibly also fictional characters, animals, etc. While https://schema.org/Male and https://schema.org/Female may be used, text strings are also acceptable for people who are not a binary gender. The [[gender]] property can also be used in an extended sense to cover e.g. the gender of sports teams. As with the gender of individuals, we do not try to enumerate all possibilities. A mixed-gender [[SportsTeam]] can be indicated with a text value of "Mixed".

@graph.rdfs:label: postalCodeBegin
@graph.name: postalCodeBegin
@graph.rdfs:comment: First postal code in a range (included).

@graph.rdfs:label: Consortium
@graph.name: Consortium
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Consortium is a membership [[Organization]] whose members are typically Organizations.

@graph.rdfs:label: Diet
@graph.name: Diet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A strategy of regulating the intake of food to achieve or maintain a specific health-related goal.

@graph.rdfs:label: DrugPregnancyCategory
@graph.name: DrugPregnancyCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Categories that represent an assessment of the risk of fetal injury due to a drug or pharmaceutical used as directed by the mother during pregnancy.

@graph.rdfs:label: departureTime
@graph.name: departureTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The expected departure time.

@graph.rdfs:label: IndividualProduct
@graph.name: IndividualProduct
@graph.rdfs:comment: A single, identifiable product instance (e.g. a laptop with a particular serial number).

@graph.rdfs:label: ArchiveComponent
@graph.name: ArchiveComponent
@graph.rdfs:comment: An intangible type to be applied to any archive content, carrying with it a set of properties required to describe archival items and collections.

@graph.rdfs:label: xpath
@graph.name: xpath
@graph.rdfs:comment: An XPath, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

@graph.rdfs:label: beforeMedia
@graph.name: beforeMedia
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media object representing the circumstances before performing this direction.

@graph.rdfs:label: AddAction
@graph.name: AddAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of editing by adding an object to a collection.

@graph.rdfs:label: ProductModel
@graph.name: ProductModel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A datasheet or vendor specification of a product (in the sense of a prototypical description).

@graph.rdfs:label: partOfSeries
@graph.name: partOfSeries
@graph.rdfs:comment: The series to which this episode or season belongs.

@graph.rdfs:label: tracks
@graph.name: tracks
@graph.rdfs:comment: A music recording (track)—usually a single song.

@graph.rdfs:label: HVACBusiness
@graph.name: HVACBusiness
@graph.rdfs:comment: A business that provides Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning services.

@graph.rdfs:label: pagination
@graph.name: pagination
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any description of pages that is not separated into pageStart and pageEnd; for example, "1-6, 9, 55" or "10-12, 46-49".

@graph.rdfs:label: USNonprofitType
@graph.name: USNonprofitType
@graph.rdfs:comment: USNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the United States.

@graph.rdfs:label: releaseNotes
@graph.name: releaseNotes
@graph.rdfs:comment: Description of what changed in this version.

@graph.rdfs:label: SurgicalProcedure
@graph.name: SurgicalProcedure
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical procedure involving an incision with instruments; performed for diagnose, or therapeutic purposes.

@graph.rdfs:label: HairSalon
@graph.name: HairSalon
@graph.rdfs:comment: A hair salon.

@graph.rdfs:label: customerRemorseReturnFees
@graph.name: customerRemorseReturnFees
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of return fees if the product is returned due to customer remorse.

@graph.rdfs:label: Electrician
@graph.name: Electrician
@graph.rdfs:comment: An electrician.

@graph.rdfs:label: partOfTVSeries
@graph.name: partOfTVSeries
@graph.rdfs:comment: The TV series to which this episode or season belongs.

@graph.rdfs:label: sha256
@graph.name: sha256
@graph.rdfs:comment: The [SHA-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-2) SHA256 hash of the content of the item. For example, a zero-length input has value 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'.

@graph.rdfs:label: benefitsSummaryUrl
@graph.name: benefitsSummaryUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: The URL that goes directly to the summary of benefits and coverage for the specific standard plan or plan variation.

@graph.rdfs:label: sportsEvent
@graph.name: sportsEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of location. The sports event where this action occurred.

@graph.rdfs:label: amountOfThisGood
@graph.name: amountOfThisGood
@graph.rdfs:comment: The quantity of the goods included in the offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: printPage
@graph.name: printPage
