@graph.rdfs:comment: If this NewsArticle appears in print, this field indicates the name of the page on which the article is found. Please note that this field is intended for the exact page name (e.g. A5, B18).

@graph.rdfs:label: answerCount
@graph.name: answerCount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of answers this question has received.

@graph.rdfs:label: Bakery
@graph.name: Bakery
@graph.rdfs:comment: A bakery.

@graph.rdfs:label: typicalTest
@graph.name: typicalTest
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical test typically performed given this condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: vehicleTransmission
@graph.name: vehicleTransmission
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of component used for transmitting the power from a rotating power source to the wheels or other relevant component(s) ("gearbox" for cars).

@graph.rdfs:label: ParkingFacility
@graph.name: ParkingFacility
@graph.rdfs:comment: A parking lot or other parking facility.

@graph.rdfs:label: Patient
@graph.name: Patient
@graph.rdfs:comment: A patient is any person recipient of health care services.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasEnergyEfficiencyCategory
@graph.name: hasEnergyEfficiencyCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Defines the energy efficiency Category (which could be either a rating out of range of values or a yes/no certification) for a product according to an international energy efficiency standard.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalCondition
@graph.name: MedicalCondition
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any condition of the human body that affects the normal functioning of a person, whether physically or mentally. Includes diseases, injuries, disabilities, disorders, syndromes, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: UKNonprofitType
@graph.name: UKNonprofitType
@graph.rdfs:comment: UKNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the United Kingdom.

@graph.rdfs:label: tissueSample
@graph.name: tissueSample
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of tissue sample required for the test.

@graph.rdfs:label: OccupationalExperienceRequirements
@graph.name: OccupationalExperienceRequirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates employment-related experience requirements, e.g. [[monthsOfExperience]].

@graph.rdfs:label: healthcareReportingData
@graph.name: healthcareReportingData
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates data describing a hospital, e.g. a CDC [[CDCPMDRecord]] or as some kind of [[Dataset]].

@graph.rdfs:label: alumni
@graph.name: alumni
@graph.rdfs:comment: Alumni of an organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: procedure
@graph.name: procedure
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the procedure involved in setting up, using, and/or installing the device.

@graph.rdfs:label: BookStore
@graph.name: BookStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A bookstore.

@graph.rdfs:label: programName
@graph.name: programName
@graph.rdfs:comment: The program providing the membership. It is preferable to use [:program](https://schema.org/program) instead.

@graph.rdfs:label: Thing
@graph.name: Thing
@graph.rdfs:comment: The most generic type of item.

@graph.rdfs:label: ShoeStore
@graph.name: ShoeStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A shoe store.

@graph.rdfs:label: mediaAuthenticityCategory
@graph.name: mediaAuthenticityCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration classification of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared).

@graph.rdfs:label: coverageEndTime
@graph.name: coverageEndTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The time when the live blog will stop covering the Event. Note that coverage may continue after the Event concludes.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalSpecialty
@graph.name: MedicalSpecialty
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any specific branch of medical science or practice. Medical specialities include clinical specialties that pertain to particular organ systems and their respective disease states, as well as allied health specialties. Enumerated type.

@graph.rdfs:label: SaleEvent
@graph.name: SaleEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Sales event.

@graph.rdfs:label: ExerciseGym
@graph.name: ExerciseGym
@graph.rdfs:comment: A gym.

@graph.rdfs:label: OrderAction
@graph.name: OrderAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: An agent orders an object/product/service to be delivered/sent.

@graph.rdfs:label: InfectiousDisease
@graph.name: InfectiousDisease
@graph.rdfs:comment: An infectious disease is a clinically evident human disease resulting from the presence of pathogenic microbial agents, like pathogenic viruses, pathogenic bacteria, fungi, protozoa, multicellular parasites, and prions. To be considered an infectious disease, such pathogens are known to be able to cause this disease.

@graph.rdfs:label: homeLocation
@graph.name: homeLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A contact location for a person's residence.

@graph.rdfs:label: UserCheckins
@graph.name: UserCheckins
@graph.rdfs:comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

@graph.rdfs:label: alignmentType
@graph.name: alignmentType
@graph.rdfs:comment: A category of alignment between the learning resource and the framework node. Recommended values include: 'requires', 'textComplexity', 'readingLevel', and 'educationalSubject'.

@graph.rdfs:label: AudioObject
@graph.name: AudioObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: An audio file.

@graph.rdfs:label: certificationIdentification
@graph.name: certificationIdentification
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifier of a certification instance (as registered with an independent certification body). Typically this identifier can be used to consult and verify the certification instance. See also [gs1:certificationIdentification](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationIdentification).

@graph.rdfs:label: BioChemEntity
@graph.name: BioChemEntity
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any biological, chemical, or biochemical thing. For example: a protein; a gene; a chemical; a synthetic chemical.

@graph.rdfs:label: program
@graph.name: program
@graph.rdfs:comment: The [MemberProgram](https://schema.org/MemberProgram) associated with a [ProgramMembership](https://schema.org/ProgramMembership).

@graph.rdfs:label: itemCondition
@graph.name: itemCondition
@graph.rdfs:comment: A predefined value from OfferItemCondition specifying the condition of the product or service, or the products or services included in the offer. Also used for product return policies to specify the condition of products accepted for returns.

@graph.rdfs:label: fiberContent
@graph.name: fiberContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of grams of fiber.

@graph.rdfs:label: ShippingRateSettings
@graph.name: ShippingRateSettings
@graph.rdfs:comment: A ShippingRateSettings represents re-usable pieces of shipping information. It is designed for publication on an URL that may be referenced via the [[shippingSettingsLink]] property of an [[OfferShippingDetails]]. Several occurrences can be published, distinguished and matched (i.e. identified/referenced) by their different values for [[shippingLabel]].

@graph.rdfs:label: Hostel
@graph.name: Hostel
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A hostel - cheap accommodation, often in shared dormitories.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

@graph.rdfs:label: workPresented
@graph.name: workPresented
@graph.rdfs:comment: The movie presented during this event.

@graph.rdfs:label: suggestedGender
@graph.name: suggestedGender
@graph.rdfs:comment: The suggested gender of the intended person or audience, for example "male", "female", or "unisex".

@graph.rdfs:label: School
@graph.name: School
@graph.rdfs:comment: A school.

@graph.rdfs:label: serviceArea
@graph.name: serviceArea
@graph.rdfs:comment: The geographic area where the service is provided.

@graph.rdfs:label: Campground
@graph.name: Campground
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A camping site, campsite, or [[Campground]] is a place used for overnight stay in the outdoors, typically containing individual [[CampingPitch]] locations. \n\n
In British English a campsite is an area, usually divided into a number of pitches, where people can camp overnight using tents or camper vans or caravans; this British English use of the word is synonymous with the American English expression campground. In American English the term campsite generally means an area where an individual, family, group, or military unit can pitch a tent or park a camper; a campground may contain many campsites (source: Wikipedia, see [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Campsite](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Campsite)).\n\n

See also the dedicated [document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations](/docs/hotels.html).

@graph.rdfs:label: mediaItemAppearance
@graph.name: mediaItemAppearance
@graph.rdfs:comment: In the context of a [[MediaReview]], indicates specific media item(s) that are grouped using a [[MediaReviewItem]].

@graph.rdfs:label: musicReleaseFormat
@graph.name: musicReleaseFormat
@graph.rdfs:comment: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: leaseLength
@graph.name: leaseLength
@graph.rdfs:comment: Length of the lease for some [[Accommodation]], either particular to some [[Offer]] or in some cases intrinsic to the property.

@graph.rdfs:label: itemShipped
@graph.name: itemShipped
@graph.rdfs:comment: Item(s) being shipped.

@graph.rdfs:label: Energy
@graph.name: Energy
@graph.rdfs:comment: Properties that take Energy as values are of the form '<Number> <Energy unit of measure>'.

@graph.rdfs:label: offerCount
@graph.name: offerCount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of offers for the product.

@graph.rdfs:label: UnRegisterAction
@graph.name: UnRegisterAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of un-registering from a service.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: antonym of UnRegisterAction.
* [[LeaveAction]]: Unlike LeaveAction, UnRegisterAction implies that you are unregistering from a service you were previously registered, rather than leaving a team/group of people.

@graph.rdfs:label: LoseAction
@graph.name: LoseAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of being defeated in a competitive activity.

@graph.rdfs:label: relevantSpecialty
@graph.name: relevantSpecialty
@graph.rdfs:comment: If applicable, a medical specialty in which this entity is relevant.

@graph.rdfs:label: typeOfBed
@graph.name: typeOfBed
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of bed to which the BedDetail refers, i.e. the type of bed available in the quantity indicated by quantity.

@graph.rdfs:label: WatchAction
@graph.name: WatchAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of consuming dynamic/moving visual content.

@graph.rdfs:label: suitableForDiet
@graph.name: suitableForDiet
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a dietary restriction or guideline for which this recipe or menu item is suitable, e.g. diabetic, halal etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: VisualArtsEvent
@graph.name: VisualArtsEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Visual arts event.

@graph.rdfs:label: status
@graph.name: status
@graph.rdfs:comment: The status of the study (enumerated).

@graph.rdfs:label: specialOpeningHoursSpecification
@graph.name: specialOpeningHoursSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: The special opening hours of a certain place.\n\nUse this to explicitly override general opening hours brought in scope by [[openingHoursSpecification]] or [[openingHours]].

@graph.rdfs:label: featureList
@graph.name: featureList
@graph.rdfs:comment: Features or modules provided by this application (and possibly required by other applications).

@graph.rdfs:label: ConsumeAction
@graph.name: ConsumeAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of ingesting information/resources/food.

@graph.rdfs:label: BedDetails
@graph.name: BedDetails
@graph.rdfs:comment: An entity holding detailed information about the available bed types, e.g. the quantity of twin beds for a hotel room. For the single case of just one bed of a certain type, you can use bed directly with a text. See also [[BedType]] (under development).

@graph.rdfs:label: MerchantReturnEnumeration
@graph.name: MerchantReturnEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates several kinds of product return policies.

@graph.rdfs:label: Substance
@graph.name: Substance
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any matter of defined composition that has discrete existence, whose origin may be biological, mineral or chemical.

@graph.rdfs:label: Bone
@graph.name: Bone
@graph.rdfs:comment: Rigid connective tissue that comprises up the skeletal structure of the human body.

@graph.rdfs:label: EmergencyService
@graph.name: EmergencyService
@graph.rdfs:comment: An emergency service, such as a fire station or ER.

@graph.rdfs:label: Quotation
@graph.name: Quotation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A quotation. Often but not necessarily from some written work, attributable to a real world author and - if associated with a fictional character - to any fictional Person. Use [[isBasedOn]] to link to source/origin. The [[recordedIn]] property can be used to reference a Quotation from an [[Event]].

@graph.rdfs:label: includesHealthPlanFormulary
@graph.name: includesHealthPlanFormulary
@graph.rdfs:comment: Formularies covered by this plan.

@graph.rdfs:label: Cooperative
@graph.name: Cooperative
@graph.rdfs:comment: An organization that is a joint project of multiple organizations or persons.

@graph.rdfs:label: GeoShape
@graph.name: GeoShape
@graph.rdfs:comment: The geographic shape of a place. A GeoShape can be described using several properties whose values are based on latitude/longitude pairs. Either whitespace or commas can be used to separate latitude and longitude; whitespace should be used when writing a list of several such points.

@graph.rdfs:label: videoFrameSize
@graph.name: videoFrameSize
@graph.rdfs:comment: The frame size of the video.

@graph.rdfs:label: arrivalAirport
@graph.name: arrivalAirport
@graph.rdfs:comment: The airport where the flight terminates.

@graph.rdfs:label: dateline
@graph.name: dateline
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A [dateline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dateline) is a brief piece of text included in news articles that describes where and when the story was written or filed though the date is often omitted. Sometimes only a placename is provided.

Structured representations of dateline-related information can also be expressed more explicitly using [[locationCreated]] (which represents where a work was created, e.g. where a news report was written).  For location depicted or described in the content, use [[contentLocation]].

Dateline summaries are oriented more towards human readers than towards automated processing, and can vary substantially. Some examples: "BEIRUT, Lebanon, June 2.", "Paris, France", "December 19, 2017 11:43AM Reporting from Washington", "Beijing/Moscow", "QUEZON CITY, Philippines".

@graph.rdfs:label: deliveryTime
@graph.name: deliveryTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The total delay between the receipt of the order and the goods reaching the final customer.

@graph.rdfs:label: keywords
@graph.name: keywords
@graph.rdfs:comment: Keywords or tags used to describe some item. Multiple textual entries in a keywords list are typically delimited by commas, or by repeating the property.

@graph.rdfs:label: error
@graph.name: error
@graph.rdfs:comment: For failed actions, more information on the cause of the failure. Consider using the Error type.

@graph.rdfs:label: verificationFactCheckingPolicy
@graph.name: verificationFactCheckingPolicy
@graph.rdfs:comment: Disclosure about verification and fact-checking processes for a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other fact-checking [[Organization]].

@graph.rdfs:label: foodWarning
@graph.name: foodWarning
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of specific foods while taking this drug.

@graph.rdfs:label: JoinAction
@graph.name: JoinAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An agent joins an event/group with participants/friends at a location.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, JoinAction refers to joining a group/team of people.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, JoinAction does not imply that you'll be receiving updates.
* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, JoinAction does not imply that you'll be polling for updates.

@graph.rdfs:label: constraintProperty
@graph.name: constraintProperty
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a property used as a constraint. For example, in the definition of a [[StatisticalVariable]]. The value is a property, either from within Schema.org or from other compatible (e.g. RDF) systems such as DataCommons.org or Wikidata.org.

@graph.rdfs:label: WholesaleStore
@graph.name: WholesaleStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A wholesale store.

@graph.rdfs:label: vehicleSeatingCapacity
@graph.name: vehicleSeatingCapacity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of passengers that can be seated in the vehicle, both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

@graph.rdfs:label: NewsArticle
@graph.name: NewsArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A NewsArticle is an article whose content reports news, or provides background context and supporting materials for understanding the news.

A more detailed overview of [schema.org News markup](/docs/news.html) is also available.

@graph.rdfs:label: TaxiReservation
@graph.name: TaxiReservation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reservation for a taxi.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

@graph.rdfs:label: taxID
@graph.name: taxID
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Tax / Fiscal ID of the organization or person, e.g. the TIN in the US or the CIF/NIF in Spain.

@graph.rdfs:label: AlignmentObject
@graph.name: AlignmentObject
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An intangible item that describes an alignment between a learning resource and a node in an educational framework.
Should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource [[teaches]] or [[assesses]] a competency.

@graph.rdfs:label: CheckInAction
@graph.name: CheckInAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of an agent communicating (service provider, social media, etc) their arrival by registering/confirming for a previously reserved service (e.g. flight check-in) or at a place (e.g. hotel), possibly resulting in a result (boarding pass, etc).

Related actions:

* [[CheckOutAction]]: The antonym of CheckInAction.
* [[ArriveAction]]: Unlike ArriveAction, CheckInAction implies that the agent is informing/confirming the start of a previously reserved service.
* [[ConfirmAction]]: Unlike ConfirmAction, CheckInAction implies that the agent is informing/confirming the *start* of a previously reserved service rather than its validity/existence.

@graph.rdfs:label: purchasePriceLimit
@graph.name: purchasePriceLimit
@graph.rdfs:comment: Optional. The maximum price the item can have and still qualify for this offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: SportingGoodsStore
@graph.name: SportingGoodsStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sporting goods store.

@graph.rdfs:label: RefundTypeEnumeration
@graph.name: RefundTypeEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates several kinds of product return refund types.

@graph.rdfs:label: ActionStatusType
@graph.name: ActionStatusType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The status of an Action.

@graph.rdfs:label: petsAllowed
@graph.name: petsAllowed
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether pets are allowed to enter the accommodation or lodging business. More detailed information can be put in a text value.

@graph.rdfs:label: albums
@graph.name: albums
@graph.rdfs:comment: A collection of music albums.

@graph.rdfs:label: distribution
@graph.name: distribution
@graph.rdfs:comment: A downloadable form of this dataset, at a specific location, in a specific format. This property can be repeated if different variations are available. There is no expectation that different downloadable distributions must contain exactly equivalent information (see also [DCAT](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/#Class:Distribution) on this point). Different distributions might include or exclude different subsets of the entire dataset, for example.

@graph.rdfs:label: line
@graph.name: line
@graph.rdfs:comment: A line is a point-to-point path consisting of two or more points. A line is expressed as a series of two or more point objects separated by space.

@graph.rdfs:label: IncentiveQualifiedExpenseType
@graph.name: IncentiveQualifiedExpenseType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The types of expenses that are covered by the incentive. For example some incentives are only for the goods (tangible items) but the services (labor) are excluded.

@graph.rdfs:label: SeaBodyOfWater
@graph.name: SeaBodyOfWater
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sea (for example, the Caspian sea).

@graph.rdfs:label: Specialty
@graph.name: Specialty
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any branch of a field in which people typically develop specific expertise, usually after significant study, time, and effort.

@graph.rdfs:label: serviceAudience
@graph.name: serviceAudience
@graph.rdfs:comment: The audience eligible for this service.

@graph.rdfs:label: procedureType
@graph.name: procedureType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of procedure, for example Surgical, Noninvasive, or Percutaneous.

@graph.rdfs:label: MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride
@graph.name: MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride
@graph.rdfs:comment: A seasonal override of a return policy, for example used for holidays.

@graph.rdfs:label: map
@graph.name: map
@graph.rdfs:comment: A URL to a map of the place.

@graph.rdfs:label: Pond
@graph.name: Pond
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pond.

@graph.rdfs:label: downPayment
@graph.name: downPayment
@graph.rdfs:comment: a type of payment made in cash during the onset of the purchase of an expensive good/service. The payment typically represents only a percentage of the full purchase price.

@graph.rdfs:label: carbohydrateContent
@graph.name: carbohydrateContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of grams of carbohydrates.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcaster
@graph.name: broadcaster
@graph.rdfs:comment: The organization owning or operating the broadcast service.

@graph.rdfs:label: requiredQuantity
@graph.name: requiredQuantity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The required quantity of the item(s).

@graph.rdfs:label: artEdition
@graph.name: artEdition
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of copies when multiple copies of a piece of artwork are produced - e.g. for a limited edition of 20 prints, 'artEdition' refers to the total number of copies (in this example "20").

@graph.rdfs:label: businessFunction
@graph.name: businessFunction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The business function (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose) of the offer or component of a bundle (TypeAndQuantityNode). The default is http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.

@graph.rdfs:label: TypeAndQuantityNode
@graph.name: TypeAndQuantityNode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A structured value indicating the quantity, unit of measurement, and business function of goods included in a bundle offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: accessibilitySummary
@graph.name: accessibilitySummary
@graph.rdfs:comment: A human-readable summary of specific accessibility features or deficiencies, consistent with the other accessibility metadata but expressing subtleties such as "short descriptions are present but long descriptions will be needed for non-visual users" or "short descriptions are present and no long descriptions are needed".

@graph.rdfs:label: photo
@graph.name: photo
@graph.rdfs:comment: A photograph of this place.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumICUBedsOcc
@graph.name: cvdNumICUBedsOcc
@graph.rdfs:comment: numicubedsocc - ICU BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient ICU beds that are occupied.

@graph.rdfs:label: targetDescription
@graph.name: targetDescription
@graph.rdfs:comment: The description of a node in an established educational framework.

@graph.rdfs:label: NewsMediaOrganization
@graph.name: NewsMediaOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: A News/Media organization such as a newspaper or TV station.

@graph.rdfs:label: publishingPrinciples
@graph.name: publishingPrinciples
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The publishingPrinciples property indicates (typically via [[URL]]) a document describing the editorial principles of an [[Organization]] (or individual, e.g. a [[Person]] writing a blog) that relate to their activities as a publisher, e.g. ethics or diversity policies. When applied to a [[CreativeWork]] (e.g. [[NewsArticle]]) the principles are those of the party primarily responsible for the creation of the [[CreativeWork]].

While such policies are most typically expressed in natural language, sometimes related information (e.g. indicating a [[funder]]) can be expressed using schema.org terminology.

@graph.rdfs:label: correctionsPolicy
@graph.name: correctionsPolicy
@graph.rdfs:comment: For an [[Organization]] (e.g. [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement describing (in news media, the newsroom’s) disclosure and correction policy for errors.

@graph.rdfs:label: applicableCountry
@graph.name: applicableCountry
@graph.rdfs:comment: A country where a particular merchant return policy applies to, for example the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

@graph.rdfs:label: publisher
@graph.name: publisher
@graph.rdfs:comment: The publisher of the article in question.

@graph.rdfs:label: Seat
@graph.name: Seat
@graph.rdfs:comment: Used to describe a seat, such as a reserved seat in an event reservation.

@graph.rdfs:label: manufacturer
@graph.name: manufacturer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The manufacturer of the product.

@graph.rdfs:label: FindAction
@graph.name: FindAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of finding an object.

Related actions:

* [[SearchAction]]: FindAction is generally lead by a SearchAction, but not necessarily.

@graph.rdfs:label: EventAttendanceModeEnumeration
@graph.name: EventAttendanceModeEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: An EventAttendanceModeEnumeration value is one of potentially several modes of organising an event, relating to whether it is online or offline.

@graph.rdfs:label: characterAttribute
@graph.name: characterAttribute
@graph.rdfs:comment: A piece of data that represents a particular aspect of a fictional character (skill, power, character points, advantage, disadvantage).

@graph.rdfs:label: BusStop
@graph.name: BusStop
@graph.rdfs:comment: A bus stop.

@graph.rdfs:label: Boolean
@graph.name: Boolean
@graph.rdfs:comment: Boolean: True or False.

@graph.rdfs:label: IndividualPhysician
@graph.name: IndividualPhysician
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An individual medical practitioner. For their official address use [[address]], for affiliations to hospitals use [[hospitalAffiliation]]. 
The [[practicesAt]] property can be used to indicate [[MedicalOrganization]] hospitals, clinics, pharmacies etc. where this physician practices.

@graph.rdfs:label: VideoObject
@graph.name: VideoObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: A video file.

@graph.rdfs:label: EndorseAction
@graph.name: EndorseAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: An agent approves/certifies/likes/supports/sanctions an object.

@graph.rdfs:label: ViewAction
@graph.name: ViewAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of consuming static visual content.

@graph.rdfs:label: availability
@graph.name: availability
@graph.rdfs:comment: The availability of this item—for example In stock, Out of stock, Pre-order, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: ChildrensEvent
@graph.name: ChildrensEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Children's event.

@graph.rdfs:label: engineDisplacement
@graph.name: engineDisplacement
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The volume swept by all of the pistons inside the cylinders of an internal combustion engine in a single movement. 

Typical unit code(s): CMQ for cubic centimeter, LTR for liters, INQ for cubic inches
* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

@graph.rdfs:label: datePublished
@graph.name: datePublished
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalBusiness
@graph.name: MedicalBusiness
@graph.rdfs:comment: A particular physical or virtual business of an organization for medical purposes. Examples of MedicalBusiness include different businesses run by health professionals.

@graph.rdfs:label: PostOffice
@graph.name: PostOffice
@graph.rdfs:comment: A post office.

@graph.rdfs:label: legalName
@graph.name: legalName
@graph.rdfs:comment: The official name of the organization, e.g. the registered company name.

@graph.rdfs:label: liveBlogUpdate
@graph.name: liveBlogUpdate
@graph.rdfs:comment: An update to the LiveBlog.

@graph.rdfs:label: catalogNumber
@graph.name: catalogNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The catalog number for the release.

@graph.rdfs:label: repeatFrequency
@graph.name: repeatFrequency
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Defines the frequency at which [[Event]]s will occur according to a schedule [[Schedule]]. The intervals between
      events should be defined as a [[Duration]] of time.

@graph.rdfs:label: member
@graph.name: member
@graph.rdfs:comment: A member of an Organization or a ProgramMembership. Organizations can be members of organizations; ProgramMembership is typically for individuals.

@graph.rdfs:label: applicationSubCategory
@graph.name: applicationSubCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Subcategory of the application, e.g. 'Arcade Game'.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanCopayOption
@graph.name: healthPlanCopayOption
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether the copay is before or after deductible, etc. TODO: Is this a closed set?

@graph.rdfs:label: timestamp
@graph.name: timestamp
@graph.rdfs:comment: The instant the event occured.

@graph.rdfs:label: fileSize
@graph.name: fileSize
@graph.rdfs:comment: Size of the application / package (e.g. 18MB). In the absence of a unit (MB, KB etc.), KB will be assumed.

@graph.rdfs:label: authenticator
@graph.name: authenticator
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Organization responsible for authenticating the user's subscription. For example, many media apps require a cable/satellite provider to authenticate your subscription before playing media.

@graph.rdfs:label: artist
@graph.name: artist
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The primary artist for a work
    	in a medium other than pencils or digital line art--for example, if the
    	primary artwork is done in watercolors or digital paints.

@graph.rdfs:label: paymentDueDate
@graph.name: paymentDueDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date that payment is due.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationChanges
@graph.name: legislationChanges
@graph.rdfs:comment: Another legislation that this legislation changes. This encompasses the notions of amendment, replacement, correction, repeal, or other types of change. This may be a direct change (textual or non-textual amendment) or a consequential or indirect change. The property is to be used to express the existence of a change relationship between two acts rather than the existence of a consolidated version of the text that shows the result of the change. For consolidation relationships, use the legislationConsolidates property.

@graph.rdfs:label: tributary
@graph.name: tributary
@graph.rdfs:comment: The anatomical or organ system that the vein flows into; a larger structure that the vein connects to.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasBioPolymerSequence
@graph.name: hasBioPolymerSequence
@graph.rdfs:comment: A symbolic representation of a BioChemEntity. For example, a nucleotide sequence of a Gene or an amino acid sequence of a Protein.

@graph.rdfs:label: MerchantReturnPolicy
@graph.name: MerchantReturnPolicy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A MerchantReturnPolicy provides information about product return policies associated with an [[Organization]], [[Product]], or [[Offer]].

@graph.rdfs:label: Church
@graph.name: Church
@graph.rdfs:comment: A church.

@graph.rdfs:label: composer
@graph.name: composer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The person or organization who wrote a composition, or who is the composer of a work performed at some event.

@graph.rdfs:label: SchoolDistrict
@graph.name: SchoolDistrict
@graph.rdfs:comment: A School District is an administrative area for the administration of schools.

@graph.rdfs:label: fuelConsumption
@graph.name: fuelConsumption
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The amount of fuel consumed for traveling a particular distance or temporal duration with the given vehicle (e.g. liters per 100 km).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for liters per 100 km.  Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. L/100 km.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel consumption to another value.

@graph.rdfs:label: suggestedAnswer
@graph.name: suggestedAnswer
@graph.rdfs:comment: An answer (possibly one of several, possibly incorrect) to a Question, e.g. on a Question/Answer site.

@graph.rdfs:label: EventVenue
@graph.name: EventVenue
@graph.rdfs:comment: An event venue.

@graph.rdfs:label: addressLocality
@graph.name: addressLocality
@graph.rdfs:comment: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. For example, Mountain View.

@graph.rdfs:label: WriteAction
@graph.name: WriteAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of authoring written creative content.

@graph.rdfs:label: depth
@graph.name: depth
@graph.rdfs:comment: The depth of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: safetyConsideration
@graph.name: safetyConsideration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any potential safety concern associated with the supplement. May include interactions with other drugs and foods, pregnancy, breastfeeding, known adverse reactions, and documented efficacy of the supplement.

@graph.rdfs:label: transFatContent
@graph.name: transFatContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of grams of trans fat.

@graph.rdfs:label: aspect
@graph.name: aspect
@graph.rdfs:comment: An aspect of medical practice that is considered on the page, such as 'diagnosis', 'treatment', 'causes', 'prognosis', 'etiology', 'epidemiology', etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: geoMidpoint
@graph.name: geoMidpoint
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the GeoCoordinates at the centre of a GeoShape, e.g. GeoCircle.

@graph.rdfs:label: NailSalon
@graph.name: NailSalon
@graph.rdfs:comment: A nail salon.

@graph.rdfs:label: menu
@graph.name: menu
@graph.rdfs:comment: Either the actual menu as a structured representation, as text, or a URL of the menu.

@graph.rdfs:label: MathSolver
@graph.name: MathSolver
@graph.rdfs:comment: A math solver which is capable of solving a subset of mathematical problems.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasDigitalDocumentPermission
@graph.name: hasDigitalDocumentPermission
@graph.rdfs:comment: A permission related to the access to this document (e.g. permission to read or write an electronic document). For a public document, specify a grantee with an Audience with audienceType equal to "public".

@graph.rdfs:label: ElementarySchool
@graph.name: ElementarySchool
@graph.rdfs:comment: An elementary school.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalDevicePurpose
@graph.name: MedicalDevicePurpose
@graph.rdfs:comment: Categories of medical devices, organized by the purpose or intended use of the device.

@graph.rdfs:label: Vein
@graph.name: Vein
@graph.rdfs:comment: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries blood to the heart.

@graph.rdfs:label: OnlineStore
@graph.name: OnlineStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: An eCommerce site.

@graph.rdfs:label: Reservoir
@graph.name: Reservoir
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reservoir of water, typically an artificially created lake, like the Lake Kariba reservoir.

@graph.rdfs:label: Place
@graph.name: Place
@graph.rdfs:comment: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical extension.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasCourseInstance
@graph.name: hasCourseInstance
@graph.rdfs:comment: An offering of the course at a specific time and place or through specific media or mode of study or to a specific section of students.

@graph.rdfs:label: opponent
@graph.name: opponent
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of participant. The opponent on this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: floorLimit
@graph.name: floorLimit
@graph.rdfs:comment: A floor limit is the amount of money above which credit card transactions must be authorized.

@graph.rdfs:label: TreatmentIndication
@graph.name: TreatmentIndication
@graph.rdfs:comment: An indication for treating an underlying condition, symptom, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: noBylinesPolicy
@graph.name: noBylinesPolicy
@graph.rdfs:comment: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other news-related [[Organization]], a statement explaining when authors of articles are not named in bylines.

@graph.rdfs:label: sku
@graph.name: sku
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU), i.e. a merchant-specific identifier for a product or service, or the product to which the offer refers.

@graph.rdfs:label: unnamedSourcesPolicy
@graph.name: unnamedSourcesPolicy
@graph.rdfs:comment: For an [[Organization]] (typically a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement about policy on use of unnamed sources and the decision process required.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasOfferCatalog
@graph.name: hasOfferCatalog
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates an OfferCatalog listing for this Organization, Person, or Service.

@graph.rdfs:label: membershipPointsEarned
@graph.name: membershipPointsEarned
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of membership points earned by the member. If necessary, the unitText can be used to express the units the points are issued in. (E.g. stars, miles, etc.)

@graph.rdfs:label: suggestedMinAge
@graph.name: suggestedMinAge
@graph.rdfs:comment: Minimum recommended age in years for the audience or user.

@graph.rdfs:label: trainingSalary
@graph.name: trainingSalary
@graph.rdfs:comment: The estimated salary earned while in the program.

@graph.rdfs:label: preparation
@graph.name: preparation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Typical preparation that a patient must undergo before having the procedure performed.

@graph.rdfs:label: reviewRating
@graph.name: reviewRating
@graph.rdfs:comment: The rating given in this review. Note that reviews can themselves be rated. The ```reviewRating``` applies to rating given by the review. The [[aggregateRating]] property applies to the review itself, as a creative work.

@graph.rdfs:label: accountOverdraftLimit
@graph.name: accountOverdraftLimit
@graph.rdfs:comment: An overdraft is an extension of credit from a lending institution when an account reaches zero. An overdraft allows the individual to continue withdrawing money even if the account has no funds in it. Basically the bank allows people to borrow a set amount of money.

@graph.rdfs:label: Gene
@graph.name: Gene
@graph.rdfs:comment: A discrete unit of inheritance which affects one or more biological traits (Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene)). Examples include FOXP2 (Forkhead box protein P2), SCARNA21 (small Cajal body-specific RNA 21), A- (agouti genotype).

@graph.rdfs:label: vehicleConfiguration
@graph.name: vehicleConfiguration
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short text indicating the configuration of the vehicle, e.g. '5dr hatchback ST 2.5 MT 225 hp' or 'limited edition'.

@graph.rdfs:label: dropoffTime
@graph.name: dropoffTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: When a rental car can be dropped off.

@graph.rdfs:label: EUEnergyEfficiencyEnumeration
@graph.name: EUEnergyEfficiencyEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates the EU energy efficiency classes A-G as well as A+, A++, and A+++ as defined in EU directive 2017/1369.

@graph.rdfs:label: AnatomicalStructure
@graph.name: AnatomicalStructure
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any part of the human body, typically a component of an anatomical system. Organs, tissues, and cells are all anatomical structures.

@graph.rdfs:label: deliveryMethod
@graph.name: deliveryMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of instrument. The method of delivery.

@graph.rdfs:label: AdvertiserContentArticle
@graph.name: AdvertiserContentArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment: An [[Article]] that an external entity has paid to place or to produce to its specifications. Includes [advertorials](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advertorial), sponsored content, native advertising and other paid content.

@graph.rdfs:label: instrument
@graph.name: instrument
@graph.rdfs:comment: The object that helped the agent perform the action. E.g. John wrote a book with *a pen*.

@graph.rdfs:label: isStoreOn
@graph.name: isStoreOn
@graph.rdfs:comment: The eCommerce marketplace this online store is on.

@graph.rdfs:label: termDuration
@graph.name: termDuration
@graph.rdfs:comment: The amount of time in a term as defined by the institution. A term is a length of time where students take one or more classes. Semesters and quarters are common units for term.

@graph.rdfs:label: volumeNumber
@graph.name: volumeNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifies the volume of publication or multi-part work; for example, "iii" or "2".

@graph.rdfs:label: PostalAddress
@graph.name: PostalAddress
@graph.rdfs:comment: The mailing address.

@graph.rdfs:label: reviewedBy
@graph.name: reviewedBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: People or organizations that have reviewed the content on this web page for accuracy and/or completeness.

@graph.rdfs:label: measurementTechnique
@graph.name: measurementTechnique
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A technique, method or technology used in an [[Observation]], [[StatisticalVariable]] or [[Dataset]] (or [[DataDownload]], [[DataCatalog]]), corresponding to the method used for measuring the corresponding variable(s) (for datasets, described using [[variableMeasured]]; for [[Observation]], a [[StatisticalVariable]]). Often but not necessarily each [[variableMeasured]] will have an explicit representation as (or mapping to) an property such as those defined in Schema.org, or other RDF vocabularies and "knowledge graphs". In that case the subproperty of [[variableMeasured]] called [[measuredProperty]] is applicable.
    
The [[measurementTechnique]] property helps when extra clarification is needed about how a [[measuredProperty]] was measured. This is oriented towards scientific and scholarly dataset publication but may have broader applicability; it is not intended as a full representation of measurement, but can often serve as a high level summary for dataset discovery. 

For example, if [[variableMeasured]] is: molecule concentration, [[measurementTechnique]] could be: "mass spectrometry" or "nmr spectroscopy" or "colorimetry" or "immunofluorescence". If the [[variableMeasured]] is "depression rating", the [[measurementTechnique]] could be "Zung Scale" or "HAM-D" or "Beck Depression Inventory". 

If there are several [[variableMeasured]] properties recorded for some given data object, use a [[PropertyValue]] for each [[variableMeasured]] and attach the corresponding [[measurementTechnique]]. The value can also be from an enumeration, organized as a [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].

@graph.rdfs:label: weight
@graph.name: weight
@graph.rdfs:comment: The weight of the product or person.

@graph.rdfs:label: AggregateRating
@graph.name: AggregateRating
@graph.rdfs:comment: The average rating based on multiple ratings or reviews.

@graph.rdfs:label: ShoppingCenter
@graph.name: ShoppingCenter
@graph.rdfs:comment: A shopping center or mall.

@graph.rdfs:label: CollegeOrUniversity
@graph.name: CollegeOrUniversity
@graph.rdfs:comment: A college, university, or other third-level educational institution.

@graph.rdfs:label: exerciseType
@graph.name: exerciseType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Type(s) of exercise or activity, such as strength training, flexibility training, aerobics, cardiac rehabilitation, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: storageRequirements
@graph.name: storageRequirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: Storage requirements (free space required).

@graph.rdfs:label: yearlyRevenue
@graph.name: yearlyRevenue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The size of the business in annual revenue.

@graph.rdfs:label: DrugLegalStatus
@graph.name: DrugLegalStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The legal availability status of a medical drug.

@graph.rdfs:label: interpretedAsClaim
@graph.name: interpretedAsClaim
@graph.rdfs:comment: Used to indicate a specific claim contained, implied, translated or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. The interpreting party can be indicated using [[claimInterpreter]].

@graph.rdfs:label: bookFormat
@graph.name: bookFormat
@graph.rdfs:comment: The format of the book.

@graph.rdfs:label: AutoPartsStore
@graph.name: AutoPartsStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: An auto parts store.

@graph.rdfs:label: replyToUrl
@graph.name: replyToUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: The URL at which a reply may be posted to the specified UserComment.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastOfEvent
@graph.name: broadcastOfEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The event being broadcast such as a sporting event or awards ceremony.

@graph.rdfs:label: readonlyValue
@graph.name: readonlyValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether or not a property is mutable.  Default is false. Specifying this for a property that also has a value makes it act similar to a "hidden" input in an HTML form.

@graph.rdfs:label: funding
@graph.name: funding
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[Grant]] that directly or indirectly provide funding or sponsorship for this item. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].

@graph.rdfs:label: FoodService
@graph.name: FoodService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A food service, like breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

@graph.rdfs:label: SiteNavigationElement
@graph.name: SiteNavigationElement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A navigation element of the page.

@graph.rdfs:label: maximumEnrollment
@graph.name: maximumEnrollment
@graph.rdfs:comment: The maximum number of students who may be enrolled in the program.

@graph.rdfs:label: CreativeWork
@graph.name: CreativeWork
@graph.rdfs:comment: The most generic kind of creative work, including books, movies, photographs, software programs, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: availableAtOrFrom
@graph.name: availableAtOrFrom
@graph.rdfs:comment: The place(s) from which the offer can be obtained (e.g. store locations).

@graph.rdfs:label: engineType
@graph.name: engineType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of engine or engines powering the vehicle.

@graph.rdfs:label: Movie
@graph.name: Movie
@graph.rdfs:comment: A movie.

@graph.rdfs:label: LocalBusiness
@graph.name: LocalBusiness
@graph.rdfs:comment: A particular physical business or branch of an organization. Examples of LocalBusiness include a restaurant, a particular branch of a restaurant chain, a branch of a bank, a medical practice, a club, a bowling alley, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: ComputerLanguage
@graph.name: ComputerLanguage
@graph.rdfs:comment: This type covers computer programming languages such as Scheme and Lisp, as well as other language-like computer representations. Natural languages are best represented with the [[Language]] type.

@graph.rdfs:label: warranty
@graph.name: warranty
@graph.rdfs:comment: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: ownedThrough
@graph.name: ownedThrough
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date and time of giving up ownership on the product.

@graph.rdfs:label: doseValue
@graph.name: doseValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The value of the dose, e.g. 500.

@graph.rdfs:label: deliveryAddress
@graph.name: deliveryAddress
@graph.rdfs:comment: Destination address.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasEnergyConsumptionDetails
@graph.name: hasEnergyConsumptionDetails
@graph.rdfs:comment: Defines the energy efficiency Category (also known as "class" or "rating") for a product according to an international energy efficiency standard.

@graph.rdfs:label: softwareHelp
@graph.name: softwareHelp
@graph.rdfs:comment: Software application help.

@graph.rdfs:label: location
@graph.name: location
@graph.rdfs:comment: The location of, for example, where an event is happening, where an organization is located, or where an action takes place.

@graph.rdfs:label: GeneralContractor
@graph.name: GeneralContractor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A general contractor.

@graph.rdfs:label: musicGroupMember
@graph.name: musicGroupMember
@graph.rdfs:comment: A member of a music group—for example, John, Paul, George, or Ringo.

@graph.rdfs:label: totalPrice
@graph.name: totalPrice
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The total price for the reservation or ticket, including applicable taxes, shipping, etc.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicineSystem
@graph.name: MedicineSystem
@graph.rdfs:comment: Systems of medical practice.

@graph.rdfs:label: gameServer
@graph.name: gameServer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The server on which  it is possible to play the game.

@graph.rdfs:label: EnergyEfficiencyEnumeration
@graph.name: EnergyEfficiencyEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates energy efficiency levels (also known as "classes" or "ratings") and certifications that are part of several international energy efficiency standards.

@graph.rdfs:label: asin
@graph.name: asin
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) is a 10-character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.com and its partners for product identification within the Amazon organization (summary from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Standard_Identification_Number)'s article).

Note also that this is a definition for how to include ASINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of ASINs in general - see documentation from Amazon for authoritative details.
ASINs are most commonly encoded as text strings, but the [asin] property supports URL/URI as potential values too.

@graph.rdfs:label: Aquarium
@graph.name: Aquarium
@graph.rdfs:comment: Aquarium.

@graph.rdfs:label: video
@graph.name: video
@graph.rdfs:comment: An embedded video object.

@graph.rdfs:label: smokingAllowed
@graph.name: smokingAllowed
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether it is allowed to smoke in the place, e.g. in the restaurant, hotel or hotel room.

@graph.rdfs:label: email
@graph.name: email
@graph.rdfs:comment: Email address.

@graph.rdfs:label: Enumeration
@graph.name: Enumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Lists or enumerations—for example, a list of cuisines or music genres, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: PodcastSeason
@graph.name: PodcastSeason
@graph.rdfs:comment: A single season of a podcast. Many podcasts do not break down into separate seasons. In that case, PodcastSeries should be used.

@graph.rdfs:label: applicationCategory
@graph.name: applicationCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Type of software application, e.g. 'Game, Multimedia'.

@graph.rdfs:label: MediaGallery
@graph.name: MediaGallery
@graph.rdfs:comment: Web page type: Media gallery page. A mixed-media page that can contain media such as images, videos, and other multimedia.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastFrequencyValue
@graph.name: broadcastFrequencyValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The frequency in MHz for a particular broadcast.

@graph.rdfs:label: MemberProgram
@graph.name: MemberProgram
@graph.rdfs:comment: A MemberProgram defines a loyalty (or membership) program that provides its members with certain benefits, for example better pricing, free shipping or returns, or the ability to earn loyalty points. Member programs may have multiple tiers, for example silver and gold members, each with different benefits.

@graph.rdfs:label: Project
@graph.name: Project
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An enterprise (potentially individual but typically collaborative), planned to achieve a particular aim.
Use properties from [[Organization]], [[subOrganization]]/[[parentOrganization]] to indicate project sub-structures.

@graph.rdfs:label: attendee
@graph.name: attendee
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person or organization attending the event.

@graph.rdfs:label: accessibilityAPI
@graph.name: accessibilityAPI
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates that the resource is compatible with the referenced accessibility API. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityAPI-vocabulary).

@graph.rdfs:label: hasTiers
@graph.name: hasTiers
@graph.rdfs:comment: The tiers of a member program.

@graph.rdfs:label: SoftwareApplication
@graph.name: SoftwareApplication
@graph.rdfs:comment: A software application.

@graph.rdfs:label: aggregateElement
@graph.name: aggregateElement
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a prototype of the elements in the list that is used to hold aggregate information (ratings, offers, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: bodyLocation
@graph.name: bodyLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Location in the body of the anatomical structure.

@graph.rdfs:label: OnlineMarketplace
@graph.name: OnlineMarketplace
@graph.rdfs:comment: An eCommerce marketplace.

@graph.rdfs:label: numConstraints
@graph.name: numConstraints
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the number of constraints property values defined for a particular [[ConstraintNode]] such as [[StatisticalVariable]]. This helps applications understand if they have access to a sufficiently complete description of a [[StatisticalVariable]] or other construct that is defined using properties on template-style nodes.

@graph.rdfs:label: comment
@graph.name: comment
@graph.rdfs:comment: Comments, typically from users.

@graph.rdfs:label: PrependAction
@graph.name: PrependAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of inserting at the beginning if an ordered collection.

@graph.rdfs:label: normalRange
@graph.name: normalRange
@graph.rdfs:comment: Range of acceptable values for a typical patient, when applicable.

@graph.rdfs:label: copyrightNotice
@graph.name: copyrightNotice
@graph.rdfs:comment: Text of a notice appropriate for describing the copyright aspects of this Creative Work, ideally indicating the owner of the copyright for the Work.

@graph.rdfs:label: PerformingArtsTheater
@graph.name: PerformingArtsTheater
@graph.rdfs:comment: A theater or other performing art center.

@graph.rdfs:label: archivedAt
@graph.name: archivedAt
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a page or other link involved in archival of a [[CreativeWork]]. In the case of [[MediaReview]], the items in a [[MediaReviewItem]] may often become inaccessible, but be archived by archival, journalistic, activist, or law enforcement organizations. In such cases, the referenced page may not directly publish the content.

@graph.rdfs:label: strengthUnit
@graph.name: strengthUnit
@graph.rdfs:comment: The units of an active ingredient's strength, e.g. mg.

@graph.rdfs:label: birthPlace
@graph.name: birthPlace
@graph.rdfs:comment: The place where the person was born.

@graph.rdfs:label: variesBy
@graph.name: variesBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the property or properties by which the variants in a [[ProductGroup]] vary, e.g. their size, color etc. Schema.org properties can be referenced by their short name e.g. "color"; terms defined elsewhere can be referenced with their URIs.

@graph.rdfs:label: SheetMusic
@graph.name: SheetMusic
@graph.rdfs:comment: Printed music, as opposed to performed or recorded music.

@graph.rdfs:label: diagnosis
@graph.name: diagnosis
@graph.rdfs:comment: One or more alternative conditions considered in the differential diagnosis process as output of a diagnosis process.

@graph.rdfs:label: functionalClass
@graph.name: functionalClass
@graph.rdfs:comment: The degree of mobility the joint allows.

@graph.rdfs:label: DENonprofitType
@graph.name: DENonprofitType
@graph.rdfs:comment: DENonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from Germany in accordance with article 52 of the German fiscal code (Abgabenverordnung or AO).

@graph.rdfs:label: auditDate
@graph.name: auditDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date when a certification was last audited. See also  [gs1:certificationAuditDate](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationAuditDate).

@graph.rdfs:label: regionDrained
@graph.name: regionDrained
@graph.rdfs:comment: The anatomical or organ system drained by this vessel; generally refers to a specific part of an organ.

@graph.rdfs:label: knowsLanguage
@graph.name: knowsLanguage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a known language. We do not distinguish skill levels or reading/writing/speaking/signing here. Use language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47).

@graph.rdfs:label: schoolClosuresInfo
@graph.name: schoolClosuresInfo
@graph.rdfs:comment: Information about school closures.

@graph.rdfs:label: servingSize
@graph.name: servingSize
@graph.rdfs:comment: The serving size, in terms of the number of volume or mass.

@graph.rdfs:label: Season
@graph.name: Season
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media season, e.g. TV, radio, video game etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: sdDatePublished
@graph.name: sdDatePublished
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the date on which the current structured data was generated / published. Typically used alongside [[sdPublisher]].

@graph.rdfs:label: ReturnAction
@graph.name: ReturnAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of returning to the origin that which was previously received (concrete objects) or taken (ownership).

@graph.rdfs:label: ProgramMembership
@graph.name: ProgramMembership
@graph.rdfs:comment: Used to describe membership in a loyalty programs (e.g. "StarAliance"), traveler clubs (e.g. "AAA"), purchase clubs ("Safeway Club"), etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumC19OverflowPats
@graph.name: cvdNumC19OverflowPats
@graph.rdfs:comment: numc19overflowpats - ED/OVERFLOW: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed.

@graph.rdfs:label: thumbnailUrl
@graph.name: thumbnailUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: A thumbnail image relevant to the Thing.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasDeliveryMethod
@graph.name: hasDeliveryMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: Method used for delivery or shipping.

@graph.rdfs:label: loanPaymentFrequency
@graph.name: loanPaymentFrequency
@graph.rdfs:comment: Frequency of payments due, i.e. number of months between payments. This is defined as a frequency, i.e. the reciprocal of a period of time.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasCredential
@graph.name: hasCredential
@graph.rdfs:comment: A credential awarded to the Person or Organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: Review
@graph.name: Review
@graph.rdfs:comment: A review of an item - for example, of a restaurant, movie, or store.

@graph.rdfs:label: GovernmentPermit
@graph.name: GovernmentPermit
@graph.rdfs:comment: A permit issued by a government agency.

@graph.rdfs:label: locationCreated
@graph.name: locationCreated
@graph.rdfs:comment: The location where the CreativeWork was created, which may not be the same as the location depicted in the CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalRiskEstimator
@graph.name: MedicalRiskEstimator
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any rule set or interactive tool for estimating the risk of developing a complication or condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: monthlyMinimumRepaymentAmount
@graph.name: monthlyMinimumRepaymentAmount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The minimum payment is the lowest amount of money that one is required to pay on a credit card statement each month.

@graph.rdfs:label: significance
@graph.name: significance
@graph.rdfs:comment: The significance associated with the superficial anatomy; as an example, how characteristics of the superficial anatomy can suggest underlying medical conditions or courses of treatment.

@graph.rdfs:label: season
@graph.name: season
@graph.rdfs:comment: A season in a media series.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalObservationalStudyDesign
@graph.name: MedicalObservationalStudyDesign
@graph.rdfs:comment: Design models for observational medical studies. Enumerated type.

@graph.rdfs:label: muscleAction
@graph.name: muscleAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The movement the muscle generates.

@graph.rdfs:label: longitude
@graph.name: longitude
@graph.rdfs:comment: The longitude of a location. For example ```-122.08585``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

@graph.rdfs:label: lodgingUnitDescription
@graph.name: lodgingUnitDescription
@graph.rdfs:comment: A full description of the lodging unit.

@graph.rdfs:label: commentTime
@graph.name: commentTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The time at which the UserComment was made.

@graph.rdfs:label: ChooseAction
@graph.name: ChooseAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of expressing a preference from a set of options or a large or unbounded set of choices/options.

@graph.rdfs:label: acquireLicensePage
@graph.name: acquireLicensePage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a page documenting how licenses can be purchased or otherwise acquired, for the current item.

@graph.rdfs:label: GasStation
@graph.name: GasStation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A gas station.

@graph.rdfs:label: clipNumber
@graph.name: clipNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: Position of the clip within an ordered group of clips.

@graph.rdfs:label: predecessorOf
@graph.name: predecessorOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pointer from a previous, often discontinued variant of the product to its newer variant.

@graph.rdfs:label: lowPrice
@graph.name: lowPrice
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The lowest price of all offers available.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

@graph.rdfs:label: IgnoreAction
@graph.name: IgnoreAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of intentionally disregarding the object. An agent ignores an object.

@graph.rdfs:label: MediaSubscription
@graph.name: MediaSubscription
@graph.rdfs:comment: A subscription which allows a user to access media including audio, video, books, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: BuddhistTemple
@graph.name: BuddhistTemple
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Buddhist temple.

@graph.rdfs:label: taxonRank
@graph.name: taxonRank
@graph.rdfs:comment: The taxonomic rank of this taxon given preferably as a URI from a controlled vocabulary – typically the ranks from TDWG TaxonRank ontology or equivalent Wikidata URIs.

@graph.rdfs:label: Painting
@graph.name: Painting
@graph.rdfs:comment: A painting.

@graph.rdfs:label: toLocation
@graph.name: toLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of location. The final location of the object or the agent after the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: PropertyValue
@graph.name: PropertyValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: A property-value pair, e.g. representing a feature of a product or place. Use the 'name' property for the name of the property. If there is an additional human-readable version of the value, put that into the 'description' property.\n\n Always use specific schema.org properties when a) they exist and b) you can populate them. Using PropertyValue as a substitute will typically not trigger the same effect as using the original, specific property.

@graph.rdfs:label: UpdateAction
@graph.name: UpdateAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of managing by changing/editing the state of the object.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastSubChannel
@graph.name: broadcastSubChannel
@graph.rdfs:comment: The subchannel used for the broadcast.

@graph.rdfs:label: copyrightYear
@graph.name: copyrightYear
@graph.rdfs:comment: The year during which the claimed copyright for the CreativeWork was first asserted.

@graph.rdfs:label: Airport
@graph.name: Airport
@graph.rdfs:comment: An airport.

@graph.rdfs:label: contactPoint
@graph.name: contactPoint
@graph.rdfs:comment: A contact point for a person or organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: review
@graph.name: review
@graph.rdfs:comment: A review of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: Conversation
@graph.name: Conversation
@graph.rdfs:comment: One or more messages between organizations or people on a particular topic. Individual messages can be linked to the conversation with isPartOf or hasPart properties.

@graph.rdfs:label: Action
@graph.name: Action
@graph.rdfs:comment: An action performed by a direct agent and indirect participants upon a direct object. Optionally happens at a location with the help of an inanimate instrument. The execution of the action may produce a result. Specific action sub-type documentation specifies the exact expectation of each argument/role.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/04/16/announcing-schema-org-actions/) and [Actions overview document](https://schema.org/docs/actions.html).

@graph.rdfs:label: MemberProgramTier
@graph.name: MemberProgramTier
@graph.rdfs:comment: A MemberProgramTier specifies a tier under a loyalty (member) program, for example "gold".

@graph.rdfs:label: increasesRiskOf
@graph.name: increasesRiskOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: The condition, complication, etc. influenced by this factor.

@graph.rdfs:label: containedIn
@graph.name: containedIn
@graph.rdfs:comment: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

@graph.rdfs:label: shippingConditions
@graph.name: shippingConditions
@graph.rdfs:comment: The conditions (constraints, price) applicable to the [[ShippingService]].

@graph.rdfs:label: MensClothingStore
@graph.name: MensClothingStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A men's clothing store.

@graph.rdfs:label: eventAttendanceMode
@graph.name: eventAttendanceMode
@graph.rdfs:comment: The eventAttendanceMode of an event indicates whether it occurs online, offline, or a mix.

@graph.rdfs:label: maximumVirtualAttendeeCapacity
@graph.name: maximumVirtualAttendeeCapacity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The maximum virtual attendee capacity of an [[Event]] whose [[eventAttendanceMode]] is [[OnlineEventAttendanceMode]] (or the online aspects, in the case of a [[MixedEventAttendanceMode]]).

@graph.rdfs:label: paymentUrl
@graph.name: paymentUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: The URL for sending a payment.

@graph.rdfs:label: additionalVariable
@graph.name: additionalVariable
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any additional component of the exercise prescription that may need to be articulated to the patient. This may include the order of exercises, the number of repetitions of movement, quantitative distance, progressions over time, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: subEvent
@graph.name: subEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: An Event that is part of this event. For example, a conference event includes many presentations, each of which is a subEvent of the conference.

@graph.rdfs:label: availableTest
@graph.name: availableTest
@graph.rdfs:comment: A diagnostic test or procedure offered by this lab.

@graph.rdfs:label: Airline
@graph.name: Airline
@graph.rdfs:comment: An organization that provides flights for passengers.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanCoinsuranceOption
@graph.name: healthPlanCoinsuranceOption
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether the coinsurance applies before or after deductible, etc. TODO: Is this a closed set?

@graph.rdfs:label: BuyAction
@graph.name: BuyAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of giving money to a seller in exchange for goods or services rendered. An agent buys an object, product, or service from a seller for a price. Reciprocal of SellAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasVariant
@graph.name: hasVariant
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a [[Product]] that is a member of this [[ProductGroup]] (or [[ProductModel]]).

@graph.rdfs:label: publication
@graph.name: publication
@graph.rdfs:comment: A publication event associated with the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: duplicateTherapy
@graph.name: duplicateTherapy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A therapy that duplicates or overlaps this one.

@graph.rdfs:label: InvestmentOrDeposit
@graph.name: InvestmentOrDeposit
@graph.rdfs:comment: A type of financial product that typically requires the client to transfer funds to a financial service in return for potential beneficial financial return.

@graph.rdfs:label: GatedResidenceCommunity
@graph.name: GatedResidenceCommunity
@graph.rdfs:comment: Residence type: Gated community.

@graph.rdfs:label: bestRating
@graph.name: bestRating
@graph.rdfs:comment: The highest value allowed in this rating system.

@graph.rdfs:label: StadiumOrArena
@graph.name: StadiumOrArena
@graph.rdfs:comment: A stadium.

@graph.rdfs:label: recourseLoan
@graph.name: recourseLoan
@graph.rdfs:comment: The only way you get the money back in the event of default is the security. Recourse is where you still have the opportunity to go back to the borrower for the rest of the money.

@graph.rdfs:label: fromLocation
@graph.name: fromLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of location. The original location of the object or the agent before the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: encodesBioChemEntity
@graph.name: encodesBioChemEntity
@graph.rdfs:comment: Another BioChemEntity encoded by this one.

@graph.rdfs:label: isFamilyFriendly
@graph.name: isFamilyFriendly
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether this content is family friendly.

@graph.rdfs:label: returnPolicyCountry
@graph.name: returnPolicyCountry
@graph.rdfs:comment: The country where the product has to be sent to for returns, for example "Ireland" using the [[name]] property of [[Country]]. You can also provide the two-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1). Note that this can be different from the country where the product was originally shipped from or sent to.

@graph.rdfs:label: jobLocation
@graph.name: jobLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A (typically single) geographic location associated with the job position.

@graph.rdfs:label: valueMinLength
@graph.name: valueMinLength
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies the minimum allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

@graph.rdfs:label: referenceQuantity
@graph.name: referenceQuantity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The reference quantity for which a certain price applies, e.g. 1 EUR per 4 kWh of electricity. This property is a replacement for unitOfMeasurement for the advanced cases where the price does not relate to a standard unit.

@graph.rdfs:label: childTaxon
@graph.name: childTaxon
@graph.rdfs:comment: Closest child taxa of the taxon in question.

@graph.rdfs:label: ratingExplanation
@graph.name: ratingExplanation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short explanation (e.g. one to two sentences) providing background context and other information that led to the conclusion expressed in the rating. This is particularly applicable to ratings associated with "fact check" markup using [[ClaimReview]].

@graph.rdfs:label: MovieClip
@graph.name: MovieClip
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short segment/part of a movie.

@graph.rdfs:label: additionalType
@graph.name: additionalType
@graph.rdfs:comment: An additional type for the item, typically used for adding more specific types from external vocabularies in microdata syntax. This is a relationship between something and a class that the thing is in. Typically the value is a URI-identified RDF class, and in this case corresponds to the use of rdf:type in RDF. Text values can be used sparingly, for cases where useful information can be added without their being an appropriate schema to reference. In the case of text values, the class label should follow the schema.org style guide.

@graph.rdfs:label: tourBookingPage
@graph.name: tourBookingPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: A page providing information on how to book a tour of some [[Place]], such as an [[Accommodation]] or [[ApartmentComplex]] in a real estate setting, as well as other kinds of tours as appropriate.

@graph.rdfs:label: Order
@graph.name: Order
@graph.rdfs:comment: An order is a confirmation of a transaction (a receipt), which can contain multiple line items, each represented by an Offer that has been accepted by the customer.

@graph.rdfs:label: sender
@graph.name: sender
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of participant. The participant who is at the sending end of the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: isUnlabelledFallback
@graph.name: isUnlabelledFallback
@graph.rdfs:comment: This can be marked 'true' to indicate that some published [[DeliveryTimeSettings]] or [[ShippingRateSettings]] are intended to apply to all [[OfferShippingDetails]] published by the same merchant, when referenced by a [[shippingSettingsLink]] in those settings. It is not meaningful to use a 'true' value for this property alongside a transitTimeLabel (for [[DeliveryTimeSettings]]) or shippingLabel (for [[ShippingRateSettings]]), since this property is for use with unlabelled settings.

@graph.rdfs:label: track
@graph.name: track
@graph.rdfs:comment: A music recording (track)—usually a single song. If an ItemList is given, the list should contain items of type MusicRecording.

@graph.rdfs:label: pregnancyCategory
@graph.name: pregnancyCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Pregnancy category of this drug.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasCertification
@graph.name: hasCertification
@graph.rdfs:comment: Certification information about a product, organization, service, place, or person.

@graph.rdfs:label: correction
@graph.name: correction
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a correction to a [[CreativeWork]], either via a [[CorrectionComment]], textually or in another document.

@graph.rdfs:label: ProfilePage
@graph.name: ProfilePage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Web page type: Profile page.

@graph.rdfs:label: interactionType
@graph.name: interactionType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Action representing the type of interaction. For up votes, +1s, etc. use [[LikeAction]]. For down votes use [[DislikeAction]]. Otherwise, use the most specific Action.

@graph.rdfs:label: DDxElement
@graph.name: DDxElement
@graph.rdfs:comment: An alternative, closely-related condition typically considered later in the differential diagnosis process along with the signs that are used to distinguish it.

@graph.rdfs:label: producer
@graph.name: producer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The person or organization who produced the work (e.g. music album, movie, TV/radio series etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: gtin13
@graph.name: gtin13
@graph.rdfs:comment: The GTIN-13 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This is equivalent to 13-digit ISBN codes and EAN UCC-13. Former 12-digit UPC codes can be converted into a GTIN-13 code by simply adding a preceding zero. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

@graph.rdfs:label: orderValue
@graph.name: orderValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: Minimum and maximum order value for which these shipping conditions are valid.

@graph.rdfs:label: DiagnosticLab
@graph.name: DiagnosticLab
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical laboratory that offers on-site or off-site diagnostic services.

@graph.rdfs:label: unitText
@graph.name: unitText
@graph.rdfs:comment: A string or text indicating the unit of measurement. Useful if you cannot provide a standard unit code for unitCode.

@graph.rdfs:label: drugUnit
@graph.name: drugUnit
@graph.rdfs:comment: The unit in which the drug is measured, e.g. '5 mg tablet'.

@graph.rdfs:label: ticketNumber
@graph.name: ticketNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier for the ticket.

@graph.rdfs:label: PeopleAudience
@graph.name: PeopleAudience
@graph.rdfs:comment: A set of characteristics belonging to people, e.g. who compose an item's target audience.

@graph.rdfs:label: Series
@graph.name: Series
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Series in schema.org is a group of related items, typically but not necessarily of the same kind. See also [[CreativeWorkSeries]], [[EventSeries]].

@graph.rdfs:label: BreadcrumbList
@graph.name: BreadcrumbList
@graph.rdfs:comment: A BreadcrumbList is an ItemList consisting of a chain of linked Web pages, typically described using at least their URL and their name, and typically ending with the current page.\n\nThe [[position]] property is used to reconstruct the order of the items in a BreadcrumbList. The convention is that a breadcrumb list has an [[itemListOrder]] of [[ItemListOrderAscending]] (lower values listed first), and that the first items in this list correspond to the "top" or beginning of the breadcrumb trail, e.g. with a site or section homepage. The specific values of 'position' are not assigned meaning for a BreadcrumbList, but they should be integers, e.g. beginning with '1' for the first item in the list.

@graph.rdfs:label: postalCodeRange
@graph.name: postalCodeRange
@graph.rdfs:comment: A defined range of postal codes.

@graph.rdfs:label: DeleteAction
@graph.name: DeleteAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of editing a recipient by removing one of its objects.

@graph.rdfs:label: repetitions
@graph.name: repetitions
@graph.rdfs:comment: Number of times one should repeat the activity.

@graph.rdfs:label: Demand
@graph.name: Demand
@graph.rdfs:comment: A demand entity represents the public, not necessarily binding, not necessarily exclusive, announcement by an organization or person to seek a certain type of goods or services. For describing demand using this type, the very same properties used for Offer apply.

@graph.rdfs:label: guidelineSubject
@graph.name: guidelineSubject
@graph.rdfs:comment: The medical conditions, treatments, etc. that are the subject of the guideline.

@graph.rdfs:label: BusReservation
@graph.name: BusReservation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reservation for bus travel. \n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

@graph.rdfs:label: cssSelector
@graph.name: cssSelector
@graph.rdfs:comment: A CSS selector, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

@graph.rdfs:label: ScheduleAction
@graph.name: ScheduleAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Scheduling future actions, events, or tasks.

Related actions:

* [[ReserveAction]]: Unlike ReserveAction, ScheduleAction allocates future actions (e.g. an event, a task, etc) towards a time slot / spatial allocation.

@graph.rdfs:label: workFeatured
@graph.name: workFeatured
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A work featured in some event, e.g. exhibited in an ExhibitionEvent.
       Specific subproperties are available for workPerformed (e.g. a play), or a workPresented (a Movie at a ScreeningEvent).

@graph.rdfs:label: iataCode
@graph.name: iataCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: IATA identifier for an airline or airport.

@graph.rdfs:label: Reservation
@graph.name: Reservation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Describes a reservation for travel, dining or an event. Some reservations require tickets. \n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, restaurant reservations, flights, or rental cars, use [[Offer]].

@graph.rdfs:label: Offer
@graph.name: Offer
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service — for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book.

Note: As the [[businessFunction]] property, which identifies the form of offer (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose), defaults to http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell; an Offer without a defined businessFunction value can be assumed to be an offer to sell.
