@graph.rdfs:label: LegalService
@graph.name: LegalService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A LegalService is a business that provides legally-oriented services, advice and representation, e.g. law firms.\n\nAs a [[LocalBusiness]] it can be described as a [[provider]] of one or more [[Service]]\(s).

@graph.rdfs:label: MapCategoryType
@graph.name: MapCategoryType
@graph.rdfs:comment: An enumeration of several kinds of Map.

@graph.rdfs:label: messageAttachment
@graph.name: messageAttachment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A CreativeWork attached to the message.

@graph.rdfs:label: foundingLocation
@graph.name: foundingLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The place where the Organization was founded.

@graph.rdfs:label: BackgroundNewsArticle
@graph.name: BackgroundNewsArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[NewsArticle]] providing historical context, definition and detail on a specific topic (aka "explainer" or "backgrounder"). For example, an in-depth article or frequently-asked-questions ([FAQ](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FAQ)) document on topics such as Climate Change or the European Union. Other kinds of background material from a non-news setting are often described using [[Book]] or [[Article]], in particular [[ScholarlyArticle]]. See also [[NewsArticle]] for related vocabulary from a learning/education perspective.

@graph.rdfs:label: expectedPrognosis
@graph.name: expectedPrognosis
@graph.rdfs:comment: The likely outcome in either the short term or long term of the medical condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: scheduleTimezone
@graph.name: scheduleTimezone
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the timezone for which the time(s) indicated in the [[Schedule]] are given. The value provided should be among those listed in the IANA Time Zone Database.

@graph.rdfs:label: paymentDue
@graph.name: paymentDue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date that payment is due.

@graph.rdfs:label: eventSchedule
@graph.name: eventSchedule
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Associates an [[Event]] with a [[Schedule]]. There are circumstances where it is preferable to share a schedule for a series of
      repeating events rather than data on the individual events themselves. For example, a website or application might prefer to publish a schedule for a weekly
      gym class rather than provide data on every event. A schedule could be processed by applications to add forthcoming events to a calendar. An [[Event]] that
      is associated with a [[Schedule]] using this property should not have [[startDate]] or [[endDate]] properties. These are instead defined within the associated
      [[Schedule]], this avoids any ambiguity for clients using the data. The property might have repeated values to specify different schedules, e.g. for different months
      or seasons.

@graph.rdfs:label: geoWithin
@graph.name: geoWithin
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to one that contains it, i.e. it is inside (i.e. within) its interior. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

@graph.rdfs:label: ReportedDoseSchedule
@graph.name: ReportedDoseSchedule
@graph.rdfs:comment: A patient-reported or observed dosing schedule for a drug or supplement.

@graph.rdfs:label: Flight
@graph.name: Flight
@graph.rdfs:comment: An airline flight.

@graph.rdfs:label: educationalCredentialAwarded
@graph.name: educationalCredentialAwarded
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other educational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

@graph.rdfs:label: DefinedTermSet
@graph.name: DefinedTermSet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A set of defined terms, for example a set of categories or a classification scheme, a glossary, dictionary or enumeration. Use the about property to specify what the term set is about.

@graph.rdfs:label: programMembershipUsed
@graph.name: programMembershipUsed
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any membership in a frequent flyer, hotel loyalty program, etc. being applied to the reservation.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfLoanPayments
@graph.name: numberOfLoanPayments
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of payments contractually required at origination to repay the loan. For monthly paying loans this is the number of months from the contractual first payment date to the maturity date.

@graph.rdfs:label: evidenceOrigin
@graph.name: evidenceOrigin
@graph.rdfs:comment: Source of the data used to formulate the guidance, e.g. RCT, consensus opinion, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: WorkersUnion
@graph.name: WorkersUnion
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Workers Union (also known as a Labor Union, Labour Union, or Trade Union) is an organization that promotes the interests of its worker members by collectively bargaining with management, organizing, and political lobbying.

@graph.rdfs:label: provider
@graph.name: provider
@graph.rdfs:comment: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.

@graph.rdfs:label: TakeAction
@graph.name: TakeAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of gaining ownership of an object from an origin. Reciprocal of GiveAction.

Related actions:

* [[GiveAction]]: The reciprocal of TakeAction.
* [[ReceiveAction]]: Unlike ReceiveAction, TakeAction implies that ownership has been transferred.

@graph.rdfs:label: spatialCoverage
@graph.name: spatialCoverage
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The spatialCoverage of a CreativeWork indicates the place(s) which are the focus of the content. It is a subproperty of
      contentLocation intended primarily for more technical and detailed materials. For example with a Dataset, it indicates
      areas that the dataset describes: a dataset of New York weather would have spatialCoverage which was the place: the state of New York.

@graph.rdfs:label: dateSent
@graph.name: dateSent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date/time at which the message was sent.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalStudy
@graph.name: MedicalStudy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical study is an umbrella type covering all kinds of research studies relating to human medicine or health, including observational studies and interventional trials and registries, randomized, controlled or not. When the specific type of study is known, use one of the extensions of this type, such as MedicalTrial or MedicalObservationalStudy. Also, note that this type should be used to mark up data that describes the study itself; to tag an article that publishes the results of a study, use MedicalScholarlyArticle. Note: use the code property of MedicalEntity to store study IDs, e.g. clinicaltrials.gov ID.

@graph.rdfs:label: numChildren
@graph.name: numChildren
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of children staying in the unit.

@graph.rdfs:label: exerciseCourse
@graph.name: exerciseCourse
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

@graph.rdfs:label: departureGate
@graph.name: departureGate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifier of the flight's departure gate.

@graph.rdfs:label: GamePlayMode
@graph.name: GamePlayMode
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether this game is multi-player, co-op or single-player.

@graph.rdfs:label: WorkBasedProgram
@graph.name: WorkBasedProgram
@graph.rdfs:comment: A program with both an educational and employment component. Typically based at a workplace and structured around work-based learning, with the aim of instilling competencies related to an occupation. WorkBasedProgram is used to distinguish programs such as apprenticeships from school, college or other classroom based educational programs.

@graph.rdfs:label: MediaObject
@graph.name: MediaObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media object, such as an image, video, audio, or text object embedded in a web page or a downloadable dataset i.e. DataDownload. Note that a creative work may have many media objects associated with it on the same web page. For example, a page about a single song (MusicRecording) may have a music video (VideoObject), and a high and low bandwidth audio stream (2 AudioObject's).

@graph.rdfs:label: SocialEvent
@graph.name: SocialEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Social event.

@graph.rdfs:label: diseasePreventionInfo
@graph.name: diseasePreventionInfo
@graph.rdfs:comment: Information about disease prevention.

@graph.rdfs:label: geoCovers
@graph.name: geoCovers
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a covering geometry to a covered geometry. "Every point of b is a point of (the interior or boundary of) a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

@graph.rdfs:label: Recipe
@graph.name: Recipe
@graph.rdfs:comment: A recipe. For dietary restrictions covered by the recipe, a few common restrictions are enumerated via [[suitableForDiet]]. The [[keywords]] property can also be used to add more detail.

@graph.rdfs:label: SendAction
@graph.name: SendAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of physically/electronically dispatching an object for transfer from an origin to a destination. Related actions:

* [[ReceiveAction]]: The reciprocal of SendAction.
* [[GiveAction]]: Unlike GiveAction, SendAction does not imply the transfer of ownership (e.g. I can send you my laptop, but I'm not necessarily giving it to you).

@graph.rdfs:label: CoverArt
@graph.name: CoverArt
@graph.rdfs:comment: The artwork on the outer surface of a CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: ConvenienceStore
@graph.name: ConvenienceStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A convenience store.

@graph.rdfs:label: FundingAgency
@graph.name: FundingAgency
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A FundingAgency is an organization that implements one or more [[FundingScheme]]s and manages
    the granting process (via [[Grant]]s, typically [[MonetaryGrant]]s).
    A funding agency is not always required for grant funding, e.g. philanthropic giving, corporate sponsorship etc.
    
Examples of funding agencies include ERC, REA, NIH, Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, ...

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanDrugOption
@graph.name: healthPlanDrugOption
@graph.rdfs:comment: TODO.

@graph.rdfs:label: transitTime
@graph.name: transitTime
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The typical delay the order has been sent for delivery and the goods reach the final customer.

  In the context of [[ShippingDeliveryTime]], use the [[QuantitativeValue]]. Typical properties: minValue, maxValue, unitCode (d for DAY).

  In the context of [[ShippingConditions]], use the [[ServicePeriod]]. It has a duration (as a [[QuantitativeValue]]) and also business days and a cut-off time.

@graph.rdfs:label: recognizingAuthority
@graph.name: recognizingAuthority
@graph.rdfs:comment: If applicable, the organization that officially recognizes this entity as part of its endorsed system of medicine.

@graph.rdfs:label: significantLink
@graph.name: significantLink
@graph.rdfs:comment: One of the more significant URLs on the page. Typically, these are the non-navigation links that are clicked on the most.

@graph.rdfs:label: CreateAction
@graph.name: CreateAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of deliberately creating/producing/generating/building a result out of the agent.

@graph.rdfs:label: PhysiciansOffice
@graph.name: PhysiciansOffice
@graph.rdfs:comment: A doctor's office or clinic.

@graph.rdfs:label: ComicIssue
@graph.name: ComicIssue
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Individual comic issues are serially published as
    	part of a larger series. For the sake of consistency, even one-shot issues
    	belong to a series comprised of a single issue. All comic issues can be
    	uniquely identified by: the combination of the name and volume number of the
    	series to which the issue belongs; the issue number; and the variant
    	description of the issue (if any).

@graph.rdfs:label: TireShop
@graph.name: TireShop
@graph.rdfs:comment: A tire shop.

@graph.rdfs:label: availableFrom
@graph.name: availableFrom
@graph.rdfs:comment: When the item is available for pickup from the store, locker, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: Apartment
@graph.name: Apartment
@graph.rdfs:comment: An apartment (in American English) or flat (in British English) is a self-contained housing unit (a type of residential real estate) that occupies only part of a building (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apartment).

@graph.rdfs:label: proprietaryName
@graph.name: proprietaryName
@graph.rdfs:comment: Proprietary name given to the diet plan, typically by its originator or creator.

@graph.rdfs:label: percentile90
@graph.name: percentile90
@graph.rdfs:comment: The 90th percentile value.

@graph.rdfs:label: nationality
@graph.name: nationality
@graph.rdfs:comment: Nationality of the person.

@graph.rdfs:label: gameEdition
@graph.name: gameEdition
@graph.rdfs:comment: The edition of a video game.

@graph.rdfs:label: AdultEntertainment
@graph.name: AdultEntertainment
@graph.rdfs:comment: An adult entertainment establishment.

@graph.rdfs:label: recipeYield
@graph.name: recipeYield
@graph.rdfs:comment: The quantity produced by the recipe (for example, number of people served, number of servings, etc).

@graph.rdfs:label: flightNumber
@graph.name: flightNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier for a flight including the airline IATA code. For example, if describing United flight 110, where the IATA code for United is 'UA', the flightNumber is 'UA110'.

@graph.rdfs:label: bccRecipient
@graph.name: bccRecipient
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of recipient. The recipient blind copied on a message.

@graph.rdfs:label: coverageStartTime
@graph.name: coverageStartTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The time when the live blog will begin covering the Event. Note that coverage may begin before the Event's start time. The LiveBlogPosting may also be created before coverage begins.

@graph.rdfs:label: DayOfWeek
@graph.name: DayOfWeek
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The day of the week, e.g. used to specify to which day the opening hours of an OpeningHoursSpecification refer.

Originally, URLs from [GoodRelations](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1) were used (for [[Monday]], [[Tuesday]], [[Wednesday]], [[Thursday]], [[Friday]], [[Saturday]], [[Sunday]] plus a special entry for [[PublicHolidays]]); these have now been integrated directly into schema.org.

@graph.rdfs:label: Playground
@graph.name: Playground
@graph.rdfs:comment: A playground.

@graph.rdfs:label: applicableLocation
@graph.name: applicableLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The location in which the status applies.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalSymptom
@graph.name: MedicalSymptom
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any complaint sensed and expressed by the patient (therefore defined as subjective)  like stomachache, lower-back pain, or fatigue.

@graph.rdfs:label: syllabusSections
@graph.name: syllabusSections
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates (typically several) Syllabus entities that lay out what each section of the overall course will cover.

@graph.rdfs:label: MenuItem
@graph.name: MenuItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: A food or drink item listed in a menu or menu section.

@graph.rdfs:label: SeekToAction
@graph.name: SeekToAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: This is the [[Action]] of navigating to a specific [[startOffset]] timestamp within a [[VideoObject]], typically represented with a URL template structure.

@graph.rdfs:label: ingredients
@graph.name: ingredients
@graph.rdfs:comment: A single ingredient used in the recipe, e.g. sugar, flour or garlic.

@graph.rdfs:label: VacationRental
@graph.name: VacationRental
@graph.rdfs:comment: A kind of lodging business that focuses on renting single properties for limited time.

@graph.rdfs:label: measurementMethod
@graph.name: measurementMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: A subproperty of [[measurementTechnique]] that can be used for specifying specific methods, in particular via [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].

@graph.rdfs:label: secondaryPrevention
@graph.name: secondaryPrevention
@graph.rdfs:comment: A preventative therapy used to prevent reoccurrence of the medical condition after an initial episode of the condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: birthDate
@graph.name: birthDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date of birth.

@graph.rdfs:label: accommodationCategory
@graph.name: accommodationCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Category of an [[Accommodation]], following real estate conventions, e.g. RESO (see [PropertySubType](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/PropertySubType+Field), and [PropertyType](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/PropertyType+Field) fields  for suggested values).

@graph.rdfs:label: ResearchOrganization
@graph.name: ResearchOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Research Organization (e.g. scientific institute, research company).

@graph.rdfs:label: itemDefectReturnLabelSource
@graph.name: itemDefectReturnLabelSource
@graph.rdfs:comment: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a defect product.

@graph.rdfs:label: currentExchangeRate
@graph.name: currentExchangeRate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The current price of a currency.

@graph.rdfs:label: TVClip
@graph.name: TVClip
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short TV program or a segment/part of a TV program.

@graph.rdfs:label: legalAddress
@graph.name: legalAddress
@graph.rdfs:comment: The legal address of an organization which acts as the officially registered address used for legal and tax purposes. The legal address can be different from the place of operations of a business and other addresses can be part of an organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: inAlbum
@graph.name: inAlbum
@graph.rdfs:comment: The album to which this recording belongs.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasGS1DigitalLink
@graph.name: hasGS1DigitalLink
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The GS1 digital link associated with the object. This URL should conform to the particular requirements of digital links. The link should only contain the Application Identifiers (AIs) that are relevant for the entity being annotated, for instance a [[Product]] or an [[Organization]], and for the correct granularity. In particular, for products:
  • A Digital Link that contains a serial number (AI 21) should only be present on instances of [[IndividualProduct]]
  • A Digital Link that contains a lot number (AI 10) should be annotated as [[SomeProducts]] if only products from that lot are sold, or [[IndividualProduct]] if there is only a specific product.
  • A Digital Link that contains a global model number (AI 8013) should be attached to a [[Product]] or a [[ProductModel]].
Other item types should be adapted similarly.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicComposition
@graph.name: MusicComposition
@graph.rdfs:comment: A musical composition.

@graph.rdfs:label: VeterinaryCare
@graph.name: VeterinaryCare
@graph.rdfs:comment: A vet's office.

@graph.rdfs:label: BankOrCreditUnion
@graph.name: BankOrCreditUnion
@graph.rdfs:comment: Bank or credit union.

@graph.rdfs:label: blogPosts
@graph.name: blogPosts
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a post that is part of a [[Blog]]. Note that historically, what we term a "Blog" was once known as a "weblog", and that what we term a "BlogPosting" is now often colloquially referred to as a "blog".

@graph.rdfs:label: diversityStaffingReport
@graph.name: diversityStaffingReport
@graph.rdfs:comment: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a report on staffing diversity issues. In a news context this might be for example ASNE or RTDNA (US) reports, or self-reported.

@graph.rdfs:label: embedUrl
@graph.name: embedUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: A URL pointing to a player for a specific video. In general, this is the information in the ```src``` element of an ```embed``` tag and should not be the same as the content of the ```loc``` tag.

@graph.rdfs:label: encodingType
@graph.name: encodingType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The supported encoding type(s) for an EntryPoint request.

@graph.rdfs:label: contentType
@graph.name: contentType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The supported content type(s) for an EntryPoint response.

@graph.rdfs:label: DrawAction
@graph.name: DrawAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of producing a visual/graphical representation of an object, typically with a pen/pencil and paper as instruments.

@graph.rdfs:label: Distance
@graph.name: Distance
@graph.rdfs:comment: Properties that take Distances as values are of the form '<Number> <Length unit of measure>'. E.g., '7 ft'.

@graph.rdfs:label: reservationId
@graph.name: reservationId
@graph.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for the reservation.

@graph.rdfs:label: Role
@graph.name: Role
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents additional information about a relationship or property. For example a Role can be used to say that a 'member' role linking some SportsTeam to a player occurred during a particular time period. Or that a Person's 'actor' role in a Movie was for some particular characterName. Such properties can be attached to a Role entity, which is then associated with the main entities using ordinary properties like 'member' or 'actor'.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/06/16/introducing-role/).

@graph.rdfs:label: memberOf
@graph.name: memberOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: An Organization (or ProgramMembership) to which this Person or Organization belongs.

@graph.rdfs:label: Muscle
@graph.name: Muscle
@graph.rdfs:comment: A muscle is an anatomical structure consisting of a contractile form of tissue that animals use to effect movement.

@graph.rdfs:label: interactionService
@graph.name: interactionService
@graph.rdfs:comment: The WebSite or SoftwareApplication where the interactions took place.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfEpisodes
@graph.name: numberOfEpisodes
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of episodes in this season or series.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits
@graph.name: numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the number of available accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAccommodationUnits]].

@graph.rdfs:label: relatedStructure
@graph.name: relatedStructure
@graph.rdfs:comment: Related anatomical structure(s) that are not part of the system but relate or connect to it, such as vascular bundles associated with an organ system.

@graph.rdfs:label: GameServerStatus
@graph.name: GameServerStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Status of a game server.

@graph.rdfs:label: itemReviewed
@graph.name: itemReviewed
@graph.rdfs:comment: The item that is being reviewed/rated.

@graph.rdfs:label: priceRange
@graph.name: priceRange
@graph.rdfs:comment: The price range of the business, for example ```$$$```.

@graph.rdfs:label: shippingRate
@graph.name: shippingRate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The shipping rate is the cost of shipping to the specified destination. Typically, the maxValue and currency values (of the [[MonetaryAmount]]) are most appropriate.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastSignalModulation
@graph.name: broadcastSignalModulation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The modulation (e.g. FM, AM, etc) used by a particular broadcast service.

@graph.rdfs:label: acceptedPaymentMethod
@graph.name: acceptedPaymentMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: The payment method(s) that are accepted in general by an organization, or for some specific demand or offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: layoutImage
@graph.name: layoutImage
@graph.rdfs:comment: A schematic image showing the floorplan layout.

@graph.rdfs:label: HousePainter
@graph.name: HousePainter
@graph.rdfs:comment: A house painting service.

@graph.rdfs:label: creativeWorkStatus
@graph.name: creativeWorkStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The status of a creative work in terms of its stage in a lifecycle. Example terms include Incomplete, Draft, Published, Obsolete. Some organizations define a set of terms for the stages of their publication lifecycle.

@graph.rdfs:label: alternateName
@graph.name: alternateName
@graph.rdfs:comment: An alias for the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: Bridge
@graph.name: Bridge
@graph.rdfs:comment: A bridge.

@graph.rdfs:label: runsTo
@graph.name: runsTo
@graph.rdfs:comment: The vasculature the lymphatic structure runs, or efferents, to.

@graph.rdfs:label: observationDate
@graph.name: observationDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The observationDate of an [[Observation]].

@graph.rdfs:label: geoEquals
@graph.name: geoEquals
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically equal, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM). "Two geometries are topologically equal if their interiors intersect and no part of the interior or boundary of one geometry intersects the exterior of the other" (a symmetric relationship).

@graph.rdfs:label: 3DModel
@graph.name: 3DModel
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A 3D model represents some kind of 3D content, which may have [[encoding]]s in one or more [[MediaObject]]s. Many 3D formats are available (e.g. see [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:3D_graphics_file_formats)); specific encoding formats can be represented using the [[encodingFormat]] property applied to the relevant [[MediaObject]]. For the
case of a single file published after Zip compression, the convention of appending '+zip' to the [[encodingFormat]] can be used. Geospatial, AR/VR, artistic/animation, gaming, engineering and scientific content can all be represented using [[3DModel]].

@graph.rdfs:label: InvestmentFund
@graph.name: InvestmentFund
@graph.rdfs:comment: A company or fund that gathers capital from a number of investors to create a pool of money that is then re-invested into stocks, bonds and other assets.

@graph.rdfs:label: maximumPhysicalAttendeeCapacity
@graph.name: maximumPhysicalAttendeeCapacity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The maximum physical attendee capacity of an [[Event]] whose [[eventAttendanceMode]] is [[OfflineEventAttendanceMode]] (or the offline aspects, in the case of a [[MixedEventAttendanceMode]]).

@graph.rdfs:label: supportingData
@graph.name: supportingData
@graph.rdfs:comment: Supporting data for a SoftwareApplication.

@graph.rdfs:label: Restaurant
@graph.name: Restaurant
@graph.rdfs:comment: A restaurant.

@graph.rdfs:label: includedInDataCatalog
@graph.name: includedInDataCatalog
@graph.rdfs:comment: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

@graph.rdfs:label: quest
@graph.name: quest
@graph.rdfs:comment: The task that a player-controlled character, or group of characters may complete in order to gain a reward.

@graph.rdfs:label: Float
@graph.name: Float
@graph.rdfs:comment: Data type: Floating number.

@graph.rdfs:label: TouristInformationCenter
@graph.name: TouristInformationCenter
@graph.rdfs:comment: A tourist information center.

@graph.rdfs:label: endDate
@graph.name: endDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The end date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

@graph.rdfs:label: PublicationIssue
@graph.name: PublicationIssue
@graph.rdfs:comment: A part of a successively published publication such as a periodical or publication volume, often numbered, usually containing a grouping of works such as articles.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog-schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

@graph.rdfs:label: gtin14
@graph.name: gtin14
@graph.rdfs:comment: The GTIN-14 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

@graph.rdfs:label: PublicationVolume
@graph.name: PublicationVolume
@graph.rdfs:comment: A part of a successively published publication such as a periodical or multi-volume work, often numbered. It may represent a time span, such as a year.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog-schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

@graph.rdfs:label: accountablePerson
@graph.name: accountablePerson
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies the Person that is legally accountable for the CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: actionableFeedbackPolicy
@graph.name: actionableFeedbackPolicy
@graph.rdfs:comment: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other news-related [[Organization]], a statement about public engagement activities (for news media, the newsroom’s), including involving the public - digitally or otherwise -- in coverage decisions, reporting and activities after publication.

@graph.rdfs:label: seasons
@graph.name: seasons
@graph.rdfs:comment: A season in a media series.

@graph.rdfs:label: availableThrough
@graph.name: availableThrough
@graph.rdfs:comment: After this date, the item will no longer be available for pickup.

@graph.rdfs:label: releasedEvent
@graph.name: releasedEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The place and time the release was issued, expressed as a PublicationEvent.

@graph.rdfs:label: mobileUrl
@graph.name: mobileUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The [[mobileUrl]] property is provided for specific situations in which data consumers need to determine whether one of several provided URLs is a dedicated 'mobile site'.

To discourage over-use, and reflecting intial usecases, the property is expected only on [[Product]] and [[Offer]], rather than [[Thing]]. The general trend in web technology is towards [responsive design](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Responsive_web_design) in which content can be flexibly adapted to a wide range of browsing environments. Pages and sites referenced with the long-established [[url]] property should ideally also be usable on a wide variety of devices, including mobile phones. In most cases, it would be pointless and counter productive to attempt to update all [[url]] markup to use [[mobileUrl]] for more mobile-oriented pages. The property is intended for the case when items (primarily [[Product]] and [[Offer]]) have extra URLs hosted on an additional "mobile site" alongside the main one. It should not be taken as an endorsement of this publication style.

@graph.rdfs:label: relatedAnatomy
@graph.name: relatedAnatomy
@graph.rdfs:comment: Anatomical systems or structures that relate to the superficial anatomy.

@graph.rdfs:label: itemOffered
@graph.name: itemOffered
@graph.rdfs:comment: An item being offered (or demanded). The transactional nature of the offer or demand is documented using [[businessFunction]], e.g. sell, lease etc. While several common expected types are listed explicitly in this definition, others can be used. Using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: DataDownload
@graph.name: DataDownload
@graph.rdfs:comment: All or part of a [[Dataset]] in downloadable form.

@graph.rdfs:label: SatiricalArticle
@graph.name: SatiricalArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment: An [[Article]] whose content is primarily [[satirical]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satire) in nature, i.e. unlikely to be literally true. A satirical article is sometimes but not necessarily also a [[NewsArticle]]. [[ScholarlyArticle]]s are also sometimes satirized.

@graph.rdfs:label: LinkRole
@graph.name: LinkRole
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Role that represents a Web link, e.g. as expressed via the 'url' property. Its linkRelationship property can indicate URL-based and plain textual link types, e.g. those in IANA link registry or others such as 'amphtml'. This structure provides a placeholder where details from HTML's link element can be represented outside of HTML, e.g. in JSON-LD feeds.

@graph.rdfs:label: ListItem
@graph.name: ListItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: An list item, e.g. a step in a checklist or how-to description.

@graph.rdfs:label: step
@graph.name: step
@graph.rdfs:comment: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection.

@graph.rdfs:label: elevation
@graph.name: elevation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The elevation of a location ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)). Values may be of the form 'NUMBER UNIT\_OF\_MEASUREMENT' (e.g., '1,000 m', '3,200 ft') while numbers alone should be assumed to be a value in meters.

@graph.rdfs:label: City
@graph.name: City
@graph.rdfs:comment: A city or town.

@graph.rdfs:label: AboutPage
@graph.name: AboutPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Web page type: About page.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalEntity
@graph.name: MedicalEntity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The most generic type of entity related to health and the practice of medicine.

@graph.rdfs:label: vendor
@graph.name: vendor
@graph.rdfs:comment: 'vendor' is an earlier term for 'seller'.

@graph.rdfs:label: BusStation
@graph.name: BusStation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A bus station.

@graph.rdfs:label: priceValidUntil
@graph.name: priceValidUntil
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date after which the price is no longer available.

@graph.rdfs:label: scheduledTime
@graph.name: scheduledTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The time the object is scheduled to.

@graph.rdfs:label: supplyTo
@graph.name: supplyTo
@graph.rdfs:comment: The area to which the artery supplies blood.

@graph.rdfs:label: incomeLimit
@graph.name: incomeLimit
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Optional. Income limit for which the incentive is applicable for.

If MonetaryAmount is specified, this should be based on annualized income (e.g. if an incentive is limited to those making <$114,000 annually):

{ "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "maxValue": 114000, "currency": "USD", } Use Text for incentives that are limited based on other criteria, for example if an incentive is only available to recipients making 120% of the median poverty income in their area.

@graph.rdfs:label: PurchaseType
@graph.name: PurchaseType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates a purchase type for an item.

@graph.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
@graph.name: operatingSystem
@graph.rdfs:comment: Operating systems supported (Windows 7, OS X 10.6, Android 1.6).

@graph.rdfs:label: PerformingGroup
@graph.name: PerformingGroup
@graph.rdfs:comment: A performance group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a circus.

@graph.rdfs:label: stageAsNumber
@graph.name: stageAsNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The stage represented as a number, e.g. 3.

@graph.rdfs:label: about
@graph.name: about
@graph.rdfs:comment: The subject matter of an object.

@graph.rdfs:label: downloadUrl
@graph.name: downloadUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: If the file can be downloaded, URL to download the binary.

@graph.rdfs:label: Motel
@graph.name: Motel
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A motel.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

@graph.rdfs:label: editEIDR
@graph.name: editEIDR
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An [EIDR](https://eidr.org/) (Entertainment Identifier Registry) [[identifier]] representing a specific edit / edition for a work of film or television.

For example, the motion picture known as "Ghostbusters" whose [[titleEIDR]] is "10.5240/7EC7-228A-510A-053E-CBB8-J" has several edits, e.g. "10.5240/1F2A-E1C5-680A-14C6-E76B-I" and "10.5240/8A35-3BEE-6497-5D12-9E4F-3".

Since schema.org types like [[Movie]] and [[TVEpisode]] can be used for both works and their multiple expressions, it is possible to use [[titleEIDR]] alone (for a general description), or alongside [[editEIDR]] for a more edit-specific description.

@graph.rdfs:label: validFrom
@graph.name: validFrom
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date when the item becomes valid.

@graph.rdfs:label: DiscoverAction
@graph.name: DiscoverAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of discovering/finding an object.

@graph.rdfs:label: founders
@graph.name: founders
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person who founded this organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: foodEstablishment
@graph.name: foodEstablishment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of location. The specific food establishment where the action occurred.

@graph.rdfs:label: maxValue
@graph.name: maxValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The upper value of some characteristic or property.

@graph.rdfs:label: contentReferenceTime
@graph.name: contentReferenceTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The specific time described by a creative work, for works (e.g. articles, video objects etc.) that emphasise a particular moment within an Event.

@graph.rdfs:label: HardwareStore
@graph.name: HardwareStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A hardware store.

@graph.rdfs:label: appearance
@graph.name: appearance
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates an occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

@graph.rdfs:label: rxcui
@graph.name: rxcui
@graph.rdfs:comment: The RxCUI drug identifier from RXNORM.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalCode
@graph.name: MedicalCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A code for a medical entity.

@graph.rdfs:label: aggregateRating
@graph.name: aggregateRating
@graph.rdfs:comment: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: Researcher
@graph.name: Researcher
@graph.rdfs:comment: Researchers.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationType
@graph.name: legislationType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of the legislation. Examples of values are "law", "act", "directive", "decree", "regulation", "statutory instrument", "loi organique", "règlement grand-ducal", etc., depending on the country.

@graph.rdfs:label: masthead
@graph.name: masthead
@graph.rdfs:comment: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a link to the masthead page or a page listing top editorial management.

@graph.rdfs:label: PropertyValueSpecification
@graph.name: PropertyValueSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Property value specification.

@graph.rdfs:label: Poster
@graph.name: Poster
@graph.rdfs:comment: A large, usually printed placard, bill, or announcement, often illustrated, that is posted to advertise or publicize something.

@graph.rdfs:label: returnMethod
@graph.name: returnMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of return method offered, specified from an enumeration.

@graph.rdfs:label: AchieveAction
@graph.name: AchieveAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of accomplishing something via previous efforts. It is an instantaneous action rather than an ongoing process.

@graph.rdfs:label: byDay
@graph.name: byDay
@graph.rdfs:comment: Defines the day(s) of the week on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. May be specified using either [[DayOfWeek]], or alternatively [[Text]] conforming to iCal's syntax for byDay recurrence rules.

@graph.rdfs:label: extendedAddress
@graph.name: extendedAddress
@graph.rdfs:comment: An address extension such as an apartment number, C/O or alternative name.

@graph.rdfs:label: riskFactor
@graph.name: riskFactor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A modifiable or non-modifiable factor that increases the risk of a patient contracting this condition, e.g. age,  coexisting condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: alumniOf
@graph.name: alumniOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: An organization that the person is an alumni of.

@graph.rdfs:label: videoFormat
@graph.name: videoFormat
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of screening or video broadcast used (e.g. IMAX, 3D, SD, HD, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: photos
@graph.name: photos
@graph.rdfs:comment: Photographs of this place.

@graph.rdfs:label: nutrition
@graph.name: nutrition
@graph.rdfs:comment: Nutrition information about the recipe or menu item.

@graph.rdfs:label: negativeNotes
@graph.name: negativeNotes
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Provides negative considerations regarding something, most typically in pro/con lists for reviews (alongside [[positiveNotes]]). For symmetry 

In the case of a [[Review]], the property describes the [[itemReviewed]] from the perspective of the review; in the case of a [[Product]], the product itself is being described. Since product descriptions 
tend to emphasise positive claims, it may be relatively unusual to find [[negativeNotes]] used in this way. Nevertheless for the sake of symmetry, [[negativeNotes]] can be used on [[Product]].

The property values can be expressed either as unstructured text (repeated as necessary), or if ordered, as a list (in which case the most negative is at the beginning of the list).

@graph.rdfs:label: relatedTherapy
@graph.name: relatedTherapy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical therapy related to this anatomy.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalWebPage
@graph.name: MedicalWebPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: A web page that provides medical information.

@graph.rdfs:label: AutoDealer
@graph.name: AutoDealer
@graph.rdfs:comment: An car dealership.

@graph.rdfs:label: containedInPlace
@graph.name: containedInPlace
@graph.rdfs:comment: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

@graph.rdfs:label: Episode
@graph.name: Episode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media episode (e.g. TV, radio, video game) which can be part of a series or season.

@graph.rdfs:label: Attorney
@graph.name: Attorney
@graph.rdfs:comment: Professional service: Attorney. \n\nThis type is deprecated - [[LegalService]] is more inclusive and less ambiguous.

@graph.rdfs:label: HowToSupply
@graph.name: HowToSupply
@graph.rdfs:comment: A supply consumed when performing the instructions for how to achieve a result.

@graph.rdfs:label: drug
@graph.name: drug
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifying a drug or medicine used in a medication procedure.

@graph.rdfs:label: HealthTopicContent
@graph.name: HealthTopicContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: [[HealthTopicContent]] is [[WebContent]] that is about some aspect of a health topic, e.g. a condition, its symptoms or treatments. Such content may be comprised of several parts or sections and use different types of media. Multiple instances of [[WebContent]] (and hence [[HealthTopicContent]]) can be related using [[hasPart]] / [[isPartOf]] where there is some kind of content hierarchy, and their content described with [[about]] and [[mentions]] e.g. building upon the existing [[MedicalCondition]] vocabulary.

@graph.rdfs:label: geoOverlaps
@graph.name: geoOverlaps
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that geospatially overlaps it, i.e. they have some but not all points in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdFacilityId
@graph.name: cvdFacilityId
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifier of the NHSN facility that this data record applies to. Use [[cvdFacilityCounty]] to indicate the county. To provide other details, [[healthcareReportingData]] can be used on a [[Hospital]] entry.

@graph.rdfs:label: mapType
@graph.name: mapType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the kind of Map, from the MapCategoryType Enumeration.

@graph.rdfs:label: recordedIn
@graph.name: recordedIn
@graph.rdfs:comment: The CreativeWork that captured all or part of this Event.

@graph.rdfs:label: partOfTrip
@graph.name: partOfTrip
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifies that this [[Trip]] is a subTrip of another Trip.  For example Day 1, Day 2, etc. of a multi-day trip.

@graph.rdfs:label: EnergyConsumptionDetails
@graph.name: EnergyConsumptionDetails
@graph.rdfs:comment: EnergyConsumptionDetails represents information related to the energy efficiency of a product that consumes energy. The information that can be provided is based on international regulations such as for example [EU directive 2017/1369](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/1369/oj) for energy labeling and the [Energy labeling rule](https://www.ftc.gov/enforcement/rules/rulemaking-regulatory-reform-proceedings/energy-water-use-labeling-consumer) under the Energy Policy and Conservation Act (EPCA) in the US.

@graph.rdfs:label: isLiveBroadcast
@graph.name: isLiveBroadcast
@graph.rdfs:comment: True if the broadcast is of a live event.

@graph.rdfs:label: Cemetery
@graph.name: Cemetery
@graph.rdfs:comment: A graveyard.

@graph.rdfs:label: MovieTheater
@graph.name: MovieTheater
@graph.rdfs:comment: A movie theater.

@graph.rdfs:label: superEvent
@graph.name: superEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: An event that this event is a part of. For example, a collection of individual music performances might each have a music festival as their superEvent.

@graph.rdfs:label: alternativeOf
@graph.name: alternativeOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: Another gene which is a variation of this one.

@graph.rdfs:label: SportsEvent
@graph.name: SportsEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Sports event.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanMarketingUrl
@graph.name: healthPlanMarketingUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: The URL that goes directly to the plan brochure for the specific standard plan or plan variation.

@graph.rdfs:label: exampleOfWork
@graph.name: exampleOfWork
@graph.rdfs:comment: A creative work that this work is an example/instance/realization/derivation of.

@graph.rdfs:label: HealthAspectEnumeration
@graph.name: HealthAspectEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: HealthAspectEnumeration enumerates several aspects of health content online, each of which might be described using [[hasHealthAspect]] and [[HealthTopicContent]].

@graph.rdfs:label: MolecularEntity
@graph.name: MolecularEntity
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity.

@graph.rdfs:label: follows
@graph.name: follows
@graph.rdfs:comment: The most generic uni-directional social relation.

@graph.rdfs:label: percentile25
@graph.name: percentile25
@graph.rdfs:comment: The 25th percentile value.

@graph.rdfs:label: Waterfall
@graph.name: Waterfall
@graph.rdfs:comment: A waterfall, like Niagara.

@graph.rdfs:label: LiteraryEvent
@graph.name: LiteraryEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Literary event.

@graph.rdfs:label: yield
@graph.name: yield
@graph.rdfs:comment: The quantity that results by performing instructions. For example, a paper airplane, 10 personalized candles.

@graph.rdfs:label: PriceTypeEnumeration
@graph.name: PriceTypeEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates different price types, for example list price, invoice price, and sale price.

@graph.rdfs:label: CheckOutAction
@graph.name: CheckOutAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of an agent communicating (service provider, social media, etc) their departure of a previously reserved service (e.g. flight check-in) or place (e.g. hotel).

Related actions:

* [[CheckInAction]]: The antonym of CheckOutAction.
* [[DepartAction]]: Unlike DepartAction, CheckOutAction implies that the agent is informing/confirming the end of a previously reserved service.
* [[CancelAction]]: Unlike CancelAction, CheckOutAction implies that the agent is informing/confirming the end of a previously reserved service.

@graph.rdfs:label: comprisedOf
@graph.name: comprisedOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifying something physically contained by something else. Typically used here for the underlying anatomical structures, such as organs, that comprise the anatomical system.

@graph.rdfs:label: financialAidEligible
@graph.name: financialAidEligible
@graph.rdfs:comment: A financial aid type or program which students may use to pay for tuition or fees associated with the program.

@graph.rdfs:label: PayAction
@graph.name: PayAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: An agent pays a price to a participant.

@graph.rdfs:label: pageStart
@graph.name: pageStart
@graph.rdfs:comment: The page on which the work starts; for example "135" or "xiii".

@graph.rdfs:label: Embassy
@graph.name: Embassy
@graph.rdfs:comment: An embassy.

@graph.rdfs:label: algorithm
@graph.name: algorithm
@graph.rdfs:comment: The algorithm or rules to follow to compute the score.

@graph.rdfs:label: orderQuantity
@graph.name: orderQuantity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of the item ordered. If the property is not set, assume the quantity is one.

@graph.rdfs:label: breastfeedingWarning
@graph.name: breastfeedingWarning
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use by breastfeeding mothers.

@graph.rdfs:label: collection
@graph.name: collection
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: Message
@graph.name: Message
@graph.rdfs:comment: A single message from a sender to one or more organizations or people.

@graph.rdfs:label: illustrator
@graph.name: illustrator
@graph.rdfs:comment: The illustrator of the book.

@graph.rdfs:label: studyDesign
@graph.name: studyDesign
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifics about the observational study design (enumerated).

@graph.rdfs:label: QualitativeValue
@graph.name: QualitativeValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: A predefined value for a product characteristic, e.g. the power cord plug type 'US' or the garment sizes 'S', 'M', 'L', and 'XL'.

@graph.rdfs:label: postalCodeEnd
@graph.name: postalCodeEnd
@graph.rdfs:comment: Last postal code in the range (included). Needs to be after [[postalCodeBegin]].

@graph.rdfs:label: pronouns
@graph.name: pronouns
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A short string listing or describing pronouns for a person. Typically the person concerned is the best authority as pronouns are a critical part of personal identity and expression. Publishers and consumers of this information are reminded to treat this data responsibly, take country-specific laws related to gender expression into account, and be wary of out-of-date data and drawing unwarranted inferences about the person being described.

In English, formulations such as "they/them", "she/her", and "he/him" are commonly used online and can also be used here. We do not intend to enumerate all possible micro-syntaxes in all languages. More structured and well-defined external values for pronouns can be referenced using the [[StructuredValue]] or [[DefinedTerm]] values.

@graph.rdfs:label: originAddress
@graph.name: originAddress
@graph.rdfs:comment: Shipper's address.

@graph.rdfs:label: slogan
@graph.name: slogan
@graph.rdfs:comment: A slogan or motto associated with the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: parentService
@graph.name: parentService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A broadcast service to which the broadcast service may belong to such as regional variations of a national channel.

@graph.rdfs:label: Collection
@graph.name: Collection
@graph.rdfs:comment: A collection of items, e.g. creative works or products.

@graph.rdfs:label: PodcastEpisode
@graph.name: PodcastEpisode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A single episode of a podcast series.

@graph.rdfs:label: underName
@graph.name: underName
@graph.rdfs:comment: The person or organization the reservation or ticket is for.

@graph.rdfs:label: SpreadsheetDigitalDocument
@graph.name: SpreadsheetDigitalDocument
@graph.rdfs:comment: A spreadsheet file.

@graph.rdfs:label: WPHeader
@graph.name: WPHeader
@graph.rdfs:comment: The header section of the page.

@graph.rdfs:label: byMonthWeek
@graph.name: byMonthWeek
@graph.rdfs:comment: Defines the week(s) of the month on which a recurring Event takes place. Specified as an Integer between 1-5. For clarity, byMonthWeek is best used in conjunction with byDay to indicate concepts like the first and third Mondays of a month.

@graph.rdfs:label: SellAction
@graph.name: SellAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of taking money from a buyer in exchange for goods or services rendered. An agent sells an object, product, or service to a buyer for a price. Reciprocal of BuyAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: subStageSuffix
@graph.name: subStageSuffix
@graph.rdfs:comment: The substage, e.g. 'a' for Stage IIIa.

@graph.rdfs:label: biologicalRole
@graph.name: biologicalRole
@graph.rdfs:comment: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a biological context.

@graph.rdfs:label: recipient
@graph.name: recipient
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of participant. The participant who is at the receiving end of the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalImagingTechnique
@graph.name: MedicalImagingTechnique
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any medical imaging modality typically used for diagnostic purposes. Enumerated type.

@graph.rdfs:label: Canal
@graph.name: Canal
@graph.rdfs:comment: A canal, like the Panama Canal.

@graph.rdfs:label: ImageGallery
@graph.name: ImageGallery
@graph.rdfs:comment: Web page type: Image gallery page.

@graph.rdfs:label: BlogPosting
@graph.name: BlogPosting
@graph.rdfs:comment: A blog post.

@graph.rdfs:label: availabilityStarts
@graph.name: availabilityStarts
@graph.rdfs:comment: The beginning of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: dateDeleted
@graph.name: dateDeleted
@graph.rdfs:comment: The datetime the item was removed from the DataFeed.

@graph.rdfs:label: PerformAction
@graph.name: PerformAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of participating in performance arts.

@graph.rdfs:label: album
@graph.name: album
@graph.rdfs:comment: A music album.

@graph.rdfs:label: candidate
@graph.name: candidate
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of object. The candidate subject of this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: MortgageLoan
@graph.name: MortgageLoan
@graph.rdfs:comment: A loan in which property or real estate is used as collateral. (A loan securitized against some real estate.)

@graph.rdfs:label: RuntimePlatform
@graph.name: RuntimePlatform
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specialized software environment that provides the essential infrastructure, libraries, and services required to execute a program.

@graph.rdfs:label: businessDays
@graph.name: businessDays
@graph.rdfs:comment: Days of the week when the merchant typically operates, indicated via opening hours markup.

@graph.rdfs:label: Person
@graph.name: Person
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).

@graph.rdfs:label: weightTotal
@graph.name: weightTotal
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The permitted total weight of the loaded vehicle, including passengers and cargo and the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

@graph.rdfs:label: benefits
@graph.name: benefits
@graph.rdfs:comment: Description of benefits associated with the job.

@graph.rdfs:label: actors
@graph.name: actors
@graph.rdfs:comment: An actor, e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

@graph.rdfs:label: itemListElement
@graph.name: itemListElement
@graph.rdfs:comment:
For itemListElement values, you can use simple strings (e.g. "Peter", "Paul", "Mary"), existing entities, or use ListItem.

Text values are best if the elements in the list are plain strings. Existing entities are best for a simple, unordered list of existing things in your data. ListItem is used with ordered lists when you want to provide additional context about the element in that list or when the same item might be in different places in different lists.

Note: The order of elements in your mark-up is not sufficient for indicating the order or elements.  Use ListItem with a 'position' property in such cases.

@graph.rdfs:label: event
@graph.name: event
@graph.rdfs:comment: Upcoming or past event associated with this place, organization, or action.

@graph.rdfs:label: AskAction
@graph.name: AskAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of posing a question / favor to someone.

Related actions:

* [[ReplyAction]]: Appears generally as a response to AskAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: duringMedia
@graph.name: duringMedia
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media object representing the circumstances while performing this direction.

@graph.rdfs:label: startDate
@graph.name: startDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The start date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

@graph.rdfs:label: MonetaryGrant
@graph.name: MonetaryGrant
@graph.rdfs:comment: A monetary grant.

@graph.rdfs:label: BrainStructure
@graph.name: BrainStructure
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any anatomical structure which pertains to the soft nervous tissue functioning as the coordinating center of sensation and intellectual and nervous activity.

@graph.rdfs:label: loanRepaymentForm
@graph.name: loanRepaymentForm
@graph.rdfs:comment: A form of paying back money previously borrowed from a lender. Repayment usually takes the form of periodic payments that normally include part principal plus interest in each payment.

@graph.rdfs:label: lifeEvent
@graph.name: lifeEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: A life event like baptism, communions, Bar Mitzvahs, Aqiqah, Namakarana, Miyamairi, burial, ....

@graph.rdfs:label: targetUrl
@graph.name: targetUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: The URL of a node in an established educational framework.

@graph.rdfs:label: publishedBy
@graph.name: publishedBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: An agent associated with the publication event.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasStore
@graph.name: hasStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: An eCommerce store part of an online marketplace.

@graph.rdfs:label: price
@graph.name: price
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The offer price of a product, or of a price component when attached to PriceSpecification and its subtypes.

Usage guidelines:

* Use the [[priceCurrency]] property (with standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR") instead of including [ambiguous symbols](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dollar_sign#Currencies_that_use_the_dollar_or_peso_sign) such as '$' in the value.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.
* Note that both [RDFa](http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml-rdfa-primer/#using-the-content-attribute) and Microdata syntax allow the use of a "content=" attribute for publishing simple machine-readable values alongside more human-friendly formatting.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.

@graph.rdfs:label: EventSeries
@graph.name: EventSeries
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A series of [[Event]]s. Included events can relate with the series using the [[superEvent]] property.

An EventSeries is a collection of events that share some unifying characteristic. For example, "The Olympic Games" is a series, which
is repeated regularly. The "2012 London Olympics" can be presented both as an [[Event]] in the series "Olympic Games", and as an
[[EventSeries]] that included a number of sporting competitions as Events.

The nature of the association between the events in an [[EventSeries]] can vary, but typical examples could
include a thematic event series (e.g. topical meetups or classes), or a series of regular events that share a location, attendee group and/or organizers.

EventSeries has been defined as a kind of Event to make it easy for publishers to use it in an Event context without
worrying about which kinds of series are really event-like enough to call an Event. In general an EventSeries
may seem more Event-like when the period of time is compact and when aspects such as location are fixed, but
it may also sometimes prove useful to describe a longer-term series as an Event.

@graph.rdfs:label: FilmAction
@graph.name: FilmAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of capturing sound and moving images on film, video, or digitally.

@graph.rdfs:label: SearchAction
@graph.name: SearchAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of searching for an object.

Related actions:

* [[FindAction]]: SearchAction generally leads to a FindAction, but not necessarily.

@graph.rdfs:label: playerType
@graph.name: playerType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Player type required—for example, Flash or Silverlight.

@graph.rdfs:label: shippingDestination
@graph.name: shippingDestination
@graph.rdfs:comment: indicates (possibly multiple) shipping destinations. These can be defined in several ways, e.g. postalCode ranges.

@graph.rdfs:label: TaxiStand
@graph.name: TaxiStand
@graph.rdfs:comment: A taxi stand.

@graph.rdfs:label: opens
@graph.name: opens
@graph.rdfs:comment: The opening hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumC19OFMechVentPats
@graph.name: cvdNumC19OFMechVentPats
@graph.rdfs:comment: numc19ofmechventpats - ED/OVERFLOW and VENTILATED: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed and on a mechanical ventilator.

@graph.rdfs:label: typeOfGood
@graph.name: typeOfGood
@graph.rdfs:comment: The product that this structured value is referring to.

@graph.rdfs:label: warning
@graph.name: warning
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any FDA or other warnings about the drug (text or URL).

@graph.rdfs:label: LoginAction
@graph.name: LoginAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The action of logging into a device or application.

@graph.rdfs:label: inDefinedTermSet
@graph.name: inDefinedTermSet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[DefinedTermSet]] that contains this term.

@graph.rdfs:label: LodgingBusiness
@graph.name: LodgingBusiness
@graph.rdfs:comment: A lodging business, such as a motel, hotel, or inn.

@graph.rdfs:label: tocContinuation
@graph.name: tocContinuation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[HyperTocEntry]] can have a [[tocContinuation]] indicated, which is another [[HyperTocEntry]] that would be the default next item to play or render.

@graph.rdfs:label: geoDisjoint
@graph.name: geoDisjoint
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically disjoint: "they have no point in common. They form a set of disconnected geometries." (A symmetric relationship, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).)

@graph.rdfs:label: Text
@graph.name: Text
@graph.rdfs:comment: Data type: Text.

@graph.rdfs:label: answerExplanation
@graph.name: answerExplanation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A step-by-step or full explanation about Answer. Can outline how this Answer was achieved or contain more broad clarification or statement about it.

@graph.rdfs:label: pickupTime
@graph.name: pickupTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: When a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

@graph.rdfs:label: evidenceLevel
@graph.name: evidenceLevel
@graph.rdfs:comment: Strength of evidence of the data used to formulate the guideline (enumerated).

@graph.rdfs:label: ComicCoverArt
@graph.name: ComicCoverArt
@graph.rdfs:comment: The artwork on the cover of a comic.

@graph.rdfs:label: FoodEstablishmentReservation
@graph.name: FoodEstablishmentReservation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reservation to dine at a food-related business.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations.

@graph.rdfs:label: commentCount
@graph.name: commentCount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of comments this CreativeWork (e.g. Article, Question or Answer) has received. This is most applicable to works published in Web sites with commenting system; additional comments may exist elsewhere.

@graph.rdfs:label: costOrigin
@graph.name: costOrigin
@graph.rdfs:comment: Additional details to capture the origin of the cost data. For example, 'Medicare Part B'.

@graph.rdfs:label: legalStatus
@graph.name: legalStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.

@graph.rdfs:label: BarOrPub
@graph.name: BarOrPub
@graph.rdfs:comment: A bar or pub.

@graph.rdfs:label: fuelType
@graph.name: fuelType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of fuel suitable for the engine or engines of the vehicle. If the vehicle has only one engine, this property can be attached directly to the vehicle.

@graph.rdfs:label: childMinAge
@graph.name: childMinAge
@graph.rdfs:comment: Minimal age of the child.

@graph.rdfs:label: isRelatedTo
@graph.name: isRelatedTo
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pointer to another, somehow related product (or multiple products).

@graph.rdfs:label: EducationalAudience
@graph.name: EducationalAudience
@graph.rdfs:comment: An EducationalAudience.

@graph.rdfs:label: AskPublicNewsArticle
@graph.name: AskPublicNewsArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[NewsArticle]] expressing an open call by a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] asking the public for input, insights, clarifications, anecdotes, documentation, etc., on an issue, for reporting purposes.

@graph.rdfs:label: HealthPlanNetwork
@graph.name: HealthPlanNetwork
@graph.rdfs:comment: A US-style health insurance plan network.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastDisplayName
@graph.name: broadcastDisplayName
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name displayed in the channel guide. For many US affiliates, it is the network name.

@graph.rdfs:label: certificationStatus
@graph.name: certificationStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the current status of a certification: active or inactive. See also  [gs1:certificationStatus](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationStatus).

@graph.rdfs:label: busName
@graph.name: busName
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of the bus (e.g. Bolt Express).

@graph.rdfs:label: serviceUrl
@graph.name: serviceUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: The website to access the service.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasDriveThroughService
@graph.name: hasDriveThroughService
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether some facility (e.g. [[FoodEstablishment]], [[CovidTestingFacility]]) offers a service that can be used by driving through in a car. In the case of [[CovidTestingFacility]] such facilities could potentially help with social distancing from other potentially-infected users.

@graph.rdfs:label: aircraft
@graph.name: aircraft
@graph.rdfs:comment: The kind of aircraft (e.g., "Boeing 747").

@graph.rdfs:label: interactingDrug
@graph.name: interactingDrug
@graph.rdfs:comment: Another drug that is known to interact with this drug in a way that impacts the effect of this drug or causes a risk to the patient. Note: disease interactions are typically captured as contraindications.

@graph.rdfs:label: course
@graph.name: course
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.name: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: LegalForceStatus
@graph.name: LegalForceStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: A list of possible statuses for the legal force of a legislation.

@graph.rdfs:label: recipe
@graph.name: recipe
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of instrument. The recipe/instructions used to perform the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: DrugCostCategory
@graph.name: DrugCostCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerated categories of medical drug costs.

@graph.rdfs:label: statType
@graph.name: statType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the kind of statistic represented by a [[StatisticalVariable]], e.g. mean, count etc. The value of statType is a property, either from within Schema.org (e.g. [[median]], [[marginOfError]], [[maxValue]], [[minValue]]) or from other compatible (e.g. RDF) systems such as DataCommons.org or Wikidata.org.

@graph.rdfs:label: percentile10
@graph.name: percentile10
@graph.rdfs:comment: The 10th percentile value.

@graph.rdfs:label: value
@graph.name: value
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The value of a [[QuantitativeValue]] (including [[Observation]]) or property value node.

* For [[QuantitativeValue]] and [[MonetaryAmount]], the recommended type for values is 'Number'.
* For [[PropertyValue]], it can be 'Text', 'Number', 'Boolean', or 'StructuredValue'.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

@graph.rdfs:label: AnalysisNewsArticle
@graph.name: AnalysisNewsArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment: An AnalysisNewsArticle is a [[NewsArticle]] that, while based on factual reporting, incorporates the expertise of the author/producer, offering interpretations and conclusions.

@graph.rdfs:label: dataset
@graph.name: dataset
@graph.rdfs:comment: A dataset contained in this catalog.

@graph.rdfs:label: letterer
@graph.name: letterer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The individual who adds lettering, including speech balloons and sound effects, to artwork.

@graph.rdfs:label: geoCrosses
@graph.name: geoCrosses
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that crosses it: "a crosses b: they have some but not all interior points in common, and the dimension of the intersection is less than that of at least one of them". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

@graph.rdfs:label: musicCompositionForm
@graph.name: musicCompositionForm
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of composition (e.g. overture, sonata, symphony, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: mechanismOfAction
@graph.name: mechanismOfAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The specific biochemical interaction through which this drug or supplement produces its pharmacological effect.

@graph.rdfs:label: serviceOutput
@graph.name: serviceOutput
@graph.rdfs:comment: The tangible thing generated by the service, e.g. a passport, permit, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: priceComponent
@graph.name: priceComponent
@graph.rdfs:comment: This property links to all [[UnitPriceSpecification]] nodes that apply in parallel for the [[CompoundPriceSpecification]] node.

@graph.rdfs:label: ExerciseAction
@graph.name: ExerciseAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of participating in exertive activity for the purposes of improving health and fitness.

@graph.rdfs:label: question
@graph.name: question
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of object. A question.

@graph.rdfs:label: securityScreening
@graph.name: securityScreening
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of security screening the passenger is subject to.

@graph.rdfs:label: TVEpisode
@graph.name: TVEpisode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A TV episode which can be part of a series or season.

@graph.rdfs:label: wheelbase
@graph.name: wheelbase
@graph.rdfs:comment: The distance between the centers of the front and rear wheels.\n\nTypical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet.

@graph.rdfs:label: intensity
@graph.name: intensity
@graph.rdfs:comment: Quantitative measure gauging the degree of force involved in the exercise, for example, heartbeats per minute. May include the velocity of the movement.

@graph.rdfs:label: textValue
@graph.name: textValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: Text value being annotated.

@graph.rdfs:label: netWorth
@graph.name: netWorth
@graph.rdfs:comment: The total financial value of the person as calculated by subtracting the total value of liabilities from the total value of assets.

@graph.rdfs:label: ResetPasswordAction
@graph.name: ResetPasswordAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The action of resetting the password of a device or application.

@graph.rdfs:label: confirmationNumber
@graph.name: confirmationNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: A number that confirms the given order or payment has been received.

@graph.rdfs:label: model
@graph.name: model
@graph.rdfs:comment: The model of the product. Use with the URL of a ProductModel or a textual representation of the model identifier. The URL of the ProductModel can be from an external source. It is recommended to additionally provide strong product identifiers via the gtin8/gtin13/gtin14 and mpn properties.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasSponsorshipOffer
@graph.name: hasSponsorshipOffer
@graph.rdfs:comment: An offer to sponsor the event, for example, Sponsorship Prospectus, Sponsorship Opportunities, or Sponsor Packages.

@graph.rdfs:label: AuthorizeAction
@graph.name: AuthorizeAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of granting permission to an object.

@graph.rdfs:label: EmploymentAgency
@graph.name: EmploymentAgency
@graph.rdfs:comment: An employment agency.

@graph.rdfs:label: isResizable
@graph.name: isResizable
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether the 3DModel allows resizing. For example, room layout applications often do not allow 3DModel elements to be resized to reflect reality.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalTrial
@graph.name: MedicalTrial
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical trial is a type of medical study that uses a scientific process to compare the safety and efficacy of medical therapies or medical procedures. In general, medical trials are controlled and subjects are allocated at random to the different treatment and/or control groups.

@graph.rdfs:label: physicalRequirement
@graph.name: physicalRequirement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the types of physical activity associated with the job. Defined terms such as those in O*net may be used, but note that there is no way to specify the level of ability as well as its nature when using a defined term.

@graph.rdfs:label: recipeCuisine
@graph.name: recipeCuisine
@graph.rdfs:comment: The cuisine of the recipe (for example, French or Ethiopian).

@graph.rdfs:label: FinancialService
@graph.name: FinancialService
@graph.rdfs:comment: Financial services business.

@graph.rdfs:label: StructuredValue
@graph.name: StructuredValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: Structured values are used when the value of a property has a more complex structure than simply being a textual value or a reference to another thing.

@graph.rdfs:label: MobileApplication
@graph.name: MobileApplication
@graph.rdfs:comment: A software application designed specifically to work well on a mobile device such as a telephone.

@graph.rdfs:label: EngineSpecification
@graph.name: EngineSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: Information about the engine of the vehicle. A vehicle can have multiple engines represented by multiple engine specification entities.

@graph.rdfs:label: HealthPlanFormulary
@graph.name: HealthPlanFormulary
@graph.rdfs:comment: For a given health insurance plan, the specification for costs and coverage of prescription drugs.

@graph.rdfs:label: BorrowAction
@graph.name: BorrowAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of obtaining an object under an agreement to return it at a later date. Reciprocal of LendAction.

Related actions:

* [[LendAction]]: Reciprocal of BorrowAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasTierBenefit
@graph.name: hasTierBenefit
@graph.rdfs:comment: A member benefit for a particular tier of a loyalty program.

@graph.rdfs:label: httpMethod
@graph.name: httpMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: An HTTP method that specifies the appropriate HTTP method for a request to an HTTP EntryPoint. Values are capitalized strings as used in HTTP.

@graph.rdfs:label: TechArticle
@graph.name: TechArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment: A technical article - Example: How-to (task) topics, step-by-step, procedural troubleshooting, specifications, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: Claim
@graph.name: Claim
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A [[Claim]] in Schema.org represents a specific, factually-oriented claim that could be the [[itemReviewed]] in a [[ClaimReview]]. The content of a claim can be summarized with the [[text]] property. Variations on well known claims can have their common identity indicated via [[sameAs]] links, and summarized with a [[name]]. Ideally, a [[Claim]] description includes enough contextual information to minimize the risk of ambiguity or inclarity. In practice, many claims are better understood in the context in which they appear or the interpretations provided by claim reviews.

  Beyond [[ClaimReview]], the Claim type can be associated with related creative works - for example a [[ScholarlyArticle]] or [[Question]] might be [[about]] some [[Claim]].

  At this time, Schema.org does not define any types of relationship between claims. This is a natural area for future exploration.

@graph.rdfs:label: WPSideBar
@graph.name: WPSideBar
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sidebar section of the page.

@graph.rdfs:label: accessMode
@graph.name: accessMode
@graph.rdfs:comment: The human sensory perceptual system or cognitive faculty through which a person may process or perceive the intellectual content of a resource, not including any adaptations of the content (e.g., text alternatives for images). Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessMode-vocabulary).

@graph.rdfs:label: merchantReturnLink
@graph.name: merchantReturnLink
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies a Web page or service by URL, for product returns.

@graph.rdfs:label: issn
@graph.name: issn
@graph.rdfs:comment: The International Standard Serial Number (ISSN) that identifies this serial publication. You can repeat this property to identify different formats of, or the linking ISSN (ISSN-L) for, this serial publication.

@graph.rdfs:label: ReserveAction
@graph.name: ReserveAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Reserving a concrete object.

Related actions:

* [[ScheduleAction]]: Unlike ScheduleAction, ReserveAction reserves concrete objects (e.g. a table, a hotel) towards a time slot / spatial allocation.

@graph.rdfs:label: screenshot
@graph.name: screenshot
@graph.rdfs:comment: A link to a screenshot image of the app.

@graph.rdfs:label: position
@graph.name: position
@graph.rdfs:comment: The position of an item in a series or sequence of items.

@graph.rdfs:label: OfferShippingDetails
@graph.name: OfferShippingDetails
@graph.rdfs:comment:
OfferShippingDetails represents information about shipping destinations.

Multiple of these entities can be used to represent different shipping rates for different destinations:

One entity for Alaska/Hawaii. A different one for continental US. A different one for all France.

Multiple of these entities can be used to represent different shipping costs and delivery times.

Two entities that are identical but differ in rate and time:

E.g. Cheaper and slower: $5 in 5-7 days
or Fast and expensive: $15 in 1-2 days.

@graph.rdfs:label: identifyingTest
@graph.name: identifyingTest
@graph.rdfs:comment: A diagnostic test that can identify this sign.

@graph.rdfs:label: datasetTimeInterval
@graph.name: datasetTimeInterval
@graph.rdfs:comment: The range of temporal applicability of a dataset, e.g. for a 2011 census dataset, the year 2011 (in ISO 8601 time interval format).

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumICUBeds
@graph.name: cvdNumICUBeds
@graph.rdfs:comment: numicubeds - ICU BEDS: Total number of staffed inpatient intensive care unit (ICU) beds.

@graph.rdfs:label: ReviewAction
@graph.name: ReviewAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of producing a balanced opinion about the object for an audience. An agent reviews an object with participants resulting in a review.

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastFrequency
@graph.name: broadcastFrequency
@graph.rdfs:comment: The frequency used for over-the-air broadcasts. Numeric values or simple ranges, e.g. 87-99. In addition a shortcut idiom is supported for frequencies of AM and FM radio channels, e.g. "87 FM".

@graph.rdfs:label: Continent
@graph.name: Continent
@graph.rdfs:comment: One of the continents (for example, Europe or Africa).

@graph.rdfs:label: ReadAction
@graph.name: ReadAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of consuming written content.

@graph.rdfs:label: RoofingContractor
@graph.name: RoofingContractor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A roofing contractor.

@graph.rdfs:label: speechToTextMarkup
@graph.name: speechToTextMarkup
@graph.rdfs:comment: Form of markup used. eg. [SSML](https://www.w3.org/TR/speech-synthesis11) or [IPA](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Property:P898).

@graph.rdfs:label: DryCleaningOrLaundry
@graph.name: DryCleaningOrLaundry
@graph.rdfs:comment: A dry-cleaning business.

@graph.rdfs:label: employerOverview
@graph.name: employerOverview
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the employer, career opportunities and work environment for this position.

@graph.rdfs:label: Clip
@graph.name: Clip
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short TV or radio program or a segment/part of a program.

@graph.rdfs:label: steeringPosition
@graph.name: steeringPosition
