@graph.rdfs:comment: The position of the steering wheel or similar device (mostly for cars).

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalSignOrSymptom
@graph.name: MedicalSignOrSymptom
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any feature associated or not with a medical condition. In medicine a symptom is generally subjective while a sign is objective.

@graph.rdfs:label: StatisticalVariable
@graph.name: StatisticalVariable
@graph.rdfs:comment: [[StatisticalVariable]] represents any type of statistical metric that can be measured at a place and time. The usage pattern for [[StatisticalVariable]] is typically expressed using [[Observation]] with an explicit [[populationType]], which is a type, typically drawn from Schema.org. Each [[StatisticalVariable]] is marked as a [[ConstraintNode]], meaning that some properties (those listed using [[constraintProperty]]) serve in this setting solely to define the statistical variable rather than literally describe a specific person, place or thing. For example, a [[StatisticalVariable]] Median_Height_Person_Female representing the median height of women, could be written as follows: the population type is [[Person]]; the measuredProperty [[height]]; the [[statType]] [[median]]; the [[gender]] [[Female]]. It is important to note that there are many kinds of scientific quantitative observation which are not fully, perfectly or unambiguously described following this pattern, or with solely Schema.org terminology. The approach taken here is designed to allow partial, incremental or minimal description of [[StatisticalVariable]]s, and the use of detailed sets of entity and property IDs from external repositories. The [[measurementMethod]], [[unitCode]] and [[unitText]] properties can also be used to clarify the specific nature and notation of an observed measurement.

@graph.rdfs:label: GroceryStore
@graph.name: GroceryStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A grocery store.

@graph.rdfs:label: LodgingReservation
@graph.name: LodgingReservation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reservation for lodging at a hotel, motel, inn, etc.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations.

@graph.rdfs:label: availableDeliveryMethod
@graph.name: availableDeliveryMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: The delivery method(s) available for this offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: seasonNumber
@graph.name: seasonNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: Position of the season within an ordered group of seasons.

@graph.rdfs:label: sourcedFrom
@graph.name: sourcedFrom
@graph.rdfs:comment: The neurological pathway that originates the neurons.

@graph.rdfs:label: HealthAndBeautyBusiness
@graph.name: HealthAndBeautyBusiness
@graph.rdfs:comment: Health and beauty.

@graph.rdfs:label: subTest
@graph.name: subTest
@graph.rdfs:comment: A component test of the panel.

@graph.rdfs:label: broker
@graph.name: broker
@graph.rdfs:comment: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller.  In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange.  If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.

@graph.rdfs:label: TravelAction
@graph.name: TravelAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of traveling from a fromLocation to a destination by a specified mode of transport, optionally with participants.

@graph.rdfs:label: instructor
@graph.name: instructor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person assigned to instruct or provide instructional assistance for the [[CourseInstance]].

@graph.rdfs:label: variantCover
@graph.name: variantCover
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A description of the variant cover
    	for the issue, if the issue is a variant printing. For example, "Bryan Hitch
    	Variant Cover" or "2nd Printing Variant".

@graph.rdfs:label: publisherImprint
@graph.name: publisherImprint
@graph.rdfs:comment: The publishing division which published the comic.

@graph.rdfs:label: XPathType
@graph.name: XPathType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Text representing an XPath (typically but not necessarily version 1.0).

@graph.rdfs:label: arrivalBusStop
@graph.name: arrivalBusStop
@graph.rdfs:comment: The stop or station from which the bus arrives.

@graph.rdfs:label: includedComposition
@graph.name: includedComposition
@graph.rdfs:comment: Smaller compositions included in this work (e.g. a movement in a symphony).

@graph.rdfs:label: NLNonprofitType
@graph.name: NLNonprofitType
@graph.rdfs:comment: NLNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the Netherlands.

@graph.rdfs:label: providesService
@graph.name: providesService
@graph.rdfs:comment: The service provided by this channel.

@graph.rdfs:label: associatedReview
@graph.name: associatedReview
@graph.rdfs:comment: An associated [[Review]].

@graph.rdfs:label: GovernmentOffice
@graph.name: GovernmentOffice
@graph.rdfs:comment: A government office—for example, an IRS or DMV office.

@graph.rdfs:label: addressCountry
@graph.name: addressCountry
@graph.rdfs:comment: The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1) format, for example "US". For backward compatibility, a 3-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3) country code such as "SGP" or a full country name such as "Singapore" can also be used.

@graph.rdfs:label: paymentMethodType
@graph.name: paymentMethodType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of a payment method.

@graph.rdfs:label: occupancy
@graph.name: occupancy
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The allowed total occupancy for the accommodation in persons (including infants etc). For individual accommodations, this is not necessarily the legal maximum but defines the permitted usage as per the contractual agreement (e.g. a double room used by a single person).
Typical unit code(s): C62 for person.

@graph.rdfs:label: identifier
@graph.name: identifier
@graph.rdfs:comment: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.

@graph.rdfs:label: StatisticalPopulation
@graph.name: StatisticalPopulation
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A StatisticalPopulation is a set of instances of a certain given type that satisfy some set of constraints. The property [[populationType]] is used to specify the type. Any property that can be used on instances of that type can appear on the statistical population. For example, a [[StatisticalPopulation]] representing all [[Person]]s with a [[homeLocation]] of East Podunk California would be described by applying the appropriate [[homeLocation]] and [[populationType]] properties to a [[StatisticalPopulation]] item that stands for that set of people.
The properties [[numConstraints]] and [[constraintProperty]] are used to specify which of the populations properties are used to specify the population. Note that the sense of "population" used here is the general sense of a statistical
population, and does not imply that the population consists of people. For example, a [[populationType]] of [[Event]] or [[NewsArticle]] could be used. See also [[Observation]], where a [[populationType]] such as [[Person]] or [[Event]] can be indicated directly. In most cases it may be better to use [[StatisticalVariable]] instead of [[StatisticalPopulation]].

@graph.rdfs:label: data
@graph.name: data
@graph.rdfs:comment: Data associated with the event, like for instance a log message.

@graph.rdfs:label: episode
@graph.name: episode
@graph.rdfs:comment: An episode of a TV, radio or game media within a series or season.

@graph.rdfs:label: issuedBy
@graph.name: issuedBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: The organization issuing the item, for example a [[Permit]], [[Ticket]], or [[Certification]].

@graph.rdfs:label: title
@graph.name: title
@graph.rdfs:comment: The title of the job.

@graph.rdfs:label: DonateAction
@graph.name: DonateAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of providing goods, services, or money without compensation, often for philanthropic reasons.

@graph.rdfs:label: incentivizedItem
@graph.name: incentivizedItem
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The type or specific product(s) and/or service(s) being incentivized.

DefinedTermSets are used for product and service categories such as the United Nations Standard Products and Services Code:

{ "@type": "DefinedTerm", "inDefinedTermSet": "https://www.unspsc.org/", "termCode": "261315XX", "name": "Photovoltaic module" }

For a specific product or service, use the Product type:

{ "@type": "Product", "name": "Kenmore White 17" Microwave", } For multiple different incentivized items, use multiple [[DefinedTerm]] or [[Product]].

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfBathroomsTotal
@graph.name: numberOfBathroomsTotal
@graph.rdfs:comment: The total integer number of bathrooms in some [[Accommodation]], following real estate conventions as [documented in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsTotalInteger+Field): "The simple sum of the number of bathrooms. For example for a property with two Full Bathrooms and one Half Bathroom, the Bathrooms Total Integer will be 3.". See also [[numberOfRooms]].

@graph.rdfs:label: ShortStory
@graph.name: ShortStory
@graph.rdfs:comment: Short story or tale. A brief work of literature, usually written in narrative prose.

@graph.rdfs:label: eligibleQuantity
@graph.name: eligibleQuantity
@graph.rdfs:comment: The interval and unit of measurement of ordering quantities for which the offer or price specification is valid. This allows e.g. specifying that a certain freight charge is valid only for a certain quantity.

@graph.rdfs:label: mainEntityOfPage
@graph.name: mainEntityOfPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a page (or other CreativeWork) for which this thing is the main entity being described. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#mainEntityBackground) for details.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalTherapy
@graph.name: MedicalTherapy
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any medical intervention designed to prevent, treat, and cure human diseases and medical conditions, including both curative and palliative therapies. Medical therapies are typically processes of care relying upon pharmacotherapy, behavioral therapy, supportive therapy (with fluid or nutrition for example), or detoxification (e.g. hemodialysis) aimed at improving or preventing a health condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: DrugStrength
@graph.name: DrugStrength
@graph.rdfs:comment: A specific strength in which a medical drug is available in a specific country.

@graph.rdfs:label: costPerUnit
@graph.name: costPerUnit
@graph.rdfs:comment: The cost per unit of the drug.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfDoors
@graph.name: numberOfDoors
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of doors.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

@graph.rdfs:label: BrokerageAccount
@graph.name: BrokerageAccount
@graph.rdfs:comment: An account that allows an investor to deposit funds and place investment orders with a licensed broker or brokerage firm.

@graph.rdfs:label: audience
@graph.name: audience
@graph.rdfs:comment: An intended audience, i.e. a group for whom something was created.

@graph.rdfs:label: BodyOfWater
@graph.name: BodyOfWater
@graph.rdfs:comment: A body of water, such as a sea, ocean, or lake.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfBedrooms
@graph.name: numberOfBedrooms
@graph.rdfs:comment: The total integer number of bedrooms in a some [[Accommodation]], [[ApartmentComplex]] or [[FloorPlan]].

@graph.rdfs:label: greaterOrEqual
@graph.name: greaterOrEqual
@graph.rdfs:comment: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is greater than or equal to the object.

@graph.rdfs:label: RadioSeason
@graph.name: RadioSeason
@graph.rdfs:comment: Season dedicated to radio broadcast and associated online delivery.

@graph.rdfs:label: relatedLink
@graph.name: relatedLink
@graph.rdfs:comment: A link related to this web page, for example to other related web pages.

@graph.rdfs:label: guidelineDate
@graph.name: guidelineDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date on which this guideline's recommendation was made.

@graph.rdfs:label: subOrganization
@graph.name: subOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: A relationship between two organizations where the first includes the second, e.g., as a subsidiary. See also: the more specific 'department' property.

@graph.rdfs:label: ReportageNewsArticle
@graph.name: ReportageNewsArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The [[ReportageNewsArticle]] type is a subtype of [[NewsArticle]] representing
 news articles which are the result of journalistic news reporting conventions.

In practice many news publishers produce a wide variety of article types, many of which might be considered a [[NewsArticle]] but not a [[ReportageNewsArticle]]. For example, opinion pieces, reviews, analysis, sponsored or satirical articles, or articles that combine several of these elements.

The [[ReportageNewsArticle]] type is based on a stricter ideal for "news" as a work of journalism, with articles based on factual information either observed or verified by the author, or reported and verified from knowledgeable sources.  This often includes perspectives from multiple viewpoints on a particular issue (distinguishing news reports from public relations or propaganda).  News reports in the [[ReportageNewsArticle]] sense de-emphasize the opinion of the author, with commentary and value judgements typically expressed elsewhere.

A [[ReportageNewsArticle]] which goes deeper into analysis can also be marked with an additional type of [[AnalysisNewsArticle]].

@graph.rdfs:label: Barcode
@graph.name: Barcode
@graph.rdfs:comment: An image of a visual machine-readable code such as a barcode or QR code.

@graph.rdfs:label: director
@graph.name: director
@graph.rdfs:comment: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video gaming etc. content, or of an event. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

@graph.rdfs:label: proficiencyLevel
@graph.name: proficiencyLevel
@graph.rdfs:comment: Proficiency needed for this content; expected values: 'Beginner', 'Expert'.

@graph.rdfs:label: vehicleIdentificationNumber
@graph.name: vehicleIdentificationNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is a unique serial number used by the automotive industry to identify individual motor vehicles.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalTest
@graph.name: MedicalTest
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any medical test, typically performed for diagnostic purposes.

@graph.rdfs:label: WearableMeasurementTypeEnumeration
@graph.name: WearableMeasurementTypeEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates common types of measurement for wearables products.

@graph.rdfs:label: domiciledMortgage
@graph.name: domiciledMortgage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether borrower is a resident of the jurisdiction where the property is located.

@graph.rdfs:label: PsychologicalTreatment
@graph.name: PsychologicalTreatment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A process of care relying upon counseling, dialogue and communication  aimed at improving a mental health condition without use of drugs.

@graph.rdfs:label: incentiveAmount
@graph.name: incentiveAmount
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Describes the amount that can be redeemed from this incentive.

[[QuantitativeValue]]: Use this for incentives based on price (either raw amount or percentage-based). For a raw amount example, "You can claim $2,500 - $7,500 from the total cost of installation" would be represented as the following:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", “minValue”: 2500, “maxValue”: 7500, "unitCode": "USD" }

[[QuantitativeValue]] can also be used for percentage amounts. In such cases, value is used to represent the incentive’s percentage, while maxValue represents a limit (if one exists) to that incentive. The unitCode should be 'P1' and the unitText should be '%', while valueReference should be used for holding the currency type. For example, "You can claim up to 30% of the total cost of installation, up to a maximum of $7,500" would be:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "value": 30, "unitCode": "P1", "unitText": "%", “maxValue”: 7500, “valueReference”: “USD” }

[[UnitPriceSpecification]]: Use this for incentives that are based on amounts rather than price. For example, a net metering rebate that pays $10/kWh, up to $1,000:

{ "@type": "UnitPriceSpecification", "price": 10, "priceCurrency": "USD", "referenceQuantity": 1, "unitCode": "DO3", "unitText": "kw/h", "maxPrice": 1000, "description": "$10 / kwh up to $1000" }

[[LoanOrCredit]]: Use for incentives that are loan based. For example, a loan of $4,000 - $50,000 with a repayment term of 10 years, interest free would look like:

{ "@type": "LoanOrCredit", "loanTerm": { "@type":"QuantitativeValue", "value":"10", "unitCode": "ANN" }, "amount":[ { "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "Name":"fixed interest rate", "value":"0", }, ], "amount":[ { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"min loan amount", "value":"4000", "currency":"CAD" }, { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"max loan amount", "value":"50000", "currency":"CAD" } ], } In summary:
  • Use [[QuantitativeValue]] for absolute/percentage-based incentives applied on the price of a good/service.
  • Use [[UnitPriceSpecification]] for incentives based on a per-unit basis (e.g. net metering).
  • Use [[LoanOrCredit]] for loans/credits.
.

@graph.rdfs:label: jobImmediateStart
@graph.name: jobImmediateStart
@graph.rdfs:comment: An indicator as to whether a position is available for an immediate start.

@graph.rdfs:label: BookSeries
@graph.name: BookSeries
@graph.rdfs:comment: A series of books. Included books can be indicated with the hasPart property.

@graph.rdfs:label: isPartOfBioChemEntity
@graph.name: isPartOfBioChemEntity
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a BioChemEntity that is (in some sense) a part of this BioChemEntity.

@graph.rdfs:label: material
@graph.name: material
@graph.rdfs:comment: A material that something is made from, e.g. leather, wool, cotton, paper.

@graph.rdfs:label: numAdults
@graph.name: numAdults
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of adults staying in the unit.

@graph.rdfs:label: URL
@graph.name: URL
@graph.rdfs:comment: Data type: URL.

@graph.rdfs:label: providesBroadcastService
@graph.name: providesBroadcastService
@graph.rdfs:comment: The BroadcastService offered on this channel.

@graph.rdfs:label: Recommendation
@graph.name: Recommendation
@graph.rdfs:comment: [[Recommendation]] is a type of [[Review]] that suggests or proposes something as the best option or best course of action. Recommendations may be for products or services, or other concrete things, as in the case of a ranked list or product guide. A [[Guide]] may list multiple recommendations for different categories. For example, in a [[Guide]] about which TVs to buy, the author may have several [[Recommendation]]s.

@graph.rdfs:label: entertainmentBusiness
@graph.name: entertainmentBusiness
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of location. The entertainment business where the action occurred.

@graph.rdfs:label: QuantitativeValueDistribution
@graph.name: QuantitativeValueDistribution
@graph.rdfs:comment: A statistical distribution of values.

@graph.rdfs:label: downvoteCount
@graph.name: downvoteCount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of downvotes this question, answer or comment has received from the community.

@graph.rdfs:label: actionOption
@graph.name: actionOption
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of object. The options subject to this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: PlanAction
@graph.name: PlanAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of planning the execution of an event/task/action/reservation/plan to a future date.

@graph.rdfs:label: lesserOrEqual
@graph.name: lesserOrEqual
@graph.rdfs:comment: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than or equal to the object.

@graph.rdfs:label: RecommendedDoseSchedule
@graph.name: RecommendedDoseSchedule
@graph.rdfs:comment: A recommended dosing schedule for a drug or supplement as prescribed or recommended by an authority or by the drug/supplement's manufacturer. Capture the recommending authority in the recognizingAuthority property of MedicalEntity.

@graph.rdfs:label: renegotiableLoan
@graph.name: renegotiableLoan
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether the terms for payment of interest can be renegotiated during the life of the loan.

@graph.rdfs:label: pattern
@graph.name: pattern
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pattern that something has, for example 'polka dot', 'striped', 'Canadian flag'. Values are typically expressed as text, although links to controlled value schemes are also supported.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfPages
@graph.name: numberOfPages
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of pages in the book.

@graph.rdfs:label: DriveWheelConfigurationValue
@graph.name: DriveWheelConfigurationValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: A value indicating which roadwheels will receive torque.

@graph.rdfs:label: honorificPrefix
@graph.name: honorificPrefix
@graph.rdfs:comment: An honorific prefix preceding a Person's name such as Dr/Mrs/Mr.

@graph.rdfs:label: SolveMathAction
@graph.name: SolveMathAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The action that takes in a math expression and directs users to a page potentially capable of solving/simplifying that expression.

@graph.rdfs:label: Number
@graph.name: Number
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Data type: Number.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

@graph.rdfs:label: BroadcastEvent
@graph.name: BroadcastEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: An over the air or online broadcast event.

@graph.rdfs:label: quarantineGuidelines
@graph.name: quarantineGuidelines
@graph.rdfs:comment: Guidelines about quarantine rules, e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

@graph.rdfs:label: seasonalOverride
@graph.name: seasonalOverride
@graph.rdfs:comment: Limited period during which these shipping conditions apply.

@graph.rdfs:label: Observation
@graph.name: Observation
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Instances of the class [[Observation]] are used to specify observations about an entity at a particular time. The principal properties of an [[Observation]] are [[observationAbout]], [[measuredProperty]], [[statType]], [[value] and [[observationDate]]  and [[measuredProperty]]. Some but not all Observations represent a [[QuantitativeValue]]. Quantitative observations can be about a [[StatisticalVariable]], which is an abstract specification about which we can make observations that are grounded at a particular location and time.

Observations can also encode a subset of simple RDF-like statements (its observationAbout, a StatisticalVariable, defining the measuredPoperty; its observationAbout property indicating the entity the statement is about, and [[value]] )

In the context of a quantitative knowledge graph, typical properties could include [[measuredProperty]], [[observationAbout]], [[observationDate]], [[value]], [[unitCode]], [[unitText]], [[measurementMethod]].

@graph.rdfs:label: Notary
@graph.name: Notary
@graph.rdfs:comment: A notary.

@graph.rdfs:label: namedPosition
@graph.name: namedPosition
@graph.rdfs:comment: A position played, performed or filled by a person or organization, as part of an organization. For example, an athlete in a SportsTeam might play in the position named 'Quarterback'.

@graph.rdfs:label: customerRemorseReturnShippingFeesAmount
@graph.name: customerRemorseReturnShippingFeesAmount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The amount of shipping costs if a product is returned due to customer remorse. Applicable when property [[customerRemorseReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

@graph.rdfs:label: termCode
@graph.name: termCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A code that identifies this [[DefinedTerm]] within a [[DefinedTermSet]].

@graph.rdfs:label: albumReleaseType
@graph.name: albumReleaseType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalClinic
@graph.name: MedicalClinic
@graph.rdfs:comment: A facility, often associated with a hospital or medical school, that is devoted to the specific diagnosis and/or healthcare. Previously limited to outpatients but with evolution it may be open to inpatients as well.

@graph.rdfs:label: AmpStory
@graph.name: AmpStory
@graph.rdfs:comment: A creative work with a visual storytelling format intended to be viewed online, particularly on mobile devices.

@graph.rdfs:label: Vehicle
@graph.name: Vehicle
@graph.rdfs:comment: A vehicle is a device that is designed or used to transport people or cargo over land, water, air, or through space.

@graph.rdfs:label: amount
@graph.name: amount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The amount of money.

@graph.rdfs:label: UserPlays
@graph.name: UserPlays
@graph.rdfs:comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanCopay
@graph.name: healthPlanCopay
@graph.rdfs:comment: The copay amount.

@graph.rdfs:label: discusses
@graph.name: discusses
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies the CreativeWork associated with the UserComment.

@graph.rdfs:label: editor
@graph.name: editor
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies the Person who edited the CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: partOfInvoice
@graph.name: partOfInvoice
@graph.rdfs:comment: The order is being paid as part of the referenced Invoice.

@graph.rdfs:label: activityDuration
@graph.name: activityDuration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Length of time to engage in the activity.

@graph.rdfs:label: loser
@graph.name: loser
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of participant. The loser of the action.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationLegalForce
@graph.name: legislationLegalForce
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether the legislation is currently in force, not in force, or partially in force.

@graph.rdfs:label: ItemList
@graph.name: ItemList
@graph.rdfs:comment: A list of items of any sort—for example, Top 10 Movies About Weathermen, or Top 100 Party Songs. Not to be confused with HTML lists, which are often used only for formatting.

@graph.rdfs:label: HowToTool
@graph.name: HowToTool
@graph.rdfs:comment: A tool used (but not consumed) when performing instructions for how to achieve a result.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalObservationalStudy
@graph.name: MedicalObservationalStudy
@graph.rdfs:comment: An observational study is a type of medical study that attempts to infer the possible effect of a treatment through observation of a cohort of subjects over a period of time. In an observational study, the assignment of subjects into treatment groups versus control groups is outside the control of the investigator. This is in contrast with controlled studies, such as the randomized controlled trials represented by MedicalTrial, where each subject is randomly assigned to a treatment group or a control group before the start of the treatment.

@graph.rdfs:label: isbn
@graph.name: isbn
@graph.rdfs:comment: The ISBN of the book.

@graph.rdfs:label: FurnitureStore
@graph.name: FurnitureStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A furniture store.

@graph.rdfs:label: LegalValueLevel
@graph.name: LegalValueLevel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A list of possible levels for the legal validity of a legislation.

@graph.rdfs:label: NGO
@graph.name: NGO
@graph.rdfs:comment: Organization: Non-governmental Organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: calories
@graph.name: calories
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of calories.

@graph.rdfs:label: athlete
@graph.name: athlete
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person that acts as performing member of a sports team; a player as opposed to a coach.

@graph.rdfs:label: geoRadius
@graph.name: geoRadius
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the approximate radius of a GeoCircle (metres unless indicated otherwise via Distance notation).

@graph.rdfs:label: overdosage
@graph.name: overdosage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any information related to overdose on a drug, including signs or symptoms, treatments, contact information for emergency response.

@graph.rdfs:label: replacer
@graph.name: replacer
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of object. The object that replaces.

@graph.rdfs:label: loanMortgageMandateAmount
@graph.name: loanMortgageMandateAmount
@graph.rdfs:comment: Amount of mortgage mandate that can be converted into a proper mortgage at a later stage.

@graph.rdfs:label: spokenByCharacter
@graph.name: spokenByCharacter
@graph.rdfs:comment: The (e.g. fictional) character, Person or Organization to whom the quotation is attributed within the containing CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: thumbnail
@graph.name: thumbnail
@graph.rdfs:comment: Thumbnail image for an image or video.

@graph.rdfs:label: SelfStorage
@graph.name: SelfStorage
@graph.rdfs:comment: A self-storage facility.

@graph.rdfs:label: workTranslation
@graph.name: workTranslation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A work that is a translation of the content of this work. E.g. 西遊記 has an English workTranslation “Journey to the West”, a German workTranslation “Monkeys Pilgerfahrt” and a Vietnamese  translation Tây du ký bình khảo.

@graph.rdfs:label: GovernmentService
@graph.name: GovernmentService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A service provided by a government organization, e.g. food stamps, veterans benefits, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdCollectionDate
@graph.name: cvdCollectionDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: collectiondate - Date for which patient counts are reported.

@graph.rdfs:label: ReceiveAction
@graph.name: ReceiveAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of physically/electronically taking delivery of an object that has been transferred from an origin to a destination. Reciprocal of SendAction.

Related actions:

* [[SendAction]]: The reciprocal of ReceiveAction.
* [[TakeAction]]: Unlike TakeAction, ReceiveAction does not imply that the ownership has been transferred (e.g. I can receive a package, but it does not mean the package is now mine).

@graph.rdfs:label: FlightReservation
@graph.name: FlightReservation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reservation for air travel.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

@graph.rdfs:label: priceType
@graph.name: priceType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Defines the type of a price specified for an offered product, for example a list price, a (temporary) sale price or a manufacturer suggested retail price. If multiple prices are specified for an offer the [[priceType]] property can be used to identify the type of each such specified price. The value of priceType can be specified as a value from enumeration PriceTypeEnumeration or, a UN/EDIFACT 5387 code, or as a free form text string for price types that are not already predefined in PriceTypeEnumeration.

@graph.rdfs:label: encodings
@graph.name: encodings
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: CourseInstance
@graph.name: CourseInstance
@graph.rdfs:comment: An instance of a [[Course]] which is distinct from other instances because it is offered at a different time or location or through different media or modes of study or to a specific section of students.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalEvidenceLevel
@graph.name: MedicalEvidenceLevel
@graph.rdfs:comment: Level of evidence for a medical guideline. Enumerated type.

@graph.rdfs:label: OfferCatalog
@graph.name: OfferCatalog
@graph.rdfs:comment: An OfferCatalog is an ItemList that contains related Offers and/or further OfferCatalogs that are offeredBy the same provider.

@graph.rdfs:label: TouristDestination
@graph.name: TouristDestination
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A tourist destination. In principle any [[Place]] can be a [[TouristDestination]] from a [[City]], Region or [[Country]] to an [[AmusementPark]] or [[Hotel]]. This Type can be used on its own to describe a general [[TouristDestination]], or be used as an [[additionalType]] to add tourist relevant properties to any other [[Place]].  A [[TouristDestination]] is defined as a [[Place]] that contains, or is colocated with, one or more [[TouristAttraction]]s, often linked by a similar theme or interest to a particular [[touristType]]. The [UNWTO](http://www2.unwto.org/) defines Destination (main destination of a tourism trip) as the place visited that is central to the decision to take the trip.
  (See examples below.)

@graph.rdfs:label: subEvents
@graph.name: subEvents
@graph.rdfs:comment: Events that are a part of this event. For example, a conference event includes many presentations, each subEvents of the conference.

@graph.rdfs:label: gtin
@graph.name: gtin
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A Global Trade Item Number ([GTIN](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin)). GTINs identify trade items, including products and services, using numeric identification codes.

A correct [[gtin]] value should be a valid GTIN, which means that it should be an all-numeric string of either 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, or a "GS1 Digital Link" URL based on such a string. The numeric component should also have a [valid GS1 check digit](https://www.gs1.org/services/check-digit-calculator) and meet the other rules for valid GTINs. See also [GS1's GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) and [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Global_Trade_Item_Number) for more details. Left-padding of the gtin values is not required or encouraged. The [[gtin]] property generalizes the earlier [[gtin8]], [[gtin12]], [[gtin13]], and [[gtin14]] properties.

The GS1 [digital link specifications](https://www.gs1.org/standards/Digital-Link/) expresses GTINs as URLs (URIs, IRIs, etc.).
Digital Links should be populated into the [[hasGS1DigitalLink]] attribute.

Note also that this is a definition for how to include GTINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of GTINs in general - see the GS1 documentation for authoritative details.

@graph.rdfs:label: inCodeSet
@graph.name: inCodeSet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[CategoryCodeSet]] that contains this category code.

@graph.rdfs:label: userInteractionCount
@graph.name: userInteractionCount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of interactions for the CreativeWork using the WebSite or SoftwareApplication.

@graph.rdfs:label: possibleTreatment
@graph.name: possibleTreatment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A possible treatment to address this condition, sign or symptom.

@graph.rdfs:label: EnergyStarEnergyEfficiencyEnumeration
@graph.name: EnergyStarEnergyEfficiencyEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Used to indicate whether a product is EnergyStar certified.

@graph.rdfs:label: industry
@graph.name: industry
@graph.rdfs:comment: The industry associated with the job position.

@graph.rdfs:label: Artery
@graph.name: Artery
@graph.rdfs:comment: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries blood away from the heart.

@graph.rdfs:label: experienceRequirements
@graph.name: experienceRequirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: Description of skills and experience needed for the position or Occupation.

@graph.rdfs:label: workload
@graph.name: workload
@graph.rdfs:comment: Quantitative measure of the physiologic output of the exercise; also referred to as energy expenditure.

@graph.rdfs:label: codeRepository
@graph.name: codeRepository
@graph.rdfs:comment: Link to the repository where the un-compiled, human readable code and related code is located (SVN, GitHub, CodePlex).

@graph.rdfs:label: encoding
@graph.name: encoding
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for associatedMedia.

@graph.rdfs:label: PaymentChargeSpecification
@graph.name: PaymentChargeSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: The costs of settling the payment using a particular payment method.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicAlbumReleaseType
@graph.name: MusicAlbumReleaseType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

@graph.rdfs:label: CableOrSatelliteService
@graph.name: CableOrSatelliteService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A service which provides access to media programming like TV or radio. Access may be via cable or satellite.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalIntangible
@graph.name: MedicalIntangible
@graph.rdfs:comment: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things in the medical space.

@graph.rdfs:label: acceptsReservations
@graph.name: acceptsReservations
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether a FoodEstablishment accepts reservations. Values can be Boolean, an URL at which reservations can be made or (for backwards compatibility) the strings ```Yes``` or ```No```.

@graph.rdfs:label: membershipNumber
@graph.name: membershipNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for the membership.

@graph.rdfs:label: PaymentService
@graph.name: PaymentService
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Service to transfer funds from a person or organization to a beneficiary person or organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: returnLabelSource
@graph.name: returnLabelSource
@graph.rdfs:comment: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned for any reason.

@graph.rdfs:label: CheckAction
@graph.name: CheckAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: An agent inspects, determines, investigates, inquires, or examines an object's accuracy, quality, condition, or state.

@graph.rdfs:label: RealEstateListing
@graph.name: RealEstateListing
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A [[RealEstateListing]] is a listing that describes one or more real-estate [[Offer]]s (whose [[businessFunction]] is typically to lease out, or to sell).
  The [[RealEstateListing]] type itself represents the overall listing, as manifested in some [[WebPage]].

@graph.rdfs:label: accessibilityHazard
@graph.name: accessibilityHazard
@graph.rdfs:comment: A characteristic of the described resource that is physiologically dangerous to some users. Related to WCAG 2.0 guideline 2.3. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityHazard-vocabulary).

@graph.rdfs:label: InteractionCounter
@graph.name: InteractionCounter
@graph.rdfs:comment: A summary of how users have interacted with this CreativeWork. In most cases, authors will use a subtype to specify the specific type of interaction.

@graph.rdfs:label: softwareAddOn
@graph.name: softwareAddOn
@graph.rdfs:comment: Additional content for a software application.

@graph.rdfs:label: itemLocation
@graph.name: itemLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Current location of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: colorSwatch
@graph.name: colorSwatch
@graph.rdfs:comment: A color swatch image, visualizing the color of a [[Product]]. Should match the textual description specified in the [[color]] property. This can be a URL or a fully described ImageObject.

@graph.rdfs:label: repeatCount
@graph.name: repeatCount
@graph.rdfs:comment: Defines the number of times a recurring [[Event]] will take place.

@graph.rdfs:label: sourceOrganization
@graph.name: sourceOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: The Organization on whose behalf the creator was working.

@graph.rdfs:label: worksFor
@graph.name: worksFor
@graph.rdfs:comment: Organizations that the person works for.

@graph.rdfs:label: transcript
@graph.name: transcript
@graph.rdfs:comment: If this MediaObject is an AudioObject or VideoObject, the transcript of that object.

@graph.rdfs:label: BoardingPolicyType
@graph.name: BoardingPolicyType
@graph.rdfs:comment: A type of boarding policy used by an airline.

@graph.rdfs:label: inProductGroupWithID
@graph.name: inProductGroupWithID
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the [[productGroupID]] for a [[ProductGroup]] that this product [[isVariantOf]].

@graph.rdfs:label: AssessAction
@graph.name: AssessAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of forming one's opinion, reaction or sentiment.

@graph.rdfs:label: steps
@graph.name: steps
@graph.rdfs:comment: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection (originally misnamed 'steps'; 'step' is preferred).

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationResponsible
@graph.name: legislationResponsible
@graph.rdfs:comment: An individual or organization that has some kind of responsibility for the legislation. Typically the ministry who is/was in charge of elaborating the legislation, or the adressee for potential questions about the legislation once it is published.

@graph.rdfs:label: identifyingExam
@graph.name: identifyingExam
@graph.rdfs:comment: A physical examination that can identify this sign.

@graph.rdfs:label: proteinContent
@graph.name: proteinContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of grams of protein.

@graph.rdfs:label: DepositAccount
@graph.name: DepositAccount
@graph.rdfs:comment: A type of Bank Account with a main purpose of depositing funds to gain interest or other benefits.

@graph.rdfs:label: children
@graph.name: children
@graph.rdfs:comment: A child of the person.

@graph.rdfs:label: artworkSurface
@graph.name: artworkSurface
@graph.rdfs:comment: The supporting materials for the artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: variableMeasured
@graph.name: variableMeasured
@graph.rdfs:comment: The variableMeasured property can indicate (repeated as necessary) the  variables that are measured in some dataset, either described as text or as pairs of identifier and description using PropertyValue, or more explicitly as a [[StatisticalVariable]].

@graph.rdfs:label: occupationalCategory
@graph.name: occupationalCategory
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A category describing the job, preferably using a term from a taxonomy such as [BLS O*NET-SOC](http://www.onetcenter.org/taxonomy.html), [ISCO-08](https://www.ilo.org/public/english/bureau/stat/isco/isco08/) or similar, with the property repeated for each applicable value. Ideally the taxonomy should be identified, and both the textual label and formal code for the category should be provided.\n
Note: for historical reasons, any textual label and formal code provided as a literal may be assumed to be from O*NET-SOC.

@graph.rdfs:label: pregnancyWarning
@graph.name: pregnancyWarning
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use during pregnancy.

@graph.rdfs:label: signOrSymptom
@graph.name: signOrSymptom
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sign or symptom of this condition. Signs are objective or physically observable manifestations of the medical condition while symptoms are the subjective experience of the medical condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: ReactAction
@graph.name: ReactAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of responding instinctively and emotionally to an object, expressing a sentiment.

@graph.rdfs:label: AmusementPark
@graph.name: AmusementPark
@graph.rdfs:comment: An amusement park.

@graph.rdfs:label: diseaseSpreadStatistics
@graph.name: diseaseSpreadStatistics
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Statistical information about the spread of a disease, either as [[WebContent]], or
  described directly as a [[Dataset]], or the specific [[Observation]]s in the dataset. When a [[WebContent]] URL is
  provided, the page indicated might also contain more such markup.

@graph.rdfs:label: area
@graph.name: area
@graph.rdfs:comment: The area within which users can expect to reach the broadcast service.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasCourse
@graph.name: hasCourse
@graph.rdfs:comment: A course or class that is one of the learning opportunities that constitute an educational / occupational program. No information is implied about whether the course is mandatory or optional; no guarantee is implied about whether the course will be available to everyone on the program.

@graph.rdfs:label: Report
@graph.name: Report
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Report generated by governmental or non-governmental organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: merchant
@graph.name: merchant
@graph.rdfs:comment: 'merchant' is an out-dated term for 'seller'.

@graph.rdfs:label: availableIn
@graph.name: availableIn
@graph.rdfs:comment: The location in which the strength is available.

@graph.rdfs:label: ComputerStore
@graph.name: ComputerStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A computer store.

@graph.rdfs:label: WinAction
@graph.name: WinAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of achieving victory in a competitive activity.

@graph.rdfs:label: countryOfAssembly
@graph.name: countryOfAssembly
@graph.rdfs:comment: The place where the product was assembled.

@graph.rdfs:label: SportsOrganization
@graph.name: SportsOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the collection of all sports organizations, including sports teams, governing bodies, and sports associations.

@graph.rdfs:label: reviewCount
@graph.name: reviewCount
@graph.rdfs:comment: The count of total number of reviews.

@graph.rdfs:label: ItemListOrderType
@graph.name: ItemListOrderType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerated for values for itemListOrder for indicating how an ordered ItemList is organized.

@graph.rdfs:label: geographicArea
@graph.name: geographicArea
@graph.rdfs:comment: The geographic area associated with the audience.

@graph.rdfs:label: FireStation
@graph.name: FireStation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A fire station. With firemen.

@graph.rdfs:label: dateIssued
@graph.name: dateIssued
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date the ticket was issued.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasCategoryCode
@graph.name: hasCategoryCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Category code contained in this code set.

@graph.rdfs:label: requiresSubscription
@graph.name: requiresSubscription
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates if use of the media require a subscription  (either paid or free). Allowed values are ```true``` or ```false``` (note that an earlier version had 'yes', 'no').

@graph.rdfs:label: nonEqual
@graph.name: nonEqual
@graph.rdfs:comment: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is not equal to the object.

@graph.rdfs:label: sdLicense
@graph.name: sdLicense
@graph.rdfs:comment: A license document that applies to this structured data, typically indicated by URL.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalRiskCalculator
@graph.name: MedicalRiskCalculator
@graph.rdfs:comment: A complex mathematical calculation requiring an online calculator, used to assess prognosis. Note: use the url property of Thing to record any URLs for online calculators.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalRiskScore
@graph.name: MedicalRiskScore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A simple system that adds up the number of risk factors to yield a score that is associated with prognosis, e.g. CHAD score, TIMI risk score.

@graph.rdfs:label: DislikeAction
@graph.name: DislikeAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of expressing a negative sentiment about the object. An agent dislikes an object (a proposition, topic or theme) with participants.

@graph.rdfs:label: MoneyTransfer
@graph.name: MoneyTransfer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of transferring money from one place to another place. This may occur electronically or physically.

@graph.rdfs:label: ChildCare
@graph.name: ChildCare
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Childcare center.

@graph.rdfs:label: browserRequirements
@graph.name: browserRequirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies browser requirements in human-readable text. For example, 'requires HTML5 support'.

@graph.rdfs:label: PaymentCard
@graph.name: PaymentCard
@graph.rdfs:comment: A payment method using a credit, debit, store or other card to associate the payment with an account.

@graph.rdfs:label: usageInfo
@graph.name: usageInfo
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The schema.org [[usageInfo]] property indicates further information about a [[CreativeWork]]. This property is applicable both to works that are freely available and to those that require payment or other transactions. It can reference additional information, e.g. community expectations on preferred linking and citation conventions, as well as purchasing details. For something that can be commercially licensed, usageInfo can provide detailed, resource-specific information about licensing options.

This property can be used alongside the license property which indicates license(s) applicable to some piece of content. The usageInfo property can provide information about other licensing options, e.g. acquiring commercial usage rights for an image that is also available under non-commercial creative commons licenses.

@graph.rdfs:label: OrderItem
@graph.name: OrderItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: An order item is a line of an order. It includes the quantity and shipping details of a bought offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: QAPage
@graph.name: QAPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: A QAPage is a WebPage focussed on a specific Question and its Answer(s), e.g. in a question answering site or documenting Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs).

@graph.rdfs:label: contactType
@graph.name: contactType
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person or organization can have different contact points, for different purposes. For example, a sales contact point, a PR contact point and so on. This property is used to specify the kind of contact point.

@graph.rdfs:label: diagram
@graph.name: diagram
@graph.rdfs:comment: An image containing a diagram that illustrates the structure and/or its component substructures and/or connections with other structures.

@graph.rdfs:label: processingTime
@graph.name: processingTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: Estimated processing time for the service using this channel.

@graph.rdfs:label: ReturnLabelSourceEnumeration
@graph.name: ReturnLabelSourceEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates several types of return labels for product returns.

@graph.rdfs:label: InteractAction
@graph.name: InteractAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of interacting with another person or organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: TVSeries
@graph.name: TVSeries
@graph.rdfs:comment: CreativeWorkSeries dedicated to TV broadcast and associated online delivery.

@graph.rdfs:label: Ticket
@graph.name: Ticket
@graph.rdfs:comment: Used to describe a ticket to an event, a flight, a bus ride, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: significantLinks
@graph.name: significantLinks
@graph.rdfs:comment: The most significant URLs on the page. Typically, these are the non-navigation links that are clicked on the most.

@graph.rdfs:label: inverseOf
@graph.name: inverseOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: Relates a property to a property that is its inverse. Inverse properties relate the same pairs of items to each other, but in reversed direction. For example, the 'alumni' and 'alumniOf' properties are inverseOf each other. Some properties don't have explicit inverses; in these situations RDFa and JSON-LD syntax for reverse properties can be used.

@graph.rdfs:label: associatedMediaReview
@graph.name: associatedMediaReview
@graph.rdfs:comment: An associated [[MediaReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

@graph.rdfs:label: departureBoatTerminal
@graph.name: departureBoatTerminal
@graph.rdfs:comment: The terminal or port from which the boat departs.

@graph.rdfs:label: brand
@graph.name: brand
@graph.rdfs:comment: The brand(s) associated with a product or service, or the brand(s) maintained by an organization or business person.

@graph.rdfs:label: Dataset
@graph.name: Dataset
@graph.rdfs:comment: A body of structured information describing some topic(s) of interest.

@graph.rdfs:label: study
@graph.name: study
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical study or trial related to this entity.

@graph.rdfs:label: suggestedAge
@graph.name: suggestedAge
@graph.rdfs:comment: The age or age range for the intended audience or person, for example 3-12 months for infants, 1-5 years for toddlers.

@graph.rdfs:label: checkoutTime
@graph.name: checkoutTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The latest someone may check out of a lodging establishment.

@graph.rdfs:label: Florist
@graph.name: Florist
@graph.rdfs:comment: A florist.

@graph.rdfs:label: duration
@graph.name: duration
@graph.rdfs:comment: The duration of the item (movie, audio recording, event, etc.) in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

@graph.rdfs:label: differentialDiagnosis
@graph.name: differentialDiagnosis
@graph.rdfs:comment: One of a set of differential diagnoses for the condition. Specifically, a closely-related or competing diagnosis typically considered later in the cognitive process whereby this medical condition is distinguished from others most likely responsible for a similar collection of signs and symptoms to reach the most parsimonious diagnosis or diagnoses in a patient.

@graph.rdfs:label: MovingCompany
@graph.name: MovingCompany
@graph.rdfs:comment: A moving company.

@graph.rdfs:label: Museum
@graph.name: Museum
@graph.rdfs:comment: A museum.

@graph.rdfs:label: Resort
@graph.name: Resort
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A resort is a place used for relaxation or recreation, attracting visitors for holidays or vacations. Resorts are places, towns or sometimes commercial establishments operated by a single company (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Resort).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

@graph.rdfs:label: award
@graph.name: award
@graph.rdfs:comment: An award won by or for this item.

@graph.rdfs:label: dateReceived
@graph.name: dateReceived
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date/time the message was received if a single recipient exists.

@graph.rdfs:label: reservationStatus
@graph.name: reservationStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The current status of the reservation.

@graph.rdfs:label: reservationFor
@graph.name: reservationFor
@graph.rdfs:comment: The thing -- flight, event, restaurant, etc. being reserved.

@graph.rdfs:label: WebSite
@graph.name: WebSite
@graph.rdfs:comment: A WebSite is a set of related web pages and other items typically served from a single web domain and accessible via URLs.

@graph.rdfs:label: qualifiedExpense
@graph.name: qualifiedExpense
@graph.rdfs:comment: Optional. The types of expenses that are covered by the incentive. For example some incentives are only for the goods (tangible items) but the services (labor) are excluded.

@graph.rdfs:label: Drug
@graph.name: Drug
@graph.rdfs:comment: A chemical or biologic substance, used as a medical therapy, that has a physiological effect on an organism. Here the term drug is used interchangeably with the term medicine although clinical knowledge makes a clear difference between them.

@graph.rdfs:label: processorRequirements
@graph.name: processorRequirements
@graph.rdfs:comment: Processor architecture required to run the application (e.g. IA64).

@graph.rdfs:label: installUrl
@graph.name: installUrl
@graph.rdfs:comment: URL at which the app may be installed, if different from the URL of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: utterances
@graph.name: utterances
@graph.rdfs:comment: Text of an utterances (spoken words, lyrics etc.) that occurs at a certain section of a media object, represented as a [[HyperTocEntry]].

@graph.rdfs:label: orderedItem
@graph.name: orderedItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: The item ordered.

@graph.rdfs:label: OnlineBusiness
@graph.name: OnlineBusiness
@graph.rdfs:comment: A particular online business, either standalone or the online part of a broader organization. Examples include an eCommerce site, an online travel booking site, an online learning site, an online logistics and shipping provider, an online (virtual) doctor, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: ComedyEvent
@graph.name: ComedyEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Comedy event.

@graph.rdfs:label: CertificationStatusEnumeration
@graph.name: CertificationStatusEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates the different statuses of a Certification (Active and Inactive).

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfAxles
@graph.name: numberOfAxles
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of axles.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

@graph.rdfs:label: APIReference
@graph.name: APIReference
@graph.rdfs:comment: Reference documentation for application programming interfaces (APIs).

@graph.rdfs:label: billingDuration
@graph.name: billingDuration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies for how long this price (or price component) will be billed. Can be used, for example, to model the contractual duration of a subscription or payment plan. Type can be either a Duration or a Number (in which case the unit of measurement, for example month, is specified by the unitCode property).

@graph.rdfs:label: BoatTerminal
@graph.name: BoatTerminal
@graph.rdfs:comment: A terminal for boats, ships, and other water vessels.

@graph.rdfs:label: endOffset
@graph.name: endOffset
@graph.rdfs:comment: The end time of the clip expressed as the number of seconds from the beginning of the work.

@graph.rdfs:label: CategoryCodeSet
@graph.name: CategoryCodeSet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A set of Category Code values.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicAlbumProductionType
@graph.name: MusicAlbumProductionType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: TouristTrip
@graph.name: TouristTrip
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A tourist trip. A created itinerary of visits to one or more places of interest ([[TouristAttraction]]/[[TouristDestination]]) often linked by a similar theme, geographic area, or interest to a particular [[touristType]]. The [UNWTO](http://www2.unwto.org/) defines tourism trip as the Trip taken by visitors.
  (See examples below.)

@graph.rdfs:label: RadioChannel
@graph.name: RadioChannel
@graph.rdfs:comment: A unique instance of a radio BroadcastService on a CableOrSatelliteService lineup.

@graph.rdfs:label: SizeGroupEnumeration
@graph.name: SizeGroupEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates common size groups for various product categories.

@graph.rdfs:label: AutoRental
@graph.name: AutoRental
@graph.rdfs:comment: A car rental business.

@graph.rdfs:label: ImageObject
@graph.name: ImageObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: An image file.

@graph.rdfs:label: equal
@graph.name: equal
@graph.rdfs:comment: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is equal to the object.

@graph.rdfs:label: CommentAction
@graph.name: CommentAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of generating a comment about a subject.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationDate
@graph.name: legislationDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date of adoption or signature of the legislation. This is the date at which the text is officially aknowledged to be a legislation, even though it might not even be published or in force.

@graph.rdfs:label: ComicStory
@graph.name: ComicStory
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The term "story" is any indivisible, re-printable
    	unit of a comic, including the interior stories, covers, and backmatter. Most
    	comics have at least two stories: a cover (ComicCoverArt) and an interior story.

@graph.rdfs:label: ResearchProject
@graph.name: ResearchProject
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Research project.

@graph.rdfs:label: clincalPharmacology
@graph.name: clincalPharmacology
@graph.rdfs:comment: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).

@graph.rdfs:label: PlayAction
@graph.name: PlayAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of playing/exercising/training/performing for enjoyment, leisure, recreation, competition or exercise.

Related actions:

* [[ListenAction]]: Unlike ListenAction (which is under ConsumeAction), PlayAction refers to performing for an audience or at an event, rather than consuming music.
* [[WatchAction]]: Unlike WatchAction (which is under ConsumeAction), PlayAction refers to showing/displaying for an audience or at an event, rather than consuming visual content.

@graph.rdfs:label: latitude
@graph.name: latitude
@graph.rdfs:comment: The latitude of a location. For example ```37.42242``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

@graph.rdfs:label: ImagingTest
@graph.name: ImagingTest
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any medical imaging modality typically used for diagnostic purposes.

@graph.rdfs:label: RestrictedDiet
@graph.name: RestrictedDiet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A diet restricted to certain foods or preparations for cultural, religious, health or lifestyle reasons.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthCondition
@graph.name: healthCondition
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifying the health condition(s) of a patient, medical study, or other target audience.

@graph.rdfs:label: Property
@graph.name: Property
@graph.rdfs:comment: A property, used to indicate attributes and relationships of some Thing; equivalent to rdf:Property.

@graph.rdfs:label: OfferForLease
@graph.name: OfferForLease
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An [[OfferForLease]] in Schema.org represents an [[Offer]] to lease out something, i.e. an [[Offer]] whose
  [[businessFunction]] is [lease out](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#LeaseOut.). See [Good Relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GoodRelations) for
  background on the underlying concepts.

@graph.rdfs:label: code
@graph.name: code
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical code for the entity, taken from a controlled vocabulary or ontology such as ICD-9, DiseasesDB, MeSH, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: HomeAndConstructionBusiness
@graph.name: HomeAndConstructionBusiness
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A construction business.

A HomeAndConstructionBusiness is a [[LocalBusiness]] that provides services around homes and buildings.

As a [[LocalBusiness]] it can be described as a [[provider]] of one or more [[Service]]\(s).

@graph.rdfs:label: ConstraintNode
@graph.name: ConstraintNode
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The ConstraintNode type is provided to support usecases in which a node in a structured data graph is described with properties which appear to describe a single entity, but are being used in a situation where they serve a more abstract purpose. A [[ConstraintNode]] can be described using [[constraintProperty]] and [[numConstraints]]. These constraint properties can serve a
    variety of purposes, and their values may sometimes be understood to indicate sets of possible values rather than single, exact and specific values.

@graph.rdfs:label: touristType
@graph.name: touristType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Attraction suitable for type(s) of tourist. E.g. children, visitors from a particular country, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: ratingValue
@graph.name: ratingValue
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The rating for the content.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

@graph.rdfs:label: Credential
@graph.name: Credential
@graph.rdfs:comment: A credential is a certificate that is used to verify the identity of a person or entity.

@graph.rdfs:label: JobPosting
@graph.name: JobPosting
@graph.rdfs:comment: A listing that describes a job opening in a certain organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: DataFeedItem
@graph.name: DataFeedItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: A single item within a larger data feed.

@graph.rdfs:label: musicalKey
@graph.name: musicalKey
@graph.rdfs:comment: The key, mode, or scale this composition uses.

@graph.rdfs:label: MonetaryAmountDistribution
@graph.name: MonetaryAmountDistribution
@graph.rdfs:comment: A statistical distribution of monetary amounts.

@graph.rdfs:label: maps
@graph.name: maps
@graph.rdfs:comment: A URL to a map of the place.

@graph.rdfs:label: CategoryCode
@graph.name: CategoryCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Category Code.

@graph.rdfs:label: PetStore
@graph.name: PetStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pet store.

@graph.rdfs:label: actionStatus
@graph.name: actionStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the current disposition of the Action.

@graph.rdfs:label: CivicStructure
@graph.name: CivicStructure
@graph.rdfs:comment: A public structure, such as a town hall or concert hall.

@graph.rdfs:label: toRecipient
@graph.name: toRecipient
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of recipient. The recipient who was directly sent the message.

@graph.rdfs:label: practicesAt
@graph.name: practicesAt
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[MedicalOrganization]] where the [[IndividualPhysician]] practices.

@graph.rdfs:label: isEncodedByBioChemEntity
@graph.name: isEncodedByBioChemEntity
@graph.rdfs:comment: Another BioChemEntity encoding by this one.

@graph.rdfs:label: geoContains
@graph.name: geoContains
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a containing geometry to a contained geometry. "a contains b iff no points of b lie in the exterior of a, and at least one point of the interior of b lies in the interior of a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

@graph.rdfs:label: AccountingService
@graph.name: AccountingService
@graph.rdfs:comment: Accountancy business.\n\nAs a [[LocalBusiness]] it can be described as a [[provider]] of one or more [[Service]]\(s).

@graph.rdfs:label: hasBioChemEntityPart
@graph.name: hasBioChemEntityPart
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates a BioChemEntity that (in some sense) has this BioChemEntity as a part.

@graph.rdfs:label: errorCode
@graph.name: errorCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: Application or platform dependant error code.

@graph.rdfs:label: serviceOperator
@graph.name: serviceOperator
@graph.rdfs:comment: The operating organization, if different from the provider.  This enables the representation of services that are provided by an organization, but operated by another organization like a subcontractor.

@graph.rdfs:label: modelDate
@graph.name: modelDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

@graph.rdfs:label: includedDataCatalog
@graph.name: includedDataCatalog
@graph.rdfs:comment: A data catalog which contains this dataset (this property was previously 'catalog', preferred name is now 'includedInDataCatalog').

@graph.rdfs:label: OrganizationRole
@graph.name: OrganizationRole
@graph.rdfs:comment: A subclass of Role used to describe roles within organizations.

@graph.rdfs:label: releaseDate
@graph.name: releaseDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The release date of a product or product model. This can be used to distinguish the exact variant of a product.

@graph.rdfs:label: lodgingUnitType
@graph.name: lodgingUnitType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Textual description of the unit type (including suite vs. room, size of bed, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: UserLikes
@graph.name: UserLikes
@graph.rdfs:comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

@graph.rdfs:label: RadioStation
@graph.name: RadioStation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A radio station.

@graph.rdfs:label: skills
@graph.name: skills
@graph.rdfs:comment: A statement of knowledge, skill, ability, task or any other assertion expressing a competency that is either claimed by a person, an organization or desired or required to fulfill a role or to work in an occupation.

@graph.rdfs:label: seller
@graph.name: seller
@graph.rdfs:comment: An entity which offers (sells / leases / lends / loans) the services / goods.  A seller may also be a provider.

@graph.rdfs:label: minimumPaymentDue
@graph.name: minimumPaymentDue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The minimum payment required at this time.

@graph.rdfs:label: sensoryRequirement
@graph.name: sensoryRequirement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of any sensory requirements and levels necessary to function on the job, including hearing and vision. Defined terms such as those in O*net may be used, but note that there is no way to specify the level of ability as well as its nature when using a defined term.

@graph.rdfs:label: RadiationTherapy
@graph.name: RadiationTherapy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A process of care using radiation aimed at improving a health condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: isPlanForApartment
@graph.name: isPlanForApartment
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates some accommodation that this floor plan describes.

@graph.rdfs:label: EducationEvent
@graph.name: EducationEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Education event.

@graph.rdfs:label: OccupationalTherapy
@graph.name: OccupationalTherapy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A treatment of people with physical, emotional, or social problems, using purposeful activity to help them overcome or learn to deal with their problems.

@graph.rdfs:label: recordingOf
@graph.name: recordingOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: The composition this track is a recording of.

@graph.rdfs:label: cashBack
@graph.name: cashBack
@graph.rdfs:comment: A cardholder benefit that pays the cardholder a small percentage of their net expenditures.

@graph.rdfs:label: specialty
@graph.name: specialty
@graph.rdfs:comment: One of the domain specialities to which this web page's content applies.

@graph.rdfs:label: tongueWeight
@graph.name: tongueWeight
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The permitted vertical load (TWR) of a trailer attached to the vehicle. Also referred to as Tongue Load Rating (TLR) or Vertical Load Rating (VLR).

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

@graph.rdfs:label: FoodEstablishment
@graph.name: FoodEstablishment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A food-related business.

@graph.rdfs:label: CriticReview
@graph.name: CriticReview
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[CriticReview]] is a more specialized form of Review written or published by a source that is recognized for its reviewing activities. These can include online columns, travel and food guides, TV and radio shows, blogs and other independent Web sites. [[CriticReview]]s are typically more in-depth and professionally written. For simpler, casually written user/visitor/viewer/customer reviews, it is more appropriate to use the [[UserReview]] type. Review aggregator sites such as Metacritic already separate out the site's user reviews from selected critic reviews that originate from third-party sources.

@graph.rdfs:label: catalog
@graph.name: catalog
@graph.rdfs:comment: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

@graph.rdfs:label: gameItem
@graph.name: gameItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: An item is an object within the game world that can be collected by a player or, occasionally, a non-player character.

@graph.rdfs:label: Taxi
@graph.name: Taxi
@graph.rdfs:comment: A taxi.

@graph.rdfs:label: PaymentMethod
@graph.name: PaymentMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A payment method is a standardized procedure for transferring the monetary amount for a purchase. Payment methods are characterized by the legal and technical structures used, and by the organization or group carrying out the transaction. The following legacy values should be accepted: 

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#ByBankTransferInAdvance
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#ByInvoice
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Cash
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#CheckInAdvance
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#COD
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DirectDebit
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#GoogleCheckout
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PayPal
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PaySwarm

Structured values, or [UNCE payment means](https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/PaymentMeans) are recommended or for newer annotations.

@graph.rdfs:label: LibrarySystem
@graph.name: LibrarySystem
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[LibrarySystem]] is a collaborative system amongst several libraries.

@graph.rdfs:label: partOfEpisode
@graph.name: partOfEpisode
@graph.rdfs:comment: The episode to which this clip belongs.

@graph.rdfs:label: Ligament
@graph.name: Ligament
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short band of tough, flexible, fibrous connective tissue that functions to connect multiple bones, cartilages, and structurally support joints.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalProcedure
@graph.name: MedicalProcedure
@graph.rdfs:comment: A process of care used in either a diagnostic, therapeutic, preventive or palliative capacity that relies on invasive (surgical), non-invasive, or other techniques.

@graph.rdfs:label: TrainReservation
@graph.name: TrainReservation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reservation for train travel.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

@graph.rdfs:label: Quiz
@graph.name: Quiz
@graph.rdfs:comment: Quiz: A test of knowledge, skills and abilities.

@graph.rdfs:label: termsOfService
@graph.name: termsOfService
@graph.rdfs:comment: Human-readable terms of service documentation.

@graph.rdfs:label: afterMedia
@graph.name: afterMedia
@graph.rdfs:comment: A media object representing the circumstances after performing this direction.

@graph.rdfs:label: CatholicChurch
@graph.name: CatholicChurch
@graph.rdfs:comment: A Catholic church.

@graph.rdfs:label: vehicleModelDate
@graph.name: vehicleModelDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

@graph.rdfs:label: availabilityEnds
@graph.name: availabilityEnds
@graph.rdfs:comment: The end of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: relatedCondition
@graph.name: relatedCondition
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical condition associated with this anatomy.

@graph.rdfs:label: height
@graph.name: height
@graph.rdfs:comment: The height of the item.

@graph.rdfs:label: firstPerformance
@graph.name: firstPerformance
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date and place the work was first performed.

@graph.rdfs:label: applicationContact
@graph.name: applicationContact
@graph.rdfs:comment: Contact details for further information relevant to this job posting.

@graph.rdfs:label: AcceptAction
@graph.name: AcceptAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of committing to/adopting an object.

Related actions:

* [[RejectAction]]: The antonym of AcceptAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: Thesis
@graph.name: Thesis
@graph.rdfs:comment: A thesis or dissertation document submitted in support of candidature for an academic degree or professional qualification.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasParticipationOffer
@graph.name: hasParticipationOffer
@graph.rdfs:comment: An offer to participate in the event, for example, Call for Proposals, Call for Speakers, or Call for Performers.

@graph.rdfs:label: PhotographAction
@graph.name: PhotographAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of capturing still images of objects using a camera.

@graph.rdfs:label: successorOf
@graph.name: successorOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pointer from a newer variant of a product  to its previous, often discontinued predecessor.

@graph.rdfs:label: ineligibleRegion
@graph.name: ineligibleRegion
@graph.rdfs:comment: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is not valid, e.g. a region where the transaction is not allowed.\n\nSee also [[eligibleRegion]].

@graph.rdfs:label: observationAbout
@graph.name: observationAbout
@graph.rdfs:comment: The [[observationAbout]] property identifies an entity, often a [[Place]], associated with an [[Observation]].

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalGuidelineRecommendation
@graph.name: MedicalGuidelineRecommendation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A guideline recommendation that is regarded as efficacious and where quality of the data supporting the recommendation is sound.

@graph.rdfs:label: HowToDirection
@graph.name: HowToDirection
@graph.rdfs:comment: A direction indicating a single action to do in the instructions for how to achieve a result.

@graph.rdfs:label: AdministrativeArea
@graph.name: AdministrativeArea
@graph.rdfs:comment: A geographical region, typically under the jurisdiction of a particular government.

@graph.rdfs:label: exchangeRateSpread
@graph.name: exchangeRateSpread
@graph.rdfs:comment: The difference between the price at which a broker or other intermediary buys and sells foreign currency.

@graph.rdfs:label: trainName
@graph.name: trainName
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of the train (e.g. The Orient Express).

@graph.rdfs:label: GeospatialGeometry
@graph.name: GeospatialGeometry
@graph.rdfs:comment: (Eventually to be defined as) a supertype of GeoShape designed to accommodate definitions from Geo-Spatial best practices.

@graph.rdfs:label: minValue
@graph.name: minValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: The lower value of some characteristic or property.

@graph.rdfs:label: BusTrip
@graph.name: BusTrip
@graph.rdfs:comment: A trip on a commercial bus line.

@graph.rdfs:label: dropoffLocation
@graph.name: dropoffLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a rental car can be dropped off.

@graph.rdfs:label: BookFormatType
@graph.name: BookFormatType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The publication format of the book.

@graph.rdfs:label: startTime
@graph.name: startTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The startTime of something. For a reserved event or service (e.g. FoodEstablishmentReservation), the time that it is expected to start. For actions that span a period of time, when the action was performed. E.g. John wrote a book from *January* to December. For media, including audio and video, it's the time offset of the start of a clip within a larger file.\n\nNote that Event uses startDate/endDate instead of startTime/endTime, even when describing dates with times. This situation may be clarified in future revisions.

@graph.rdfs:label: administrationRoute
@graph.name: administrationRoute
@graph.rdfs:comment: A route by which this drug may be administered, e.g. 'oral'.

@graph.rdfs:label: ExchangeRateSpecification
@graph.name: ExchangeRateSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A structured value representing exchange rate.

@graph.rdfs:label: BusOrCoach
@graph.name: BusOrCoach
@graph.rdfs:comment: A bus (also omnibus or autobus) is a road vehicle designed to carry passengers. Coaches are luxury buses, usually in service for long distance travel.

@graph.rdfs:label: DaySpa
@graph.name: DaySpa
@graph.rdfs:comment: A day spa.

@graph.rdfs:label: leiCode
@graph.name: leiCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: An organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal entity as defined in ISO 17442.

@graph.rdfs:label: isTierOf
@graph.name: isTierOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: The member program this tier is a part of.

@graph.rdfs:label: Car
@graph.name: Car
@graph.rdfs:comment: A car is a wheeled, self-powered motor vehicle used for transportation.

@graph.rdfs:label: sampleType
@graph.name: sampleType
@graph.rdfs:comment: What type of code sample: full (compile ready) solution, code snippet, inline code, scripts, template.

@graph.rdfs:label: Event
@graph.name: Event
@graph.rdfs:comment: An event happening at a certain time and location, such as a concert, lecture, or festival. Ticketing information may be added via the [[offers]] property. Repeated events may be structured as separate Event objects.

@graph.rdfs:label: participant
@graph.name: participant
@graph.rdfs:comment: Other co-agents that participated in the action indirectly. E.g. John wrote a book with *Steve*.

@graph.rdfs:label: assembly
@graph.name: assembly
@graph.rdfs:comment: Library file name, e.g., mscorlib.dll, system.web.dll.

@graph.rdfs:label: bookingAgent
