@graph.name: bookingAgent
@graph.rdfs:comment: 'bookingAgent' is an out-dated term indicating a 'broker' that serves as a booking agent.

@graph.rdfs:label: artform
@graph.name: artform
@graph.rdfs:comment: e.g. Painting, Drawing, Sculpture, Print, Photograph, Assemblage, Collage, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: percentile75
@graph.name: percentile75
@graph.rdfs:comment: The 75th percentile value.

@graph.rdfs:label: recordLabel
@graph.name: recordLabel
@graph.rdfs:comment: The label that issued the release.

@graph.rdfs:label: colleague
@graph.name: colleague
@graph.rdfs:comment: A colleague of the person.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasMenuItem
@graph.name: hasMenuItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: A food or drink item contained in a menu or menu section.

@graph.rdfs:label: attendees
@graph.name: attendees
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person attending the event.

@graph.rdfs:label: usNPI
@graph.name: usNPI
@graph.rdfs:comment: A National Provider Identifier (NPI) is a unique 10-digit identification number issued to health care providers in the United States by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

@graph.rdfs:label: VisualArtwork
@graph.name: VisualArtwork
@graph.rdfs:comment: A work of art that is primarily visual in character.

@graph.rdfs:label: musicBy
@graph.name: musicBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: The composer of the soundtrack.

@graph.rdfs:label: ArchiveOrganization
@graph.name: ArchiveOrganization
@graph.rdfs:comment: An organization with archival holdings. An organization which keeps and preserves archival material and typically makes it accessible to the public.

@graph.rdfs:label: distance
@graph.name: distance
@graph.rdfs:comment: The distance travelled, e.g. exercising or travelling.

@graph.rdfs:label: inStoreReturnsOffered
@graph.name: inStoreReturnsOffered
@graph.rdfs:comment: Are in-store returns offered? (For more advanced return methods use the [[returnMethod]] property.)

@graph.rdfs:label: SubwayStation
@graph.name: SubwayStation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A subway station.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicPlaylist
@graph.name: MusicPlaylist
@graph.rdfs:comment: A collection of music tracks in playlist form.

@graph.rdfs:label: performer
@graph.name: performer
@graph.rdfs:comment: A performer at the event—for example, a presenter, musician, musical group or actor.

@graph.rdfs:label: DanceEvent
@graph.name: DanceEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: A social dance.

@graph.rdfs:label: includesHealthPlanNetwork
@graph.name: includesHealthPlanNetwork
@graph.rdfs:comment: Networks covered by this plan.

@graph.rdfs:label: collectionSize
@graph.name: collectionSize
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of items in the [[Collection]].

@graph.rdfs:label: parentItem
@graph.name: parentItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: The parent of a question, answer or item in general. Typically used for Q/A discussion threads e.g. a chain of comments with the first comment being an [[Article]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. See also [[comment]] which points from something to a comment about it.

@graph.rdfs:label: additionalNumberOfGuests
@graph.name: additionalNumberOfGuests
@graph.rdfs:comment: If responding yes, the number of guests who will attend in addition to the invitee.

@graph.rdfs:label: faxNumber
@graph.name: faxNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The fax number.

@graph.rdfs:label: certificationRating
@graph.name: certificationRating
@graph.rdfs:comment: Rating of a certification instance (as defined by an independent certification body). Typically this rating can be used to rate the level to which the requirements of the certification instance are fulfilled. See also [gs1:certificationValue](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationValue).

@graph.rdfs:label: DiagnosticProcedure
@graph.name: DiagnosticProcedure
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical procedure intended primarily for diagnostic, as opposed to therapeutic, purposes.

@graph.rdfs:label: primaryImageOfPage
@graph.name: primaryImageOfPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the main image on the page.

@graph.rdfs:label: ActionAccessSpecification
@graph.name: ActionAccessSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A set of requirements that must be fulfilled in order to perform an Action.

@graph.rdfs:label: VideoGameSeries
@graph.name: VideoGameSeries
@graph.rdfs:comment: A video game series.

@graph.rdfs:label: agentInteractionStatistic
@graph.name: agentInteractionStatistic
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of completed interactions for this entity, in a particular role (the 'agent'), in a particular action (indicated in the statistic), and in a particular context (i.e. interactionService).

@graph.rdfs:label: schemaVersion
@graph.name: schemaVersion
@graph.rdfs:comment:
Indicates (by URL or string) a particular version of a schema used in some CreativeWork. This property was created primarily to
    indicate the use of a specific schema.org release, e.g. ```10.0``` as a simple string, or more explicitly via URL, ```https://schema.org/docs/releases.html#v10.0```. There may be situations in which other schemas might usefully be referenced this way, e.g. ```http://dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dces/1999-07-02/``` but this has not been carefully explored in the community.

@graph.rdfs:label: resultComment
@graph.name: resultComment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of result. The Comment created or sent as a result of this action.

@graph.rdfs:label: DataCatalog
@graph.name: DataCatalog
@graph.rdfs:comment: A collection of datasets.

@graph.rdfs:label: isAccessibleForFree
@graph.name: isAccessibleForFree
@graph.rdfs:comment: A flag to signal that the item, event, or place is accessible for free.

@graph.rdfs:label: PreOrderAction
@graph.name: PreOrderAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: An agent orders a (not yet released) object/product/service to be delivered/sent.

@graph.rdfs:label: HyperToc
@graph.name: HyperToc
@graph.rdfs:comment: A HyperToc represents a hypertext table of contents for complex media objects, such as [[VideoObject]], [[AudioObject]]. Items in the table of contents are indicated using the [[tocEntry]] property, and typed [[HyperTocEntry]]. For cases where the same larger work is split into multiple files, [[associatedMedia]] can be used on individual [[HyperTocEntry]] items.

@graph.rdfs:label: genre
@graph.name: genre
@graph.rdfs:comment: Genre of the creative work, broadcast channel or group.

@graph.rdfs:label: isicV4
@graph.name: isicV4
@graph.rdfs:comment: The International Standard of Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities (ISIC), Revision 4 code for a particular organization, business person, or place.

@graph.rdfs:label: workHours
@graph.name: workHours
@graph.rdfs:comment: The typical working hours for this job (e.g. 1st shift, night shift, 8am-5pm).

@graph.rdfs:label: tickerSymbol
@graph.name: tickerSymbol
@graph.rdfs:comment: The exchange traded instrument associated with a Corporation object. The tickerSymbol is expressed as an exchange and an instrument name separated by a space character. For the exchange component of the tickerSymbol attribute, we recommend using the controlled vocabulary of Market Identifier Codes (MIC) specified in ISO 15022.

@graph.rdfs:label: Integer
@graph.name: Integer
@graph.rdfs:comment: Data type: Integer.

@graph.rdfs:label: tool
@graph.name: tool
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of instrument. An object used (but not consumed) when performing instructions or a direction.

@graph.rdfs:label: partOfSystem
@graph.name: partOfSystem
@graph.rdfs:comment: The anatomical or organ system that this structure is part of.

@graph.rdfs:label: postOp
@graph.name: postOp
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the postoperative procedures, care, and/or followups for this device.

@graph.rdfs:label: departureStation
@graph.name: departureStation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The station from which the train departs.

@graph.rdfs:label: nextItem
@graph.name: nextItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: A link to the ListItem that follows the current one.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicReleaseFormatType
@graph.name: MusicReleaseFormatType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

@graph.rdfs:label: fileFormat
@graph.name: fileFormat
@graph.rdfs:comment: Media type, typically MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml)) of the content, e.g. application/zip of a SoftwareApplication binary. In cases where a CreativeWork has several media type representations, 'encoding' can be used to indicate each MediaObject alongside particular fileFormat information. Unregistered or niche file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia entry.

@graph.rdfs:label: typicalCreditsPerTerm
@graph.name: typicalCreditsPerTerm
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of credits or units a full-time student would be expected to take in 1 term however 'term' is defined by the institution.

@graph.rdfs:label: expectedArrivalUntil
@graph.name: expectedArrivalUntil
@graph.rdfs:comment: The latest date the package may arrive.

@graph.rdfs:label: inLanguage
@graph.name: inLanguage
@graph.rdfs:comment: The language of the content or performance or used in an action. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[availableLanguage]].

@graph.rdfs:label: RegisterAction
@graph.name: RegisterAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of registering to be a user of a service, product or web page.

Related actions:

* [[JoinAction]]: Unlike JoinAction, RegisterAction implies you are registering to be a user of a service, *not* a group/team of people.
* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, RegisterAction doesn't imply that the agent is expecting to poll for updates from the object.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, RegisterAction doesn't imply that the agent is expecting updates from the object.

@graph.rdfs:label: Hotel
@graph.name: Hotel
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A hotel is an establishment that provides lodging paid on a short-term basis (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hotel).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

@graph.rdfs:label: lastReviewed
@graph.name: lastReviewed
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date on which the content on this web page was last reviewed for accuracy and/or completeness.

@graph.rdfs:label: jobLocationType
@graph.name: jobLocationType
@graph.rdfs:comment: A description of the job location (e.g. TELECOMMUTE for telecommute jobs).

@graph.rdfs:label: availableOnDevice
@graph.name: availableOnDevice
@graph.rdfs:comment: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.

@graph.rdfs:label: PhysicalExam
@graph.name: PhysicalExam
@graph.rdfs:comment: A type of physical examination of a patient performed by a physician.

@graph.rdfs:label: TextObject
@graph.name: TextObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: A text file. The text can be unformatted or contain markup, html, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasAdultConsideration
@graph.name: hasAdultConsideration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Used to tag an item to be intended or suitable for consumption or use by adults only.

@graph.rdfs:label: priceComponentType
@graph.name: priceComponentType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifies a price component (for example, a line item on an invoice), part of the total price for an offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: highPrice
@graph.name: highPrice
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The highest price of all offers available.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

@graph.rdfs:label: knows
@graph.name: knows
@graph.rdfs:comment: The most generic bi-directional social/work relation.

@graph.rdfs:label: ITNonprofitType
@graph.name: ITNonprofitType
@graph.rdfs:comment: ITNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from Italy.

@graph.rdfs:label: modifiedTime
@graph.name: modifiedTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date and time the reservation was modified.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasMemberProgram
@graph.name: hasMemberProgram
@graph.rdfs:comment: MemberProgram offered by an Organization, for example an eCommerce merchant or an airline.

@graph.rdfs:label: CovidTestingFacility
@graph.name: CovidTestingFacility
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A CovidTestingFacility is a [[MedicalClinic]] where testing for the COVID-19 Coronavirus
      disease is available. If the facility is being made available from an established [[Pharmacy]], [[Hotel]], or other
      non-medical organization, multiple types can be listed. This makes it easier to re-use existing schema.org information
      about that place, e.g. contact info, address, opening hours. Note that in an emergency, such information may not always be reliable.

@graph.rdfs:label: contactlessPayment
@graph.name: contactlessPayment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A secure method for consumers to purchase products or services via debit, credit or smartcards by using RFID or NFC technology.

@graph.rdfs:label: trailer
@graph.name: trailer
@graph.rdfs:comment: The trailer of a movie or TV/radio series, season, episode, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: trialDesign
@graph.name: trialDesign
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifics about the trial design (enumerated).

@graph.rdfs:label: salaryCurrency
@graph.name: salaryCurrency
@graph.rdfs:comment: The currency (coded using [ISO 4217](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217)) used for the main salary information in this job posting or for this employee.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalTrialDesign
@graph.name: MedicalTrialDesign
@graph.rdfs:comment: Design models for medical trials. Enumerated type.

@graph.rdfs:label: propertyID
@graph.name: propertyID
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A commonly used identifier for the characteristic represented by the property, e.g. a manufacturer or a standard code for a property. propertyID can be
(1) a prefixed string, mainly meant to be used with standards for product properties; (2) a site-specific, non-prefixed string (e.g. the primary key of the property or the vendor-specific ID of the property), or (3)
a URL indicating the type of the property, either pointing to an external vocabulary, or a Web resource that describes the property (e.g. a glossary entry).
Standards bodies should promote a standard prefix for the identifiers of properties from their standards.

@graph.rdfs:label: UserPlusOnes
@graph.name: UserPlusOnes
@graph.rdfs:comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

@graph.rdfs:label: game
@graph.name: game
@graph.rdfs:comment: Video game which is played on this server.

@graph.rdfs:label: DietarySupplement
@graph.name: DietarySupplement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A product taken by mouth that contains a dietary ingredient intended to supplement the diet. Dietary ingredients may include vitamins, minerals, herbs or other botanicals, amino acids, and substances such as enzymes, organ tissues, glandulars and metabolites.

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfAccommodationUnits
@graph.name: numberOfAccommodationUnits
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the total (available plus unavailable) number of accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits]].

@graph.rdfs:label: relatedDrug
@graph.name: relatedDrug
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any other drug related to this one, for example commonly-prescribed alternatives.

@graph.rdfs:label: DepartAction
@graph.name: DepartAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of  departing from a place. An agent departs from a fromLocation for a destination, optionally with participants.

@graph.rdfs:label: nerve
@graph.name: nerve
@graph.rdfs:comment: The underlying innervation associated with the muscle.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumC19Died
@graph.name: cvdNumC19Died
@graph.rdfs:comment: numc19died - DEATHS: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who died in the hospital, ED, or any overflow location.

@graph.rdfs:label: HomeGoodsStore
@graph.name: HomeGoodsStore
@graph.rdfs:comment: A home goods store.

@graph.rdfs:label: RVPark
@graph.name: RVPark
@graph.rdfs:comment: A place offering space for "Recreational Vehicles", Caravans, mobile homes and the like.

@graph.rdfs:label: Article
@graph.name: Article
@graph.rdfs:comment: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report. Newspapers and magazines have articles of many different types and this is intended to cover them all.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

@graph.rdfs:label: BefriendAction
@graph.name: BefriendAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of forming a personal connection with someone (object) mutually/bidirectionally/symmetrically.

Related actions:

* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, BefriendAction implies that the connection is reciprocal.

@graph.rdfs:label: Time
@graph.name: Time
@graph.rdfs:comment: A point in time recurring on multiple days in the form hh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm] (see [XML schema for details](http://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#time)).

@graph.rdfs:label: pathophysiology
@graph.name: pathophysiology
@graph.rdfs:comment: Changes in the normal mechanical, physical, and biochemical functions that are associated with this activity or condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: requiredGender
@graph.name: requiredGender
@graph.rdfs:comment: Audiences defined by a person's gender.

@graph.rdfs:label: affectedBy
@graph.name: affectedBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: Drugs that affect the test's results.

@graph.rdfs:label: itemListOrder
@graph.name: itemListOrder
@graph.rdfs:comment: Type of ordering (e.g. Ascending, Descending, Unordered).

@graph.rdfs:label: WebPageElement
@graph.name: WebPageElement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A web page element, like a table or an image.

@graph.rdfs:label: productionDate
@graph.name: productionDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: The date of production of the item, e.g. vehicle.

@graph.rdfs:label: surface
@graph.name: surface
@graph.rdfs:comment: A material used as a surface in some artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: LakeBodyOfWater
@graph.name: LakeBodyOfWater
@graph.rdfs:comment: A lake (for example, Lake Pontrachain).

@graph.rdfs:label: Beach
@graph.name: Beach
@graph.rdfs:comment: Beach.

@graph.rdfs:label: Suite
@graph.name: Suite
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A suite in a hotel or other public accommodation, denotes a class of luxury accommodations, the key feature of which is multiple rooms (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suite_(hotel)).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasPOS
@graph.name: hasPOS
@graph.rdfs:comment: Points-of-Sales operated by the organization or person.

@graph.rdfs:label: ReturnFeesEnumeration
@graph.name: ReturnFeesEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Enumerates several kinds of policies for product return fees.

@graph.rdfs:label: inBroadcastLineup
@graph.name: inBroadcastLineup
@graph.rdfs:comment: The CableOrSatelliteService offering the channel.

@graph.rdfs:label: TextDigitalDocument
@graph.name: TextDigitalDocument
@graph.rdfs:comment: A file composed primarily of text.

@graph.rdfs:label: pickupLocation
@graph.name: pickupLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

@graph.rdfs:label: seatingType
@graph.name: seatingType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type/class of the seat.

@graph.rdfs:label: distinguishingSign
@graph.name: distinguishingSign
@graph.rdfs:comment: One of a set of signs and symptoms that can be used to distinguish this diagnosis from others in the differential diagnosis.

@graph.rdfs:label: hasMeasurement
@graph.name: hasMeasurement
@graph.rdfs:comment: A measurement of an item, For example, the inseam of pants, the wheel size of a bicycle, the gauge of a screw, or the carbon footprint measured for certification by an authority. Usually an exact measurement, but can also be a range of measurements for adjustable products, for example belts and ski bindings.

@graph.rdfs:label: representativeOfPage
@graph.name: representativeOfPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether this image is representative of the content of the page.

@graph.rdfs:label: LearningResource
@graph.name: LearningResource
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The LearningResource type can be used to indicate [[CreativeWork]]s (whether physical or digital) that have a particular and explicit orientation towards learning, education, skill acquisition, and other educational purposes.

[[LearningResource]] is expected to be used as an addition to a primary type such as [[Book]], [[VideoObject]], [[Product]] etc.

[[EducationEvent]] serves a similar purpose for event-like things (e.g. a [[Trip]]). A [[LearningResource]] may be created as a result of an [[EducationEvent]], for example by recording one.

@graph.rdfs:label: Comment
@graph.name: Comment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A comment on an item - for example, a comment on a blog post. The comment's content is expressed via the [[text]] property, and its topic via [[about]], properties shared with all CreativeWorks.

@graph.rdfs:label: SubscribeAction
@graph.name: SubscribeAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of forming a personal connection with someone/something (object) unidirectionally/asymmetrically to get updates pushed to.

Related actions:

* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, SubscribeAction implies that the subscriber acts as a passive agent being constantly/actively pushed for updates.
* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, SubscribeAction implies that the agent is interested in continuing receiving updates from the object.
* [[JoinAction]]: Unlike JoinAction, SubscribeAction implies that the agent is interested in continuing receiving updates from the object.

@graph.rdfs:label: carrier
@graph.name: carrier
@graph.rdfs:comment: 'carrier' is an out-dated term indicating the 'provider' for parcel delivery and flights.

@graph.rdfs:label: marginOfError
@graph.name: marginOfError
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[marginOfError]] for an [[Observation]].

@graph.rdfs:label: HealthClub
@graph.name: HealthClub
@graph.rdfs:comment: A health club.

@graph.rdfs:label: byArtist
@graph.name: byArtist
@graph.rdfs:comment: The artist that performed this album or recording.

@graph.rdfs:label: CarUsageType
@graph.name: CarUsageType
@graph.rdfs:comment: A value indicating a special usage of a car, e.g. commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi.

@graph.rdfs:label: reportNumber
@graph.name: reportNumber
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number or other unique designator assigned to a Report by the publishing organization.

@graph.rdfs:label: physiologicalBenefits
@graph.name: physiologicalBenefits
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specific physiologic benefits associated to the plan.

@graph.rdfs:label: NoteDigitalDocument
@graph.name: NoteDigitalDocument
@graph.rdfs:comment: A file containing a note, primarily for the author.

@graph.rdfs:label: eligibilityToWorkRequirement
@graph.name: eligibilityToWorkRequirement
@graph.rdfs:comment: The legal requirements such as citizenship, visa and other documentation required for an applicant to this job.

@graph.rdfs:label: bloodSupply
@graph.name: bloodSupply
@graph.rdfs:comment: The blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the muscle.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalIndication
@graph.name: MedicalIndication
@graph.rdfs:comment: A condition or factor that indicates use of a medical therapy, including signs, symptoms, risk factors, anatomical states, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: offersPrescriptionByMail
@graph.name: offersPrescriptionByMail
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether prescriptions can be delivered by mail.

@graph.rdfs:label: diversityPolicy
@graph.name: diversityPolicy
@graph.rdfs:comment: Statement on diversity policy by an [[Organization]] e.g. a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]. For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement describing the newsroom’s diversity policy on both staffing and sources, typically providing staffing data.

@graph.rdfs:label: validIn
@graph.name: validIn
@graph.rdfs:comment: The geographic area where the item is valid. Applies for example to a [[Permit]], a [[Certification]], or an [[EducationalOccupationalCredential]].

@graph.rdfs:label: Park
@graph.name: Park
@graph.rdfs:comment: A park.

@graph.rdfs:label: Syllabus
@graph.name: Syllabus
@graph.rdfs:comment: A syllabus that describes the material covered in a course, often with several such sections per [[Course]] so that a distinct [[timeRequired]] can be provided for that section of the [[Course]].

@graph.rdfs:label: openingHoursSpecification
@graph.name: openingHoursSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: The opening hours of a certain place.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalStudyStatus
@graph.name: MedicalStudyStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: The status of a medical study. Enumerated type.

@graph.rdfs:label: RepaymentSpecification
@graph.name: RepaymentSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: A structured value representing repayment.

@graph.rdfs:label: sodiumContent
@graph.name: sodiumContent
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of milligrams of sodium.

@graph.rdfs:label: DeactivateAction
@graph.name: DeactivateAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of stopping or deactivating a device or application (e.g. stopping a timer or turning off a flashlight).

@graph.rdfs:label: productSupported
@graph.name: productSupported
@graph.rdfs:comment: The product or service this support contact point is related to (such as product support for a particular product line). This can be a specific product or product line (e.g. "iPhone") or a general category of products or services (e.g. "smartphones").

@graph.rdfs:label: isAccessoryOrSparePartFor
@graph.name: isAccessoryOrSparePartFor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is an accessory or spare part.

@graph.rdfs:label: currency
@graph.name: currency
@graph.rdfs:comment: The currency in which the monetary amount is expressed.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

@graph.rdfs:label: DeliveryChargeSpecification
@graph.name: DeliveryChargeSpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: The price for the delivery of an offer using a particular delivery method.

@graph.rdfs:label: ClaimReview
@graph.name: ClaimReview
@graph.rdfs:comment: A fact-checking review of claims made (or reported) in some creative work (referenced via itemReviewed).

@graph.rdfs:label: enginePower
@graph.name: enginePower
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The power of the vehicle's engine.
    Typical unit code(s): KWT for kilowatt, BHP for brake horsepower, N12 for metric horsepower (PS, with 1 PS = 735,49875 W)

* Note 1: There are many different ways of measuring an engine's power. For an overview, see  [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine\_power\_test\_codes](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine_power_test_codes).
* Note 2: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 3: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalCause
@graph.name: MedicalCause
@graph.rdfs:comment: The causative agent(s) that are responsible for the pathophysiologic process that eventually results in a medical condition, symptom or sign. In this schema, unless otherwise specified this is meant to be the proximate cause of the medical condition, symptom or sign. The proximate cause is defined as the causative agent that most directly results in the medical condition, symptom or sign. For example, the HIV virus could be considered a cause of AIDS. Or in a diagnostic context, if a patient fell and sustained a hip fracture and two days later sustained a pulmonary embolism which eventuated in a cardiac arrest, the cause of the cardiac arrest (the proximate cause) would be the pulmonary embolism and not the fall. Medical causes can include cardiovascular, chemical, dermatologic, endocrine, environmental, gastroenterologic, genetic, hematologic, gynecologic, iatrogenic, infectious, musculoskeletal, neurologic, nutritional, obstetric, oncologic, otolaryngologic, pharmacologic, psychiatric, pulmonary, renal, rheumatologic, toxic, traumatic, or urologic causes; medical conditions can be causes as well.

@graph.rdfs:label: PoliceStation
@graph.name: PoliceStation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A police station.

@graph.rdfs:label: Nerve
@graph.name: Nerve
@graph.rdfs:comment: A common pathway for the electrochemical nerve impulses that are transmitted along each of the axons.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicEvent
@graph.name: MusicEvent
@graph.rdfs:comment: Event type: Music event.

@graph.rdfs:label: ActivateAction
@graph.name: ActivateAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of starting or activating a device or application (e.g. starting a timer or turning on a flashlight).

@graph.rdfs:label: competitor
@graph.name: competitor
@graph.rdfs:comment: A competitor in a sports event.

@graph.rdfs:label: MediaReviewItem
@graph.name: MediaReviewItem
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents an item or group of closely related items treated as a unit for the sake of evaluation in a [[MediaReview]]. Authorship etc. apply to the items rather than to the curation/grouping or reviewing party.

@graph.rdfs:label: totalTime
@graph.name: totalTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The total time required to perform instructions or a direction (including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

@graph.rdfs:label: nerveMotor
@graph.name: nerveMotor
@graph.rdfs:comment: The neurological pathway extension that involves muscle control.

@graph.rdfs:label: HowTo
@graph.name: HowTo
@graph.rdfs:comment: Instructions that explain how to achieve a result by performing a sequence of steps.

@graph.rdfs:label: incentives
@graph.name: incentives
@graph.rdfs:comment: Description of bonus and commission compensation aspects of the job.

@graph.rdfs:label: CssSelectorType
@graph.name: CssSelectorType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Text representing a CSS selector.

@graph.rdfs:label: EatAction
@graph.name: EatAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of swallowing solid objects.

@graph.rdfs:label: discount
@graph.name: discount
@graph.rdfs:comment: Any discount applied (to an Order).

@graph.rdfs:label: areaServed
@graph.name: areaServed
@graph.rdfs:comment: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided.

@graph.rdfs:label: translator
@graph.name: translator
@graph.rdfs:comment: Organization or person who adapts a creative work to different languages, regional differences and technical requirements of a target market, or that translates during some event.

@graph.rdfs:label: checkinTime
@graph.name: checkinTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The earliest someone may check into a lodging establishment.

@graph.rdfs:label: BroadcastFrequencySpecification
@graph.name: BroadcastFrequencySpecification
@graph.rdfs:comment: The frequency in MHz and the modulation used for a particular BroadcastService.

@graph.rdfs:label: EventStatusType
@graph.name: EventStatusType
@graph.rdfs:comment: EventStatusType is an enumeration type whose instances represent several states that an Event may be in.

@graph.rdfs:label: CancelAction
@graph.name: CancelAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of asserting that a future event/action is no longer going to happen.

Related actions:

* [[ConfirmAction]]: The antonym of CancelAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: discountCode
@graph.name: discountCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: Code used to redeem a discount.

@graph.rdfs:label: recognizedBy
@graph.name: recognizedBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: An organization that acknowledges the validity, value or utility of a credential. Note: recognition may include a process of quality assurance or accreditation.

@graph.rdfs:label: employmentUnit
@graph.name: employmentUnit
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates the department, unit and/or facility where the employee reports and/or in which the job is to be performed.

@graph.rdfs:label: LiveBlogPosting
@graph.name: LiveBlogPosting
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[LiveBlogPosting]] is a [[BlogPosting]] intended to provide a rolling textual coverage of an ongoing event through continuous updates.

@graph.rdfs:label: UserInteraction
@graph.name: UserInteraction
@graph.rdfs:comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

@graph.rdfs:label: RadioEpisode
@graph.name: RadioEpisode
@graph.rdfs:comment: A radio episode which can be part of a series or season.

@graph.rdfs:label: bioChemSimilarity
@graph.name: bioChemSimilarity
@graph.rdfs:comment: A similar BioChemEntity, e.g., obtained by fingerprint similarity algorithms.

@graph.rdfs:label: iswcCode
@graph.name: iswcCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: The International Standard Musical Work Code for the composition.

@graph.rdfs:label: SomeProducts
@graph.name: SomeProducts
@graph.rdfs:comment: A placeholder for multiple similar products of the same kind.

@graph.rdfs:label: FAQPage
@graph.name: FAQPage
@graph.rdfs:comment: A [[FAQPage]] is a [[WebPage]] presenting one or more "[Frequently asked questions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FAQ)" (see also [[QAPage]]).

@graph.rdfs:label: countriesSupported
@graph.name: countriesSupported
@graph.rdfs:comment: Countries for which the application is supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

@graph.rdfs:label: executableLibraryName
@graph.name: executableLibraryName
@graph.rdfs:comment: Library file name, e.g., mscorlib.dll, system.web.dll.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalScholarlyArticle
@graph.name: MedicalScholarlyArticle
@graph.rdfs:comment: A scholarly article in the medical domain.

@graph.rdfs:label: warrantyScope
@graph.name: warrantyScope
@graph.rdfs:comment: The scope of the warranty promise.

@graph.rdfs:label: serviceType
@graph.name: serviceType
@graph.rdfs:comment: The type of service being offered, e.g. veterans' benefits, emergency relief, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: isrcCode
@graph.name: isrcCode
@graph.rdfs:comment: The International Standard Recording Code for the recording.

@graph.rdfs:label: Occupation
@graph.name: Occupation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A profession, may involve prolonged training and/or a formal qualification.

@graph.rdfs:label: MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration
@graph.name: MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration
@graph.rdfs:comment: Codes for use with the [[mediaAuthenticityCategory]] property, indicating the authenticity of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared). In general these codes are not mutually exclusive, although some combinations (such as 'original' versus 'transformed', 'edited' and 'staged') would be contradictory if applied in the same [[MediaReview]]. Note that the application of these codes is with regard to a piece of media shared or published in a particular context.

@graph.rdfs:label: MedicalContraindication
@graph.name: MedicalContraindication
@graph.rdfs:comment: A condition or factor that serves as a reason to withhold a certain medical therapy. Contraindications can be absolute (there are no reasonable circumstances for undertaking a course of action) or relative (the patient is at higher risk of complications, but these risks may be outweighed by other considerations or mitigated by other measures).

@graph.rdfs:label: performTime
@graph.name: performTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The length of time it takes to perform instructions or a direction (not including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

@graph.rdfs:label: totalJobOpenings
@graph.name: totalJobOpenings
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of positions open for this job posting. Use a positive integer. Do not use if the number of positions is unclear or not known.

@graph.rdfs:label: TravelAgency
@graph.name: TravelAgency
@graph.rdfs:comment: A travel agency.

@graph.rdfs:label: DeliveryMethod
@graph.name: DeliveryMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A delivery method is a standardized procedure for transferring the product or service to the destination of fulfillment chosen by the customer. Delivery methods are characterized by the means of transportation used, and by the organization or group that is the contracting party for the sending organization or person.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DeliveryModeDirectDownload
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DeliveryModeFreight
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DeliveryModeMail
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DeliveryModeOwnFleet
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DeliveryModePickUp
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DHL
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#FederalExpress
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#UPS

@graph.rdfs:label: chemicalComposition
@graph.name: chemicalComposition
@graph.rdfs:comment: The chemical composition describes the identity and relative ratio of the chemical elements that make up the substance.

@graph.rdfs:label: HowToSection
@graph.name: HowToSection
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub-grouping of steps in the instructions for how to achieve a result (e.g. steps for making a pie crust within a pie recipe).

@graph.rdfs:label: includesObject
@graph.name: includesObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: This links to a node or nodes indicating the exact quantity of the products included in  an [[Offer]] or [[ProductCollection]].

@graph.rdfs:label: EndorsementRating
@graph.name: EndorsementRating
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An EndorsementRating is a rating that expresses some level of endorsement, for example inclusion in a "critic's pick" blog, a
"Like" or "+1" on a social network. It can be considered the [[result]] of an [[EndorseAction]] in which the [[object]] of the action is rated positively by
some [[agent]]. As is common elsewhere in schema.org, it is sometimes more useful to describe the results of such an action without explicitly describing the [[Action]].

An [[EndorsementRating]] may be part of a numeric scale or organized system, but this is not required: having an explicit type for indicating a positive,
endorsement rating is particularly useful in the absence of numeric scales as it helps consumers understand that the rating is broadly positive.

@graph.rdfs:label: MusicAlbum
@graph.name: MusicAlbum
@graph.rdfs:comment: A collection of music tracks.

@graph.rdfs:label: guideline
@graph.name: guideline
@graph.rdfs:comment: A medical guideline related to this entity.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationDateVersion
@graph.name: legislationDateVersion
@graph.rdfs:comment: The point-in-time at which the provided description of the legislation is valid (e.g.: when looking at the law on the 2016-04-07 (= dateVersion), I get the consolidation of 2015-04-12 of the "National Insurance Contributions Act 2015")

@graph.rdfs:label: affiliation
@graph.name: affiliation
@graph.rdfs:comment: An organization that this person is affiliated with. For example, a school/university, a club, or a team.

@graph.rdfs:label: titleEIDR
@graph.name: titleEIDR
@graph.rdfs:comment:
An [EIDR](https://eidr.org/) (Entertainment Identifier Registry) [[identifier]] representing at the most general/abstract level, a work of film or television.

For example, the motion picture known as "Ghostbusters" has a titleEIDR of  "10.5240/7EC7-228A-510A-053E-CBB8-J". This title (or work) may have several variants, which EIDR calls "edits". See [[editEIDR]].

Since schema.org types like [[Movie]], [[TVEpisode]], [[TVSeason]], and [[TVSeries]] can be used for both works and their multiple expressions, it is possible to use [[titleEIDR]] alone (for a general description), or alongside [[editEIDR]] for a more edit-specific description.

@graph.rdfs:label: nonProprietaryName
@graph.name: nonProprietaryName
@graph.rdfs:comment: The generic name of this drug or supplement.

@graph.rdfs:label: owns
@graph.name: owns
@graph.rdfs:comment: Things owned by the organization or person.

@graph.rdfs:label: endorsee
@graph.name: endorsee
@graph.rdfs:comment: A sub property of participant. The person/organization being supported.

@graph.rdfs:label: openingHours
@graph.name: openingHours
@graph.rdfs:comment: The general opening hours for a business. Opening hours can be specified as a weekly time range, starting with days, then times per day. Multiple days can be listed with commas ',' separating each day. Day or time ranges are specified using a hyphen '-'. * Days are specified using the following two-letter combinations: ```Mo```, ```Tu```, ```We```, ```Th```, ```Fr```, ```Sa```, ```Su```. * Times are specified using 24:00 format. For example, 3pm is specified as ```15:00```, 10am as ```10:00```. * Here is an example: <time itemprop="openingHours" datetime="Tu,Th 16:00-20:00">Tuesdays and Thursdays 4-8pm</time>. * If a business is open 7 days a week, then it can be specified as <time itemprop="openingHours" datetime="Mo-Su">Monday through Sunday, all day</time>.

@graph.rdfs:label: merchantReturnDays
@graph.name: merchantReturnDays
@graph.rdfs:comment: Specifies either a fixed return date or the number of days (from the delivery date) that a product can be returned. Used when the [[returnPolicyCategory]] property is specified as [[MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow]].

@graph.rdfs:label: numberOfEmployees
@graph.name: numberOfEmployees
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number of employees in an organization, e.g. business.

@graph.rdfs:label: PawnShop
@graph.name: PawnShop
@graph.rdfs:comment: A shop that will buy, or lend money against the security of, personal possessions.

@graph.rdfs:label: prepTime
@graph.name: prepTime
@graph.rdfs:comment: The length of time it takes to prepare the items to be used in instructions or a direction, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

@graph.rdfs:label: LendAction
@graph.name: LendAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of providing an object under an agreement that it will be returned at a later date. Reciprocal of BorrowAction.

Related actions:

* [[BorrowAction]]: Reciprocal of LendAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: PaymentStatusType
@graph.name: PaymentStatusType
@graph.rdfs:comment: A specific payment status. For example, PaymentDue, PaymentComplete, etc.

@graph.rdfs:label: GovernmentBenefitsType
@graph.name: GovernmentBenefitsType
@graph.rdfs:comment: GovernmentBenefitsType enumerates several kinds of government benefits to support the COVID-19 situation. Note that this structure may not capture all benefits offered.

@graph.rdfs:label: PhysicalTherapy
@graph.name: PhysicalTherapy
@graph.rdfs:comment: A process of progressive physical care and rehabilitation aimed at improving a health condition.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanDrugTier
@graph.name: healthPlanDrugTier
@graph.rdfs:comment: The tier(s) of drugs offered by this formulary or insurance plan.

@graph.rdfs:label: healthPlanId
@graph.name: healthPlanId
@graph.rdfs:comment: The 14-character, HIOS-generated Plan ID number. (Plan IDs must be unique, even across different markets.)

@graph.rdfs:label: accessibilityControl
@graph.name: accessibilityControl
@graph.rdfs:comment: Identifies input methods that are sufficient to fully control the described resource. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityControl-vocabulary).

@graph.rdfs:label: broadcastTimezone
@graph.name: broadcastTimezone
@graph.rdfs:comment: The timezone in [ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) for which the service bases its broadcasts.

@graph.rdfs:label: ownershipFundingInfo
@graph.name: ownershipFundingInfo
@graph.rdfs:comment: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a description of organizational ownership structure; funding and grants. In a news/media setting, this is with particular reference to editorial independence.   Note that the [[funder]] is also available and can be used to make basic funder information machine-readable.

@graph.rdfs:label: legislationApplies
@graph.name: legislationApplies
@graph.rdfs:comment: Indicates that this legislation (or part of a legislation) somehow transfers another legislation in a different legislative context. This is an informative link, and it has no legal value. For legally-binding links of transposition, use the legislationTransposes property. For example an informative consolidated law of a European Union's member state "applies" the consolidated version of the European Directive implemented in it.

@graph.rdfs:label: sport
@graph.name: sport
@graph.rdfs:comment: A type of sport (e.g. Baseball).

@graph.rdfs:label: RsvpAction
@graph.name: RsvpAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of notifying an event organizer as to whether you expect to attend the event.

@graph.rdfs:label: cvdNumVent
@graph.name: cvdNumVent
@graph.rdfs:comment: numvent - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS: Total number of ventilators available.

@graph.rdfs:label: abstract
@graph.name: abstract
@graph.rdfs:comment: An abstract is a short description that summarizes a [[CreativeWork]].

@graph.rdfs:label: InviteAction
@graph.name: InviteAction
@graph.rdfs:comment: The act of asking someone to attend an event. Reciprocal of RsvpAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: CreativeWorkSeries
@graph.name: CreativeWorkSeries
@graph.rdfs:comment:
A CreativeWorkSeries in schema.org is a group of related items, typically but not necessarily of the same kind. CreativeWorkSeries are usually organized into some order, often chronological. Unlike [[ItemList]] which is a general purpose data structure for lists of things, the emphasis with CreativeWorkSeries is on published materials (written e.g. books and periodicals, or media such as TV, radio and games).

Specific subtypes are available for describing [[TVSeries]], [[RadioSeries]], [[MovieSeries]], [[BookSeries]], [[Periodical]] and [[VideoGameSeries]]. In each case, the [[hasPart]] / [[isPartOf]] properties can be used to relate the CreativeWorkSeries to its parts. The general CreativeWorkSeries type serves largely just to organize these more specific and practical subtypes.

It is common for properties applicable to an item from the series to be usefully applied to the containing group. Schema.org attempts to anticipate some of these cases, but publishers should be free to apply properties of the series parts to the series as a whole wherever they seem appropriate.

@graph.rdfs:label: associatedDisease
@graph.name: associatedDisease
@graph.rdfs:comment: Disease associated to this BioChemEntity. Such disease can be a MedicalCondition or a URL. If you want to add an evidence supporting the association, please use PropertyValue.

@graph.rdfs:label: educationalLevel
@graph.name: educationalLevel
@graph.rdfs:comment: The level in terms of progression through an educational or training context. Examples of educational levels include 'beginner', 'intermediate' or 'advanced', and formal sets of level indicators.

@graph.rdfs:label: occupationLocation
@graph.name: occupationLocation
@graph.rdfs:comment: The region/country for which this occupational description is appropriate. Note that educational requirements and qualifications can vary between jurisdictions.

@graph.rdfs:label: RejectAction
@graph.name: RejectAction
@graph.rdfs:comment:
The act of rejecting to/adopting an object.

Related actions:

* [[AcceptAction]]: The antonym of RejectAction.
